jobs.title: Engagement Manager - NGO
jobs.description:
Join an international medical non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting equitable access to resilient healthcare systems worldwide, including in Belgium, with the mission of ensuring that no one suffers or dies from preventable and treatable diseases.

The organisation operates across multiple countries, advancing public health through sustainable healthcare initiatives. It provides expert, compassionate care to people affected by tuberculosis and neglected tropical skin diseases, such as leprosy and leishmaniasis, which are closely associated with poverty, while working in close collaboration with local health systems and communities.


Jobomschrijving

You lead individual donor retention strategy to maximise donor lifetime value and drive sustainable fundraising growth through data-driven donor journeys, strong donor loyalty, and an outstanding donor experience.

Your role ?

1. Individual Donor Retention Strategy

  • Define and lead the long-term individual donor retention strategy,
  • Own and continuously optimize the donor lifecycle (welcome, engagement, upgrade,loyalty, reactivation).
  • Drive donor retention, lifetime value and sustainable individual giving revenue.
  • Align retention priorities fundraising objectives



2. Donor Experience & Engagement

  • Ensure a consistent, seamless and donor-centric experience across all touchpoints.
  • Lead multi-channel donor stewardship and engagement initiatives.
  • Strengthen donor loyalty, advocacy and long-term commitment through personalized engagement.
  • Coordinate stakeholders involved in the donor journey to ensure consistency and impact.



3. Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Define, monitor and report on retention, engagement and lifetime value KPIs.
  • Translate donor insights into strategic recommendations and improvement actions.
  • Evaluate initiatives and optimize resource allocation based on impact.
  • Foster a data-driven culture of continuous improvement.



4. Data-Driven Donor Journeys

  • Advance the use of donor data to personalize journeys and improve decision-making
  • Partner with ICT and CRM teams to ensure reliable data, segmentation and automation.
  • Optimize donor journey processes through data, testing, and technology.
  • Ensure donor engagement is supported by accurate, actionable and shared data.



5. Mission-led Donor Communications

  • Strengthen the emotional connection between donors and Damien Foundation.
  • Shape donor communications together with Brand & Acquisition to maximize engagement and loyalty.
  • Ensure storytelling and engagement support long-term donor commitment and sustainable revenue growth.
  • Contribute to a coherent donor experience aligned with the organization's positioning.



6. Data Governance & GDPR Compliance

  • Ensure all donor engagement, retention, communication, and data management activities comply with GDPR requirements and internal data protection policies.
  • Safeguard donor privacy, consent management, data accuracy, and the secure use of personal data across all channels and systems

  • You have a master's degree in marketing, Sales, Economics, Communications, or equivalent experience.
  • You have a minimum of 5 years' experience in donor engagement, individual giving, donor retention, CRM-driven marketing, or customer/donor lifecycle management, with a proven ability to design and optimize data-driven journeys that strengthen loyalty, lifetime value, and long-term support.
  • Experience in the non-profit or social impact sector is an asset.
  • You are fluent in French and Dutch, with professional proficiency in the other national language and excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong organizational skills, with a focus on efficient processes, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Strong digital mindset, with the ability to support digital transformation and leverage digital tools to achieve strategic objectives.
  • Opportunity-driven, action-oriented, and results-focused, with strong attention to detail and a proven ability to deliver long-term results.
  • Strong leadership, project management and change management skills.
  • Proven people management experience, with the ability to lead and develop teams through organizational transformation while fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate donor data into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM systems, donor segmentation, and marketing automation.
  • Experience with ERP software is an asset .
  • Excellent writing skills and communication skills

jobs.title: Freelance Warehouse Manager
jobs.description:
The client is a leading international industrial organization operating in a complex, high-volume manufacturing environment, with a strong focus on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and supply chain performance.


Jobomschrijving

  • Lead, coordinate, and monitor day-to-day warehouse and distribution activities, ensuring operational priorities, service levels, inventory accuracy, and delivery requirements are met.
  • Manage workforce planning and resource allocation, while overseeing warehouse personnel and ensuring the effective use of warehouse space, equipment, and operational resources.
  • Develop and monitor operating and investment budgets, ensuring strong cost control and alignment with departmental objectives and performance KPIs.
  • Identify and implement process, technology, equipment, and organizational improvements to optimize logistics operations and drive continuous improvement across the supply chain.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a mixed workforce while ensuring compliance with health, safety, environmental, quality, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field, with 5-8 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Proven experience in warehouse and distribution management, ideally within a complex industrial or high-volume operational environment.
  • Strong skills in operational planning, stakeholder management, project management, budget control, and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated leadership and people-management capabilities, with the ability to motivate teams and manage both permanent and temporary workforce populations.
  • Fluent English and fluent local language skills, with strong written and verbal communication abilities and a strong focus on operational excellence.

jobs.title: Freelance verkoper op commissiebasis
jobs.description:
Webily BV is gespecialiseerd in professionele websites en digitale oplossingen voor zelfstandigen en ondernemingen. Om onze commerciële groei verder te ondersteunen, zoeken we een gemotiveerde freelance verkoper die op zelfstandige basis nieuwe klanten aanbrengt.

Als freelance verkoper ga je actief op zoek naar zelfstandigen en bedrijven die behoefte hebben aan een nieuwe of verbeterde website. Je legt het eerste contact, luistert naar de behoeften van de potentiële klant en stelt de diensten en websitepakketten van Webily op een duidelijke en professionele manier voor.

Je staat onder andere in voor:

  • Actieve prospectie naar nieuwe klanten
  • Telefonisch, digitaal of persoonlijk contact opnemen met potentiële klanten
  • De diensten en websitepakketten van Webily voorstellen
  • Behoeften van potentiële klanten detecteren
  • Leads en commerciële contacten opvolgen
  • Verkoopgesprekken voeren en klanten overtuigen
  • Nieuwe klanten aanbrengen en commerciële opportuniteiten signaleren

Je werkt zelfstandig en krijgt veel vrijheid om je prospectie, werkmethode en planning zelf te organiseren.

We zoeken een commercieel ingesteld persoon die zelfstandig kan werken en initiatief durft nemen.

Je:

  • communiceert vlot, professioneel en klantgericht
  • hebt commerciële feeling en overtuigingskracht
  • bent resultaatgericht en gemotiveerd
  • durft actief nieuwe klanten te benaderen
  • kunt zelfstandig prospecteren en contacten opvolgen
  • bent betrouwbaar en komt gemaakte afspraken na
  • kunt goed luisteren naar de behoeften van een klant
  • hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands

Ervaring in verkoop, prospectie, digitale diensten, marketing of websites is een pluspunt, maar geen absolute vereiste. Motivatie, commerciële aanleg en doorzettingsvermogen zijn voor ons belangrijker.

Technische kennis van webdesign of websiteontwikkeling is niet vereist.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij administratief sterk én heb je een vlotte babbel? Krijg je energie van klanten helpen, denk je graag mee en spot je moeiteloos commerciële kansen? Dan ben jij de klantgerichte collega die we zoeken!

Als Customer Service Medewerker ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten: Je luistert naar hun vragen en behoeften, geeft deskundig advies en zoekt samen naar de best mogelijke oplossing. Dankzij jouw persoonlijke aanpak zorg je ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord en goed geholpen voelen.

  • Je staat klanten professioneel en vriendelijk te woord via telefoon, e-mail en chat.
  • Je luistert actief naar de klant en brengt zijn of haar behoeften en verwachtingen helder in kaart.
  • Je geeft advies en informatie op maat en denkt proactief mee over de beste oplossing.
  • Je herkent commerciële opportuniteiten en weet deze op een natuurlijke manier om te zetten in concrete acties.
  • Je verwerkt en registreert alle klantinformatie nauwkeurig en tijdig in het systeem.
  • Je volgt klantvragen en dossiers correct op en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken worden nagekomen.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende interne afdelingen om klanten snel en efficiënt verder te helpen.
  • Je denkt actief mee over hoe de klantenservice verder kan worden verbeterd.

Kortom: jij combineert een klantgerichte aanpak met commerciële feeling en zorgt ervoor dat elke klantcontact een positieve ervaring wordt.

  • Je communiceert vloeiend in het Nederlands, zowel gesproken als geschreven, aangevuld met een aardig mondje Frans en Engels.
  • Je bent stressbestendig en klantvriendelijk. Je gaat altijd voor de beste oplossing voor het bedrijf én de klant.
  • Je kan vlot schakelen tussen verschillende kanalen.
  • Je blijft rustig en kan prioriteiten stellen.
  • Je past je gemakkelijk aan aan je gesprekspartner, zodat het gesprek zo optimaal mogelijk verloopt.
  • Zaterdagwerk (volledige dag) is geen probleem voor jou. (1 zaterdag op 2)

jobs.title: Quantity Surveyor
jobs.description:
Job Description â Quantity Surveyor (QS Engineer)Position

Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer â Civil Construction

Project: Commercial Hotel Construction Project

Location: Vijayawada / Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh

Site: Daspalla Project Site

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in civil/building construction to join the project team for a commercial hotel construction project in Vijayawada/Amaravati.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, rate analysis, measurement, subcontractor billing, client billing, material reconciliation and cost control.

Candidates with experience in commercial buildings, hotels, high-rise buildings or large-scale building projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review BOQs, quantity take-offs and estimates for civil and finishing works.
  • Prepare detailed quantity calculations from architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
  • Conduct regular site measurements and maintain accurate measurement records.
  • Prepare and verify contractor/subcontractor bills based on actual site measurements.
  • Review subcontractor RA bills, work orders, measurements and supporting documents.
  • Prepare client bills / RA bills and ensure timely submission.
  • Carry out rate analysis for various civil, structural and finishing items.
  • Monitor project quantities against the BOQ and identify variations.
  • Prepare and maintain variation statements, extra items and deviation statements.
  • Track project costs and assist in maintaining effective cost control.
  • Reconcile quantities of key materials such as cement, steel, concrete and other construction materials.
  • Coordinate with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Team, Purchase Team, Accounts Team and subcontractors.
  • Check drawings and specifications to identify quantity/cost implications before execution.
  • Maintain proper documentation of measurements, bills, work orders, quotations and quantity records.
  • Assist in preparing project cost forecasts and quantity/progress reports.
  • Support commercial negotiations with subcontractors and vendors when required.
  • Ensure that all billing and measurement documentation is accurate and submitted within project timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer in civil/building construction.
  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity take-off, measurements and billing.
  • Good understanding of civil construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience in subcontractor billing and client billing.
  • Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost estimation.
  • Experience handling variation orders, extra items and reconciliation statements.
  • Good knowledge of Excel and quantity/billing-related software.
  • Ability to independently handle QS activities at a project site.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in the following types of projects will be preferred:

  • Hotels / Hospitality Projects
  • Commercial Buildings
  • High-rise Buildings
  • Residential & Commercial Complexes
  • Large-scale Civil Construction Projects

Om jobbet

Vi har en tjänst ledigt hos en härlig kvinna en bit utanför Örnsköldsvik.

Vi söker en personlig assistent som tycker om trädgård, laga mat och baka.

Du är meriterande om du är utbildad undersköterska.

Arbetstiderna är 8.00 - 21.00 (en lördag varannan vecka.) Det är 3 arbetspass i veckan.

Körkort och tillgång till egen bil är ett krav då du behöver ta dig till arbetsplatsen. Hund och Katt finns i hemmet.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent innebär att du hjälper en annan människa att leva ett så självständigt liv som möjligt. Du är den som ska kompensera för den personens funktionsnedsättning och hjälpa till med både stort och smått.

Arbetet

-innebär ofta att du hjälper till med förflyttningar, av och påklädning, personlig hygien, att sköta hushållet, vara med på fritidsaktiviteter mm.

Att bygga en stark relation som ändå är professionell är grunden för en bra assistans. Det måste finnas ett förtroende mellan dig och den du ska arbeta med och det är viktigt att ni kan fungera tillsammans. God personkemi är viktigt!

Kanske har vi jobbet som skulle vara perfekt för just Dig! Tveka inte att höra av dig till oss.



Om oss:

Care of Elin & Lotta är ett lokalt företag som arbetar med personlig assistans och personlig omsorg.

Vår värdegrund bygger på ödmjukhet, respekt och en genuin vilja att hjälpa. Vi förstår att det vi gör påverkar människors liv, och därför tar vi vårt ansvar på största allvar. Vi är tacksamma för det förtroende som ges oss, och arbetar alltid för att vara ett stöd som känns nära, tryggt och pålitligt.

Vi söker de bästa medarbetarna

Som anställd på Care of Elin & Lotta så blir du en del av ett härligt Team med närvarande chefer som vill ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna för att kunna göra ett bra arbete. Vi vill ge våra kunder den allra bästa assistansen och omsorgen och det innebär att vi även har höga krav på vår personal.

När du arbetar hos oss så förväntar vi oss att du har ett professionellt förhållningssätt till yrket och är en god lagspelare som tillsammans med dina kollegor och chefer arbetar aktivt för att skapa en bra och lösningsfokuserad arbetsgrupp.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic team as a Software Developer in the GCO EN D&S PMO, where you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our COMOS engineering platform. Imagine designing and implementing software solutions that not only support our internal R&D initiatives but also cater to external customer projects. You will engage in hands-on development and provide technical project support, collaborating closely with a diverse network of stakeholders. Your ability to manage complex projects and translate engineering requirements into robust software solutions will be key to your success. Get ready to immerse yourself in a collaborative environment where your contributions will drive innovation and excellence!

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Design and develop tailored software solutions on the COMOS Aries engineering platform to fulfill specific R&D and customer project needs.
    Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for solution designs, data models, and system integrations.
    Lead the evaluation and selection of technologies and methodologies to enhance the engineering tool ecosystem’s functionality and performance.
    Implement and manage system configurations, customizations, and integrations based on approved architectural designs.
    Perform advanced troubleshooting and debugging to resolve complex technical issues within the application and its interfaces.
    Manage source code and deployment packages using version control and CI/CD pipelines.
    Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and customers to define technical scope, deliverables, and timelines.
    Provide expert-level technical guidance and support to project teams and end-users during implementation and operational phases.
    Coach and mentor junior developers and team members on software development best practices and platform-specific knowledge.
    Foster close collaboration and support for our Engineering Systems team and its Business Analysts.

What You Bring

    Proven experience with C#, .NET Framework, WPF, and GIT.
    Demonstrated ability to manage large, complex software projects or processes with minimal oversight.
    Experience in developing custom solutions within an existing framework of a third-party application.
    Familiarity with Kanban and Scrum methodologies, including tools like Azure DevOps and Jira.
    Knowledge of AI/LLM assisted development, including its possibilities and pitfalls.
    Experience with web API integrations and asynchronous programming.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills.
    An open mindset that values new ideas, positive thinking, and problem-solving.
    A structured approach to continuous improvement in work processes.
    Interest in collaborating with individuals from diverse backgrounds and cultures.
    Proficiency in Swedish and English is required.
    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Snowflake, or other data lake solutions, as well as large database management, migration, and data extraction is a plus.
    Familiarity with additional programming languages (such as VB, Python, etc.) is advantageous.

About the Team
You will be part of the SE D GCO EN D&S PMO management team, which consists of three specialized teams: Project Management, Engineering Systems, and Technical Information Systems. Together, we work collaboratively to drive project success and deliver innovative solutions that meet our customers’ needs.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Místo výkonu práce: Valašské Meziříčí. Vhodné také pro OZZ.

Náplň práce:

- poskytování individuálního či rodinného odborného adiktologického poradenství,
- podpora klienta ve fázi změny, spolupráce s klienty na předcházení rizik, podpora zvyšování kompetencí klienta,
- provádění komplexní adiktologické diagnostiky bez indikace lékaře,
- provádění analýzy a hodnocení zdravotní a sociální situace, a to spolu se zvážením širších souvislostí a dopadů na osobní, rodinnou a širší situaci klienta, doporučení následné péče,
- poskytování odborné podpory blízkým osobám,
- zajišťování realizace svépomocných skupinových aktivit pro cílovou skupinu,
- poskytování doléčovacích aktivit pro osoby po léčbě závislostí a podpora při ambulantní léčbě,
- zpracování odborných zpráv, jednání se spolupracujícími organizacemi,
- zajišťování evidence klientské práce,
- účast na metodických, klientských a organizačních poradách realizačního týmu,
- účast na odborném vzdělávání a supervizích.

Požadujeme:

- odborná způsobilost k výkonu povolání adiktologa dle § 21a zákona č.  96/2004 Sb.,
- trestní bezúhonnost, zdravotní způsobilost a vyjasněný vztah k drogám a uživatelům drog,
- komunikativnost, schopnost empatie a navazování kontaktů,
- spolehlivost, zodpovědnost, schopnost týmové i samostatné práce,
- znalost práce na PC,
- výhodou je předchozí dobrovolnická práce nebo zaměstnanecká praxe v adiktologických či jiných sociálních službách, absolvovaný nebo započatý psychoterapeutický výcvik.

jobs.description:
Společnost EURONA s.r.o., hledá do týmu kolegu či kolegyni, které baví kombinace dat, kreativy a viditelných výsledků. Hledá člověka, který chce být součástí týmu přímo na pracovišti a vyhovuje mu každodenní spolupráce v kanceláři. Tato pozice není určena pro práci formou home office ani remote spolupráce, a to ani částečně.

Jedná se o pracovní poměr na dobu určitou s možností prodloužení na dobu neurčitou, jednosměnný provoz. Nástup možný ihned.

Co Vás čeká: tvorba a příprava grafických návrhů pro tiskové i online materiály; sazba textů, úprava fotografií a produktových vizuálů; příprava tiskových dat pro tiskárnu.

Co od Vás očekáváme: znalost programů Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator a InDesign; kreativní myšlení a grafické i typografické cítění; samostatnost, pečlivost a zodpovědný přístup; schopnost týmové spolupráce; přehled o současných trendech v grafice a designu.

Co Vám nabízíme: mzdu odpovídající zkušenostem s motivační složkou dle odvedených výsledků; práci v týmu zkušených kolegů; možnost dalšího vzdělávání a rozvoje; flexibilní pracovní dobu; stravenky (100 Kč/den); příspěvek na penzijní nebo životní pojištění.

Kontakt e-mailem: personalni@eurona.cz (životopis a ukázka vlastní tvorby).

jobs.title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst. 

 

About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an opportunity to serve as a key partner and advisor on Notion's Business Operations team, working primarily with our Engineering, Product, and Design teams. Business Operations is a cross-functional team that partners with senior leaders across the company, focusing on high-impact strategic projects and analysis.

In this role, you'll independently identify the highest-leverage opportunities, define the problem, drive execution, and keep going. If you thrive when given full ownership and a blank page, this role is for you. You'll work hand-in-hand with senior leadership to identify, structure, and act on the most challenging strategic and operational questions impacting our business. And you’ll use AI to build scalable systems and processes that multiply your impact.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Proactively surface and prioritize high-impact strategic and operational opportunities and own them end-to-end from scoping through execution

 - Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and go-to-market leaders to define and implement strategy across all Notion products, driving increased value for our users, our customers, and our business

 - Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for the Notion leadership team, defining clear hypotheses and building business cases and quantitative models that will inform and influence our approach

 - Work closely with cross-functional leaders to define and manage key drivers of business performance, identifying areas of opportunity and incorporating them into your work

 - Develop a comprehensive understanding of our competitive positioning by using, assessing, and developing insights about peer businesses to inform your recommendations

 - Deeply understand Notion customers and the broader market landscape to uncover insights that inform your recommendations

 - Use AI tools and drive automation to create scalable solutions that combine a broad vision for what is possible with an understanding of the practical demands that constrain them




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years of strategy experience, with 5+ years’ relevant experience in management consulting, investment banking, or related professional services fields

 - Highly structured mindset with a strong focus on driving outcomes and turning data into actionable insights

 - Excellent financial modeling skills, with strong attention to detail and high standards for quality

 - Outstanding executive-level written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to operate independently with senior stakeholders and manage relationships, deliverables, and timelines with minimal supervision

 - Genuine enthusiasm for and proficiency with AI tools; we use AI across the board to move faster and work smarter, and you do too

 - Hands-on experience with modern AI tools like Notion AI, Claude, Codex, or similar is expected; you should be actively experimenting with new models and workflows, not just aware they exist

 - Deep understanding of AI SaaS business models, monetization strategies, and pricing frameworks, or a strong demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly

 - Data self-sufficiency; knowledge of SQL is required

 - Comfort working in a high-growth, constantly changing environment with passion and enthusiasm

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in strategy and operations in B2B SaaS businesses

 - Prior people management experience

 - Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and modeling

jobs.title: IFO Vuxenenheten söker socialsekreterare
jobs.description:
Ansök idag. Kollegor imorgon.

Vill du ha ett meningsfullt och varierat arbete där du får göra skillnad för människor i komplexa livssituationer? Individ- och familjeomsorgens vuxenenhet söker dig som vill arbeta med myndighetsutövning inom skadligt bruk/beroende, våld i nära relation samt övriga vuxenfrågor. Du blir en del av en erfaren arbetsgrupp med elva socialsekreterare, fördelad på två team: vuxengruppen (4 handläggare) och ekonomigruppen (7 handläggare). Varje grupp leds av en 1:e socialsekreterare, och i enheten finns även en administratör samt ett resursteam med två behandlare.

Du får en grundlig introduktion, kontinuerlig metod- och processhandledning och nära stöd från 1:e socialsekreterare. Du blir en del av en verksamhet där myndighetsutövning och behandlingsinsatser finns nära varandra och där vi tillsammans utvecklar arbetssätt för att möta framtidens socialtjänst. Alla våra handläggare är utbildade i MI. Vi använder standardiserade bedömningsmetoder, ex FREDA bedömningsmetod, ASI, Ung-dok, som ett stöd i utredningsarbetet.

Socialtjänsten står inför spännande förändringar, bland annat genom samsjuklighetsreformen och den nya socialtjänstlagen. Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och utveckla arbetssätt och samverkan i takt med att verksamheten förändras. Vi söker dig som tycker om att utvecklas tillsammans med andra och ser möjligheter i förändring.

Vi intervjuar löpande i denna rekrytering och vid behov kan vi även ha fler intervjuer. Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Arbetsuppgifter

    Handlägga ärenden enligt SoL och LVM
    Utreda och bedöma behov av stöd och insatser
    Fatta beslut och följa upp beviljade insatser
    Samverka med interna och externa aktörer
    Tillsammans med den enskilde hitta vägar mot förändring och ett mer självständigt liv



Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig med socionomexamen och erfarenhet av socialtjänstens myndighetsutövning inom något av områdena våld i nära relationer eller skadligt bruk/beroende. Erfarenhet av båda områdena är meriterande. Du har goda kunskaper i SoL och LVM.

Det är viktigt att du har datafärdigheter relevant för ditt uppdrag Du behöver kunna uttrycka dig väl på svenska i både tal och skrift. Du behöver också kunna kommunicera på engelska.



Övrigt

Körkort B



Förmågor och färdigheter

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som:

    Har ett stort engagemang för att stötta människor i svåra livssituationer och som trivs med att arbeta i team och samverka med andra aktörer för att skapa bästa möjliga stöd för våra klienter.
    Har en god samarbetsförmåga och kan relatera till andra på ett lyhört och flexibelt sätt.
    Arbetar självständigt och strukturerat i en ibland utmanande vardag och kan se möjligheter och vägar framåt även i komplexa ärenden samtidigt som du kan be om hjälp när det behövs.
    Du planera och prioriterar ditt arbete samtidigt som du anpassar dig till förändrade förutsättningar.
    I tjänsten kommer du att möta personer i olika livssituationer och du ska vara trygg i att kunna hålla svåra samtal.



Socialförvaltningen

Med sina drygt 700 medarbetare bedriver socialförvaltningen en bred verksamhet för att se till att våra invånare får det stöd och den hjälp som de har rätt till. Förvaltningen verkar under socialnämnden och ansvarar för vård och omsorg om äldre och personer med fysisk och psykisk funktionsnedsättning samt stöd, rådgivning och övriga insatser till barn, ungdomar och vuxna. Socialförvaltningens arbete är reglerat av lagar och förordningar, då framför allt Socialtjänstlagen (SoL), Hälso- och sjukvårdslagen (HSL) samt Lagen om stöd och service till vissa funktionshindrade (LSS).

Mora kommun

Mora kommun är alla vi som jobbar här. För oss är det naturligt att ha medborgaren/kunden i fokus, vara serviceinriktade och bemöta alla med respekt. Vi tar gemensamt ansvar för verksamheten, vår egen och andras arbetssituation. När vi möter utmaningar och nya förutsättningar gör vi det med ett positivt förhållningssätt och tar tillsammans initiativ till utveckling. Var med oss när vi växer som människor och kommun. Idag och imorgon. Läs mer om oss här: Mora kommun som arbetsgivare

För dig som sökande har vi möjlighet att erbjuda medflyttarservice, se vidare Rekryteringslots

Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Mora kommun kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef, om du blir aktuell för anställning.

Vi värnar om din integritet, läs mer om vår behandling av personuppgifter här: Personuppgiftshantering.

Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

jobs.title: EY-Parthenon Manager | People M&A Nordics
jobs.description:
The opportunity



At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.



EY-Parthenon is looking for a Manager with experience from M&A projects to join our Nordic People M&A team. The role is part of our Nordic practice and can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, working closely with colleagues and clients globally.





Your key responsibilities



As a Manager in EY-Parthenon’s dedicated People M&A practice, you will work with some of the leading HR and pension specialists advising and supporting corporate and private equity clients in transactions. You will support and guide our clients through a broad range of complex people matters across the entire deal cycle, including HR and pension due diligence, ensuring readiness for day one, and achieving synergies in post-merger integrations. Some of the key responsibilities include:

    Prepare due diligence reports on HR, including analysis of target company data to identify key people related financial exposures in a due diligence context, such as workforce costs and future liabilities, retention risks among key employees, side-by-side benefits comparison, and assessment of incentives programs, among other things
    Collaborate with EY colleagues and client executives to address people related issues in carve-outs, signing-to-closing and post-deal integration phases (e. g, HR operating model implementation, organizational design, union consultation strategies, compensation planning) to ensure seamless employee transitions
    Support the evaluation, design, and development of retention strategies that align compensation, benefits and incentives for executives and key employees with overarching acquisition goals
    Mentoring junior team members and fostering an inclusive, high-performance team culture





Skills and attributes for success



    Excellent communication skills in English required, both verbal and written
    4-7 years of experience in transactions or strategy consulting
    Quantitative mindset with a focus on delivering excellent work in a fast-paced environment
    Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
    Strong interest in the financial aspects of people/HR topics, including compensation and benefits and/or pensions





Ideally, you’ll also



    Have expertise in financial analysis of HR costs and liabilities from annual reports and internal financial statements
    Experience working with senior stakeholders on HR M&A programmes
    Previous M&A experience, ideally with a focus on people-related matters, e.g. Due Diligence, post-deal integration, compensation & benefits, organisation design, competence strategy and fulfilment, change- and/or culture programs
    Experience in analysing and assessing pension plans





What we look for



    An agile, business and growth-oriented mindset. We’re looking for innovative individuals who can work in an agile way and adapt to a changing business environment
    Curiosity and a purpose-driven approach. We seek people who see opportunities instead of challenges and ask better questions to build a better working world
    Inclusivity. We value individuals who embrace diverse perspectives and work inclusively to build safety and trust





What we offer you



We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and to help build a better working world. Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



Please submit your application no later than 13th of September 2026. If you have questions about the role, please contact Marcus Nylén at marcus.nylen@se.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com.



Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.



EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.description:
TL;DR You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

    8+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with at least 3 at staff/principal level.
    Strong engineering background - you build detections as code, not as saved searches in a SIEM.
    Deep experience with cloud telemetry (GCP/AWS/Cloudflare), endpoint EDR, identity logs, and modern SIEM/data-lake stacks (Panther, Elastic, Snowflake/Clickhouse).
    Battle-tested incident commander who has led real high-severity incidents from first alert to public post-mortem.
    Adversary-minded: comfortable with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intel, purple-teaming, and red team collaboration.
    Bonus: detection for LLM/agent abuse, prompt injection at scale, or insider risk in AI-augmented engineering orgs.

What you'll do

    Build the detection engineering platform - pipelines, detections-as-code, automated triage, and response playbooks.
    Design and own security incident response process with 24/7 coverage, with a small, high-leverage human and agent team.
    Lead incidents end-to-end: detection, containment, eradication, post-mortem, and follow-through.
    Hunt proactively across corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces - and turn every finding into a durable detection.
    Define what 'world-class D&R for an AI-native company' looks like, and build it.

Our tech stack

    Frontend: React and Typescript.
    Backend: Golang and Rust.
    Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
    DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
    Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.

And we’re always exploring what’s next!

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer to SaaS-company!
jobs.description:
Are you an ML Engineer with hands-on experience taking machine learning models from development all the way into production? Do you also have a strong foundation in data engineering and enjoy working independently in a collaborative team? Then this could be your next opportunity!

ABOUT THE POSITION

Friday is now looking for an ML Engineer with Data Engineering competence who wants to join a growing data product team. Over the past two years, the team has built a modern data platform with a strong focus on Databricks. The focus is now shifting towards building an intelligence layer that will enable advanced solutions such as forecasting, ranking, and recommendation systems.

As an ML Engineer, your main focus will be applied machine learning. You will take ownership of models throughout their entire lifecycle, from development and deployment to monitoring and maintenance in production. At the same time, you will contribute to the underlying data platform when needed, making this a role where both your ML and data engineering skills will come into play.

You’ll be part of a smaller, collaborative team consisting of Data Engineers, a Product Manager and an Engineering Manager. The team places great value on inclusiveness, psychological safety and different perspectives. The role offers a high level of ownership, giving you the opportunity to work proactively, contribute your own ideas and have a real impact on how the team's work develops.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Design and develop ML models for forecasting, ranking and recommendation systems.
    Take full ownership of the model lifecycle, from development and deployment to monitoring and maintenance in production.
    Work closely with product teams to determine how model outputs should be integrated and used within the product.
    Contribute to the data platform, including data ingestion pipelines, observability and platform maintenance.
    Troubleshoot issues across both data pipelines and deployed ML models.
    Develop high-quality, maintainable code in line with established coding practices and conventions.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

    Has 1–2 years of hands-on, end-to-end ML experience, including taking models into production.
    Has 3+ years of experience in data engineering or data-related software engineering in a cloud environment.
    Has strong hands-on experience with Databricks as well as Python and SQL.
    Has a solid understanding of data platform fundamentals, including data ingestion, observability and maintenance.
    Is familiar with modern software development and delivery practices.
    Has experience working in a cloud environment such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

It is not required, but considered a plus if you have:

    Experience with additional cloud-based data or ML technologies.
    Experience contributing to the architecture and development of data platforms.

As a person, we believe you are proactive, self-driven and solution-oriented. You enjoy taking ownership of your work and are comfortable navigating complex technical challenges independently. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing ideas, collaborating with others and contributing to a positive team environment.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYMENT

This is a consulting assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The ambition from both the customer and Friday is for you to transition into direct employment with the customer.

    Start date: As soon as possible, but considering the notice period.
    Location: Gothenburg.
    Salary: Fixed monthly.
    Employment type: Full-time / Part-time

ABOUT FRIDAY

By being a partner to both our candidates and clients, we strive to find the best possible match. We do this by truly getting to know both our clients and candidates. Naturally, we make sure that skills and experience requirements align, but above all, we place great importance on shared values and a company culture that both parties appreciate.

Our passion is helping people find the right role, workplace and professional environment within IT and technology. That is why we founded Friday, with the ambition of helping you find a job that gives you that Friday feeling – every day!

We primarily focus on people who are at the beginning of their careers or are currently studying IT or engineering at a university or college.

We believe that people reach their full potential when they look forward to going to work every morning. “Friday – everyday” – how does that sound?

jobs.title: Registrar - Security Registry
jobs.description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realize amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

Do you want to contribute to security at one of Sweden's most high-tech companies? Security is prioritized, on top management's agenda and crucial for competitiveness, profitability and trust in a challenging global market.

Saab Naval Security Department is looking for a Registrar responsible for the Security Registry in Lund. As the role involves handling classified information and physical security-related processes, the work is primarily carried out on-site.

In this role, you will work hands-on with security-related administration and especially the management of classified defence information, where attention to detail makes a real difference.

You ensure that classified defence documents are registered, distributed, archived and inventoried in accordance with established regulations. You will also support encryption tasks, manage cryptographic keys and perform administrative tasks such as IT-certificate management and task management administration.

Your work impacts both colleagues and business operations, as the role is part of several interconnected security processes. The role involves coordination with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Saab's security organization and act as a backup function for Security Registries within the Business Area.

You are comfortable using the English language and flexible to travel within the position. You will be part of the Security Office within the Naval Security Department and report to the Head of Security Office.

Business Area Naval provides the most efficient platforms on and under the sea, both for the military and civilian domain. The portfolio covers submarines, surface ships, combat boats, under-surface vessels, torpedoes and more. Within Saab Security, we have anchored a Saab-wide ambition to become world leading in security risk management and to be referred to by other security professionals as the company having the best practices in place.

The Security Department at Business Area Naval is a team consisting of competences such as Security Managers, Information Security Specialists, Security Officers and Security Protection Specialists.

Your profile

To be successful in this role, you are structured and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and integrity. You take pride in delivering high-quality work and have an eye for documentation standards and administrative accuracy. Experience working with the Swedish Security Protection Act, classified information, or in regulated environments is meriting.

You are reliable and possess strong problem-solving abilities. You are comfortable handling both complex assignments and routine administrative tasks and approach your work with professionalism and commitment. You actively seek opportunities to improve ways of working, both within the department and across the business in relation to the security protection.

The role involves a significant amount of independent work, and you enjoy taking ownership of your responsibilities while remaining an engaged member of a broader security organization. You can adapt your communication style to different audiences and communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.

Your profile will be extra interesting if you possess any of the following:

    

Educated Registrar/Archivist, or equivalent professional experience

    

Curious about national and international security protection matters

    

Experience in communications security and cryptography (COMSEC) / encryption systems

Personal qualities are of great importance, and it is essential that you are trustworthy and act with strong ethics.

You understand the need for balanced security in a business-driven environment. As a Registrar at Saab Naval, you are likely to get in contact with classified information.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around security protection. For positions requiring security clearance, additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

If you are interested in what benefits you can take part of as an employee at Saab in Sweden, you can read more about them here.

Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes till trygg och varm assistentgrupp
jobs.description:
Om arbetet

Jag är en man på 31 år som söker en ny personlig assistent till min härliga assistentgrupp.
Jag har autism och en utvecklingsstörning och behöver stöd i stora delar av min vardag.

Det allra viktigaste för mig är att du är en lugn, trygg och omtänksam person och att du ser detta som ett långsiktigt arbete, så att vi kan bygga en stabil och förtroendefull relation. Jag har nämligen svårt för att ta in nya personer i mitt liv, och därför betyder kontinuitet mycket för mig.

Jag går till daglig verksamhet två dagar i veckan, och då följer du som assistent med mig dit. I ditt uppdrag ingår att motivera mig att påbörja, genomföra och avsluta aktiviteter, samt att vara strukturerad och stödjande i vardagen. Jag är själv en snäll och omtänksam person som behöver bemötas med respekt, tydlighet och godhet.

Jag tycker om att vara ute och går långa promenader varje dag, ibland flera stycken, så du behöver ha god kondition. Humor är också viktigt för mig – personer som har lätt till skratt och kan vara varma och avslappnade får mig att må bra.

Min energi varierar från dag till dag. Vissa dagar orkar jag mer, andra mindre. Därför behöver du kunna uppskatta ett lugnt och stillsamt tempo i perioder, och ha förståelse för att anpassning är en del av jobbet.

Jag har stort intresse av tv-spel, filmer, böcker och rollspel. Om du har har kunskap om rollspel som Dungeons & Dragons ses det som väldigt positivt.

Jag söker dig som:
Har erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller annan stödjande roll
Har kunskap om autism och förstår vikten av ett anpassat bemötande
Kan ta till dig både muntliga och skriftliga instruktioner och utföra dem
Är initiativrik men följsam i mitt tempo och mina rutiner
Är tydlig, strukturerad och lösningsfokuserad
Är snäll, omtänksam och har ett genuint engagemang för att hjälpa andra människor
Du ska vara flytande i svenska språket, både i tal och skrift, då jag har svårt att förstå otydligt tal
Är rökfri, då jag är mycket känslig för rök

Arbetstider:
Dygnspass med sovande jour
Omfattning 80-95 %

Jag ser fram emot din ansökan!

You'll work with:

    Android development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose

Working across regions and functions, you will influence how PLUS+1 evolves as an open and scalable platform. jobs.title: Ungdomsveileder
jobs.description:
Brenner du for å motivere og veilede ungdom til arbeid og aktivitet? Har du engasjement for Nav sitt samfunnsoppdrag?

Nav sitt overordnede mål er å gi mennesker muligheter til arbeid og aktivitet, og sikre rettigheter til velferdsytelser. Nav Ringerike er et utviklingsorientert kontor med 95 medarbeidere fordelt på ulike avdelinger og faggrupper. Vi har et sterkt fokus på arbeid og helhetlige løsninger til det beste for innbyggerne. Kontoret er lokalisert i lyse og trivelige lokaler i Hønefoss sentrum, en times kjøring fra Oslo.

Vi har nå ledig én fast stilling i Ungdomsavdelingen, og vi søker særlig etter deg som har et engasjement for å veilede og motivere ungdom, og som ønsker å bidra til at flere unge får mulighet til å lykkes i utdanning, arbeid og aktivitet.

Høres dette spennende ut? Da ønsker vi å høre fra deg.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Stillingen har som mål å bidra til at flest mulig kommer i arbeid, utdanning eller aktivitet, og oppnår økonomisk trygghet. Hovedarbeidsområdet er oppfølging og avklaring av personer som står i fare for å falle ut av, eller som allerede står utenfor arbeidslivet. Arbeidet innebærer også saksbehandling etter relevant lovverk i ulike fagsystemer ved hjelp av Nav sine arbeidsmetoder og verktøy

Arbeidsoppgaver vil være å:

  • følge opp ungdom i alderen 16 til 29 år i egen portefølje med arbeidsrettet veiledning og oppfølging
  • saksbehandle etter sosialtjenesteloven
  • veilede brukere innen personlig økonomi, budsjettering og daglig økonomistyring
  • kartlegge og avklare den enkeltes ressurser, muligheter og behov
  • benytte relevante tiltak og virkemidler for å støtte veien mot arbeid, utdanning og aktivitet
  • samarbeide tett i tverrfaglige team for å sikre helhetlig oppfølging
  • bygge relasjoner og samarbeide med arbeidsgivere, tiltaksarrangører og andre samarbeidspartnere
  • bidra til utvikling og forbedring av tjenestene ved kontoret
Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • fullført og bestått minimum treårig relevant høyskole- eller universitetsutdanning
  • utdanning innen samfunnsfag, helse- og sosialfag, pedagogikk eller veiledning er en fordel
  • god kunnskap om bruk av lov- og regelverk
  • god digital kompetanse og evne til raskt å sette deg inn i nye datasystemer
  • meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • førerkort klasse B

Utdanning fra utlandet må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse, og må dokumenteres.

Det er ønskelig at du:

  • har kjennskap til og erfaring fra Nav sine arbeidsområder
  • har erfaring med oppfølging og veiledning av ungdom i ulike livssituasjoner
Personlige egenskaper
  • godt humør, gode serviceholdninger og gode kommunikasjonsevner
  • trygghet i møte med ungdom og evne til å motivere, utfordre og skape mestring
  • trives i en hektisk arbeidshverdag og håndterer perioder med høyt arbeidspress
  • fleksibel, løsningsorientert og med stor grad av selvledelse
  • har god evne til å etablere tillit og bygge relasjoner med ungdom
  • kan møte mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner med respekt og profesjonalitet

Du vil i denne jobben møte mennesker med ulike utfordringer og behov. Vi vektlegger derfor særlig at du må være personlig egnet.

Vi tilbyr
  • gode faglige og personlige utviklingsmuligheter i arbeidshverdagen
  • fleksibel arbeidstid
  • gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger i KLP
  • lønn etter gjeldende regelverk

Søknad

Vi ønsker å gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Dette er også i tråd med vår Arbeidsgiverpolitikk (https://www.ringerike.kommune.no/globalassets/bilder-blokker-og-filarkiv/bilder-og-dokumenter/hr/pdf/rr_arbeidsgiverpolitikk_low.pdf) og våre verdier «NÆR» (https://www.ringerike.kommune.no/innhold/org-og-admin/om-ringerike-kommune/visjon-og-verdier/)

Faste ansatte med fortrinnsrett som overtallig, ferdig attført eller som ønsker å øke sin stillingsprosent, oppfordres til å søke. Du må begrunne fortrinnsretten i søknaden.

Søkerlisten til stillingen er offentlig og tilgjengelig for de om ber om det (offentleglova § 25). 
Du kan søke om å bli fritatt fra å stå på offentlig søkerliste. Dette må begrunnes og søkes om i det elektroniske søknadsskjema. Kravene er strenge. Om søknaden ikke blir innvilget, får du mulighet til å trekke deg fra prosessen.

Du må søke på stillingen elektronisk i WebCruiter. 

KontaktinformasjonDan Aspen, avdelingsleder, +47 48000666

3510 HØNEFOSS

Visste du at Ringerike kommune ligger sentralt i Østlandsområdet, kun en times kjøring fra Oslo? Ringerike byr i tillegg på flott natur, historiske steder, landlig idyll, levende by og et rikt kulturliv.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager / Programme Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager / Programme Manager – Business-Led SAP S/4HANA ImplementationAbout the role

We are looking for a senior project/programme manager to lead the next phase of a SAP S/4HANA implementation within a complex industrial operation. The core platform for finance and procurement is already in place – this phase is about designing and implementing the business processes and procedures that will support future industrial operations.

This is a business-led implementation programme. You will design the business processes from the ground up and make sure they are effectively implemented in SAP and connected digital systems. The role is leadership-oriented and business-facing rather than purely technical – the emphasis is on driving process design, coordination and alignment, not on deep SAP specialist expertise.

Scope

The initial focus is the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process:

    

Sales and order management

    

Product costing

    

Logistics and delivery

    

Commercial processes

    

Invoicing and settlement

The role also covers related processes:

    

Procurement

    

Material handling and inventory transactions

    

Production-related processes

    

Quality and material movements

    

Master data, integrations and interfaces with production-adjacent systems

Responsibilities

    

Lead the programme from planning and process design through implementation, testing, deployment and stabilisation.

    

Coordinate business functions, process owners, subject matter experts, digital teams, architects, vendors and implementation partners.

    

Lead workshops and drive alignment on new business processes and procedures.

    

Ensure processes work seamlessly across operations, sales, logistics, procurement, finance and commercial functions.

    

Manage scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, decisions, resources and milestones.

    

Present progress, risks and recommendations to senior stakeholders and steering committees.

    

Ensure data, integrations, testing, training, change management and operational readiness are addressed.

    

Build alignment and adoption among business stakeholders and end users.

Requirements (must-haves)

    

More than 10 years of relevant experience.

    

Strong leadership with the ability to make decisions and, above all, orchestrate experts, functions and stakeholders toward common goals.

    

Experience leading complex ERP implementation programmes or large-scale business process transformation initiatives.

    

Experience designing and implementing processes across multiple business functions.

    

Experience with Order-to-Cash, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics or similar operational processes.

    

A background in manufacturing, process industry, heavy industry, energy, chemicals, mining or another operationally complex environment.

    

Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with C-level stakeholders, business experts and end users.

    

Proven change management capabilities that drive alignment and adoption.

    

Experience managing implementation partners, risks, dependencies, testing activities and delivery governance.

    

A solid understanding of enterprise IT: architecture, integration platforms, software development and testing.

    

The ability to navigate ambiguity and establish structure in greenfield environments where processes and responsibilities are created for the first time.

    

Willingness to spend significant time on-site in Northern Sweden as well as in Stockholm.

Meritorious

    

Experience with SAP S/4HANA (an advantage, but not essential).

    

Experience from metals or steel production.

    

Experience with end-to-end flows from supply chain and production through to customer fulfilment in complex industrial operations.

This role is likely not a fit if you

    

Have experience limited to PMO coordination or administrative project management.

    

Have only managed a technical SAP workstream without owning business process design and implementation.

    

Lack experience working across multiple business functions.

    

Have no background in manufacturing, process industry or another operationally complex environment.

    

Are not comfortable leading workshops and facilitating decisions with senior stakeholders.

    

Are unwilling to spend significant time on-site in Northern Sweden.

Location

Northern Sweden and Stockholm. The role requires significant on-site presence during the assignment.

jobs.title: Familjeutredare/behandlare på Nanolfsvillan, HVB
jobs.description:
Vi söker dig, socionom eller psykolog, som vill arbeta i ett tryggt och professionellt team med fördjupad familjeutredning och familjebehandling.

Nanolfsvillan är ett utrednings- och behandlingshem för gravida och familjer med barn beläget i centrala Finspång. Vi arbetar med komplexa familjesystem där problematiken kan handla om anknytning, trauma, omsorgsbrister, funktionsnedsättningar, neuropsykiatriska svårigheter, psykisk ohälsa, våld i nära relation och missbruksbakgrund.

Arbetet på Nanolfsvillan sker i nära samverkan med familjer och kollegor via ett relationsbyggande förhållningssätt. Förhållningssättet skapar respekt mellan personal och familjer, en fördjupad förståelse för familjens möjligheter och svårigheter samt rak och öppen kommunikation kring barnets behov. Vi är en stabil personalgrupp med lång erfarenhet vilket ger rättssäkra bedömningar och en trygg arbetsmiljö.

Vi som arbetar med familjerna på Nanolfsvillan har högskoleutbildning och är socionomer, beteendevetare, socialpedagoger och behandlingspedagog. Vi har tillgång till sjuksköterska, psykolog, psykoterapeut och psykiatriker

I utredningsarbetet utgår vi från socialtjänstens uppdrag/frågeställningar och BBIC. Processen bygger på spontana och strukturerade observationer av familjesystemet och fördjupade samtal kring observationerna och socialtjänstens frågeställningar. Utredningar innehåller ofta arbete med kartläggning av nätverk, livslinje och barnsamtal, och psykologutredning kan ingå. Behandlingsarbetet styrs utifrån uppdraget från socialtjänsten och formas efter varje familjs behov med trygghet och delaktighet som grund och utifrån olika behandlingsmetoder.

Om du är intresserad av arbete hos oss på Nanolfsvillan ser vi att du är en person som har en inre trygghet och stabilitet. Vi värdesätter om du är tydlig, respektfull, lyhörd och flexibel. Det är viktigt att du har förmåga till ett relationsbyggande förhållningssätt. Du är prestigelös och har en förmåga till arbete i team, i en nära och öppen samverkan med kollegor. Arbetet kräver att du har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift samt hålla uppsatta tidsramar.

Vi önskar att du har socionom- eller psykologexamen. Det är meriterande är om du har utbildning inom; trauma, anknytning, Signs of Safety, barnsamtal, psykoterapi, våld i nära relation eller BBIC samt erfarenhet av utredning inom socialtjänsten och/eller arbete med familjebehandling.

Arbetet på Nanolfsvillan sker via schema där arbete på dagtid, kväll, natt och helger (var fjärde) ingår.

Nanolfsvillan HVB grundades 1986 och är privatägt. Det finns en nära samverkan mellan personal och ledning. Nanolfsvillan har under åren byggt upp goda arbetsmiljöstrukturer och arbetssätt samt ett heltäckande kvalitetsarbete.

Vi erbjuder vår personal:

Både process- och ärendehandledning.

Träning via AKTIV Hälsocenter.

___________________________________________________

Intervjuer kommer ske löpande.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan till arbete hos oss!

jobs.title: Plant Technical Support Engineer, Specialist(78033)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy to bridge the cap between people and departments? Are you good at communicating to different audiences, have an interest in understanding the business and technical side of your work? Then we have the position for you! Vestas is looking for a Plant Technical Support Engineer, Specialist (m/f/d))!

Region NCE and Global Offshore > NCE > Technical Operations North

Technical Operations is part of Service NCE (Northern & Central Europe) and supports the organization in installing and servicing a great number of SCADA systems, controlling medium and large sized wind power plants. Our mission is to transform a group of wind turbines into a fully operational power plant that meets contractual and regional specifications.

Our customers can mainly be found among larger power supply companies and professional investors.

Responsibilities

As a Specialist for Plant Operations, we will be the technical anchor for the whole department. You will report to the Director and contribute to the strategy and technical agenda.

    Have the overview of new products coming from R&D and be part of operational implementation
    Engage in technical escalations and risks to our business
    Anchor point for our 4 technical communities, making sure initiatives are aligned and create value for the business
    Stakeholder engagement, be part of global and regional communities
    Give input to the management on technical gaps, prioritisation, regional risks etc.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated leadership experience in a technical environment. For this position it is not your technical skills that will matter most, but more your ability to see synergies, align stakeholders and guide the technical agenda so it adds value to the business. You will be part of an operational department, but you will be the one with the helicopter view.

    Educational background in Information Technology, Automation or Telecommunications
    Solid leadership skills, either as a project manager or people leader
    Knowledge of the wind industry, experience with SCADA systems would be valued
    Fluency in English, both orally and in writing

Competencies

    Great communication skills, ability to explain complex technical topics in a simple way
    Professional stakeholder management skills
    Ability to work on your own and set direction for a team

What we offer

We offer an exciting job with great opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, collaborative, and international work environment in the renewable energy sector. We highly value initiative, accountability and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will have good opportunities to build your career in Vestas, when demonstrating aspiration, capacity, and potential.

Additional information

Your primary work location will be Aarhus or Videbæk, Denmark, but could also be in Malmö, Sweden, Husum or Hamburg, Germany.You should expect some travel activity, approximately 20 days per year.

If the above match your skills and qualifications, please apply no later than 20.09.2026 with an application written in English. For additional information about the position, please contact: Recruiter Rebecka Thorell at rbthr@vestas.com
