jobs.title: Juriste expert en protection des données - DPO (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du  décembre ; Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés; Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation; Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières; Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Délégué à la protection des données du secteur public, le CGSD recherche un(e) juriste expérimenté(e) en matier/ière de protection des données, notamment à travers une expérience avérée en qualité de délégué à la protection de données (DPD ou DPO). En ce sens, il faudra pour la personne qui candidate être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées: Conseils et informations aux administrations et aux communes sur toutes les questions qui concernent l'application de la législation sur la protection des données; Vérification du respect du RGPD dans le même périmètre; Rédaction et/ou revue des politiques internes y afférentes; Réalisation et/ou revue d'analyses d'impact relatives à la protection des données (AIPD); Analyses juridiques approfondies et élaboration de notes et d'avis juridiques; Rédaction de notes d'information internes, de supports de sensibilisation ainsi que de fiches et de guides pratiques en matier/ière de protection des données à caractère personnel; Veille juridique du cadre normatif et jurisprudentiel. Profil Compétences techniques Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences rédactionnelles; Vous disposez d'une bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques courants; Vous avez d'excellentes capacités analytiques, savez anticiper les défis ainsi que développer vos idées dans une approche panoramique et vous disposez d'un esprit de synthèse; Vous disposez d'une bonne aptitude à collaborer au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires et à travailler en réseau avec des partenaires internes et externes; Vous savez conceptualiser et modéliser des notions et situations abstraites. Compétences comportementales Rigoureux et structuré, vous travaillez de façon autonome et organisée; Vous avez le sens de l'initiative et êtes capable de coordonner des projets transversaux; Vous faites preuve d'originalité et de créativité dans l'élaboration de pistes de solutions; Vous avez le sens de la responsabilité et contribuez à un bon esprit d'équipe; Vous avez la confiance de vous orienter dans des domaines nouveaux et défiants et savez vous familiariser avec des sujets complexes. Atouts Vous avez une véritable expérience de Délégué à la protection des données au Luxembourg; Vous êtes titulaire du CCDL. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en droit ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. jobs.title: Resort Manager
jobs.description:
Sonka Resort, Finnish Lapland | Full-time, year-round | Start 1 October 2026

Sonka Resort is looking for an experienced Resort Manager to lead the resorts day-to-day operation and play an important role in its continued development.

Part of Arctic GM Experiences, Sonka combines accommodation, guest services and Arctic experiences in Finnish Lapland. We are looking for a strong hospitality professional who can take genuine ownership of the resort, lead the team and ensure a consistently high-quality guest experience.

- Lead the resort operation and team, including reception, housekeeping, maintenance and daily priorities

- A confident and supportive leader

- Structured, reliable and hands-on

- Proactive and comfortable making decisions

- Guest-focused with strong attention to quality

- Calm and solution-oriented when priorities change

- Fluent in English

- Hold a valid Category B driving licence recognised in Finland

- Already have the right to work in Finland without employer-sponsored work authorisation

- Experience from resort operations, international hospitality, high-volume environments or winter destinations is considered an advantage.


Why Sonka Resort?

This is a year-round management role with real responsibility and influence.

You will work closely with company management while having the independence to lead the resort, build strong working practices and help shape Sonka Resort as it continues to develop.

We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done, takes ownership and follows it through.

Apply

isa@sonka.fi

Applications are reviewed continuously.

jobs.title: Senior manager for GT IT Data Services Team, K Group
jobs.description:
Do you want to work as a critical link between business and technology in one of the leading company in its field? K Group is looking for an experienced and technically strong data professional to join K IT and strengthen our Grocery Trade IT Data Services team as Senior Manager working in IT Application Owner role.

We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K group!

About the role

This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of developing, maintaining, and continuously improving business-critical data and analytics solutions as well as our strongly evolving AI capabilities. The role combines daily hands-on problem solving, application ownership, service management, and participation in development initiatives both as a subject matter expert and, when needed, as a project manager for smaller projects.

What does an IT Application Owner do?

The IT Application Owner is responsible for the end-to-end management, maintenance and development of their assigned service and application portfolio. The role includes both business functionality and technical lifecycle management, ensuring the continuity, stability, and evolution of the solutions under their ownership. In addition, IT Application Owner guides and collaborates with offshore partners and other service providers, while ensuring the continuous quality, availability, continuity and development of the services.

Our IT Application owners work closely with business stakeholders, architects, development and core IT teams, and external service partners. Success in this role requires the ability to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and drive solutions into practical implementation together with various stakeholders.

The role also requires a high-level understanding of the technical environment surrounding the applications, including capacity management, networking and connectivity solutions, as well as any service-related hardware and its operational principles.

What are we looking for?

Your responsibilities will focus on new and emerging data platforms and applications that we refer to as data kiosks. These solutions are primarily built on Snowflake technology utilizing dbt (data build tool), making strong practical experience with Snowflake and a solid understanding of modern data platform architectures and operating models essential for success in this role.

The position also requires strong SQL skills, including the ability to design, develop, and utilize SQL queries for data analysis, reporting, data model interpretation, and problem solving. Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Qlik Sense, Sigma, or similar technologies is also highly valued.

Your skills and background:

- Strong experience with Snowflake and modern data platform solutions. - Good SQL skills and hands-on experience in data analysis and reporting. - Experience with reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Sigma). - The ability to manage applications, integrations, and related service ecosystems. - Strong experience working with IT vendors and offshore delivery teams. - Excellent collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills. - Project management experience is considered an advantage as well as knowledge of the retail industry.

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written in English. Proficiency in Finnish is considered a significant asset. - Relevant academic background.


The role emphasizes a willingness and ability to take initiative and work independently, develop ones own work and ways of working by utilizing new digital and intelligent solutions as part of everyday operations.

Why join us?

We offer an opportunity to work at the heart of the business with modern data and analytics solutions, and to play a key role in shaping and developing data capabilities as part of K Group's digital transformation journey.

- Youll be working on business-critical platforms and your work really matters: the input you provide can affect the daily shopping experience of our customers (and there are millions of them, by the way!).
- You have a great chance to work with the pioneer of modern grocery and wholesale trade.
- You get a broad view of the rapidly developing commerce and trade sector.
- Become part of community of expert colleagues, who are ready to support each other when you need it.

What else we offer

- For office days - modern office with several accommodations (e.g., collaboration and break areas throughout the office, gym, health care services, restaurant and cafeteria) along good connections in Kalasatama, Helsinki.
- Modern work tools and numerous opportunities to learn and network as a future professional.
- Extensive employee benefits unique to the K group. These include, among others: Culture & sport benefit (ePassi), shopping benefits that apply in K-Group stores and staff shops (K-Citymarket, K-Supermarket & K-Market, K-Rauta, Intersport, Budget Sport), own occupational health care services and leisure time accident insurance. jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.

Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

Do našeho týmu hledáme spolehlivého a manažersky zdatného kolegu či kolegyni, který/á si vezme na starosti kompletní provozní správu našich budov a areálu. Máte rádi věci v pořádku, dokážete si poradit s provozními problémy a hledáte flexibilní práci na půl úvazku? Pak hledáme právě Vás!

- Správa budov a areálu: zajištění plynulého technického chodu svěřených objektů a přilehlých prostor.

Co od Vás očekáváme:
- Technické myšlení: přehled o fungování technického zázemí budov.
- Organizační schopnosti: schopnost efektivně plánovat údržbu a koordinovat práci externích dodavatelů.
- Samostatnost a proaktivitu: schopnost samostatně vyhledávat nedostatky a navrhovat jejich řešení.
- Uživatelskou znalost PC: běžná administrativa spojená s evidencí revizí a e-mailovou komunikací.
- Dobrá komunikace.

Oceníme:
- Předchozí zkušenost na obdobné pozici (správa nemovitostí, facility management).
- Základní zručnost pro operativní vyřešení drobných závad.
- Znalost legislativy v oblasti BOZP a PO.

Nabízíme:
- Poloviční úvazek s velkou mírou flexibility v plánování pracovní doby.
- Zázemí zavedené olomoucké společnosti.
- Finanční ohodnocení od 15 000 Kč
- Práci v centru Olomouce

jobs.title: Social Media Support Specialist (NYC, Weekend Shift, Sunday to Thursday)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE SUMMARY

As a Social Media Support Specialist, you are at the forefront of helping developers create while managing our social media presence and community interactions. You'll assist developers with complex technical issues, billing inquiries, account management, and product usage questions across multiple channels including X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, Apple/Google Play stores, and other relevant platforms.

You will help bubble up what is important to Replit's engineering and Product teams, and what needs improvement to your own team, while also serving as a key voice in our social media community engagement.

We use tools like Zendesk, Sprout Social, Linear, Slack, Stripe, Orb, Notion, and Replit itself to get the job done, alongside social media management platforms for X, LinkedIn, and Reddit.

You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.

 



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets and social media accounts to solve account, billing, and product issues

 - Manage and respond to customer inquiries and community discussions on X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, and Apple/Google Play stores, with the possibility of expanding coverage to additional platforms as we grow

 - Monitor social media channels for product feedback, technical issues, and community sentiment

 - Manage escalations from social media channels and coordinate with appropriate internal teams to ensure timely resolution

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit

 - Work cross-functionally with marketing and community teams to align messaging across channels



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of social media support experience, across platforms including on X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, and Apple/Google Play stores

 - Experience with support platforms (Zendesk, Sprout Social), payment systems (Stripe, Orb), and ticketing workflows

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong written communication skills for public-facing social media interactions

 - Comfort operating with autonomy and ambiguity

 - Ability to maintain brand voice and tone all channels

 - Strong understanding of each social platform’s distinct audience and etiquette

 - Understanding of developer communities and technical terminology

 


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with community management or developer relations

 - Background in B2B SaaS customer success or support

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)

 - Experience with Replit

 


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Zendesk

 - Stripe

 - Slack

 - Orb

 - Linear

 - Sprout Social

 - Notion

 - Replit

 


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You prefer predetermined static processes

 - You need all information laid out

 - You struggle with demanding users

 - You are uncomfortable representing the companies voice publicly



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. The role has an in-office requirement of a hybrid schedule.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

jobs.title: Public Sector Strategic Account Executive, SLED - Great Lakes
AEO/GEO/SEO Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Search is being rebuilt in real time. Millions of people now start with a question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity, and the answer they get decides which products they try. When someone asks how to build an app, a website, or a tool for their business, Replit needs to be the answer.

We're hiring an AEO/GEO/SEO Lead to own how Replit gets discovered, across AI-generated answers and traditional search. This is a zero-to-one role. You'll define the strategy, then execute it yourself with AI-leveraged production, agency partners, and cross-functional teams behind you. You'll work daily with our Web, Growth, Brand, Content, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

The fastest-growing AI-native companies have already turned AI answers into a primary acquisition channel. Your mandate is to do the same for Replit: grow AI referral traffic into one of our largest sources of new builders, keep our traditional search presence compounding, and make Replit the platform AI assistants recommend when anyone wants to build software.

Replit moves fast. We ship continuously, experiment relentlessly, and aim to make every builder more productive and creative. We're looking for someone who thrives in that environment: part strategist, part operator, part scientist of a channel that changes every month.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AEO/GEO Strategy Define where Replit must show up across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, for which prompts and buyer intents, and build the playbook to win those answers. Set targets, sequence the roadmap, and defend the strategy with data.

 - Win Citations Across the Open Web LLMs cite what they trust: Reddit threads, YouTube videos, high-authority publications, community content, and well-structured owned pages. Build durable programs on each of these surfaces, understand the half-life of an AI citation, and keep Replit ranked as models retrain and retrieval systems shift.

 - Run SEO End to End Own keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content-driven organic growth in partnership with our Head of Web. Protect and grow search equity through a major site relaunch, and coordinate with our paid search team on keyword coverage.

 - Build the Content Engine Produce and direct content designed for two readers at once: LLM crawlers and humans. Blogs, comparison pages, videos, and structured resources, created at volume with AI-assisted workflows and held to a high quality bar. The durable human work here is judgment: strategy, editorial quality, and distribution.

 - Stand Up Measurement Build reporting for a channel that lacks perfect attribution: AI referral traffic, share of voice in AI answers, citation tracking, and downstream signups and revenue. Run controlled experiments, isolate what actually moves citations, and teach the rest of the company what you learn.

 - Direct Agencies and Tools Own our agency and vendor relationships across search and AI visibility, plus the tool stack that powers tracking and production. Write the briefs, hold the quality bar, and decide what stays in-house.
   



YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years in SEO, organic growth, or content-driven acquisition (ideally within SaaS, technology, or developer-focused businesses), including hands-on AEO/GEO work within the last year

 - Can show real results: AI referral traffic you grew, citations you won, rankings you moved, and how you measured all of it

 - Are technically fluent in SEO: keyword research, crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture, and log analysis

 - Understand how LLMs actually retrieve and cite sources, and how that differs across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

 - Write clearly and quickly, and can direct people, agencies, and AI tools to produce content that earns citations

 - Are analytical enough to build credible measurement in a messy, fast-changing channel, connecting organic visibility to traffic, signups, product adoption, and revenue

 - Are comfortable partnering with engineering, product, content, and analytics stakeholders to get changes shipped in a fast-moving environment

 - Love building from scratch: frameworks, processes, and strategy

 - Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, and don't wait for someone else to define the playbook

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach and willingness to dig into the details
   



BONUS POINTS:

 - Made AI answers a primary acquisition channel at a PLG, consumer, or developer-facing software company

 - Deep Reddit fluency: you understand how communities work and how to earn credible presence there

 - Experience running YouTube as an organic discovery channel

 - Hands-on with AI visibility and citation tracking tools (Profound, Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or similar)

 - Programmatic SEO at meaningful scale

 - You've built with Replit or other AI building tools and understand our builders firsthand

 - Experience directing SEO/AEO agencies and fractional specialists

jobs.title: Field Technician III
jobs.description:
Overview


Responsible for day-to-day SRO completion, downstream and upstream SNR maintenance and repair, troubleshooting and repair of all aspects of the HFC network from the node to the end of line, HFC (Hybrid Fibre Coaxial) node activation. RF alignment, node power supply troubleshooting, Outside Plant Construction (consisting of Aerial and Underground infrastructure), including new builds to support HFC plant extensions, FTTH Developments and Commercial Installations, installation and activation of new Outside Plant passive and active devices, construction of underground chambers inclusive of underground enclosures. This role also supports the requirements for mean time to repair Outside Plant faults/outages on the HFC and fibre transmission network.


Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot, locate, and rectify reports of system deficiencies on the HFC Network.
  • Recognize, troubleshoot, and repair ingress/egress events which are adversely affecting node SNR performance to meet Outside Plant KPIâs.
  • Ensure overall system performance and picture quality by maintaining nodes and distribution amplifiers, passive devices in accordance with design specifications.
  • Perform quality control tests and checks in the HFC Network.
  • Replace defective Outside Plant, Network equipment that contributes to RF degradation in the HFC Network.
  • Activate and align HFC network equipment, including distribution active devices.
  • Read, understand, and interpret fibre designs.
  • Timely troubleshooting of service impacting, HFC Network outages to meet Outside Plant Reliability KPIâs.
  • Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance at work.
  • Operate company vehicles in a safe and responsible manner.
  • Communicate with NOC Support and all relevant personnel in a timely manner, during Network restoration activity.
  • Timely completion of construction activity and daily assigned tasks.
  • Timely completion of Outside Plant commercial installation construction requirements.
  • Timely completion of construction repairs and requirements for restorations to the fibre network.
  • Timely completion of construction repairs and requirements for restorations of the Aliv fibre transmission network.
  • Respond to utility pole transfers or relocation requests.
  • Oversee and maintain contractor relations to ensure the timely completion of projects.
  • Provide Support to Network Design Team for RFP site survey details as well as any new additions or changes to the Outside Plant.
  • Work in conjunction with other utility Companies and private contractors for coordination of request requirements (to include, but not limited to utility locate requests).
  • Ensure all OSP construction activity is of high quality and meets installation guidelines.
  • Be responsive and professional in addressing escalated customer service issues.
  • Coordinate the availability of as-built aerial construction designs upon completion of network buildouts for new trunk, distribution, and service drop layouts.
  • Maintain all company assigned assets (inclusive of but not limited to test equipment, tablets and specialized tools).
  • Participate in Department training initiatives and requirements.
  • Submit purchase order requisitions and return of receipts for vendor invoices.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays as necessary.
  • Ability to travel to inter Family Islands to complete/respond to Engineering work requirements.
  • Properly maintain company assigned vehicle interior/exterior and assigned test equipment.
  • Operate company vehicles in a safe and responsible manner. Adhere to all company safety policies.
  • Communicate with upper Management on all relevant reporting requirements in a timely manner.
  • Participate in the On Call rotation schedule.
  • Adhere to Cable Bahamas Health & Safety policies, processes, and procedures.
  • Perform any other related duties associated with the daily functions of the Engineering Department as assigned by Management.


Qualifications


  • Up to a minimum of 5 yearsâ experience in the cable industry with knowledge of Outside Plant Operations (inclusive of but not limited to, Installation, Service, Construction, Preventative Maintenance of a HFC Network and fibre network topology.
  • Minimum of an Associate Degree or Certification in Construction, HFC or Fiber.
  • Must have a basic knowledge of Microsoft application.
  • Good communication and organizational skills .
  • Ability to consistently display a high level of both internal and external customer service and interpersonal competencies.
  • Must exhibit the ability to function independently in a safe, efficient manner and assume increased responsibilities as necessary to drive improved NPS .
  • Must have physical dexterity for pole climbing and working in all weather conditions.
  • Acceptable physical condition to enable crawling, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, pulling, pushing, grasping, climbing, lifting 75 pounds, working with general hand tools and a 32-foot ladder.
  • Willingness to learn about all aspects of business.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays as necessary.
  • Ability to travel to inter Family Islands to complete/respond to Engineering work requirements .
  • Participate in the On Call rotation schedule.
  • NCTI training or similar accreditation in Engineering/Electronics is an asset
  • A valid driverâs license and acceptable driving record.
  • A positive and professional manner and appearance are essential.

Zakres obowiązków: Zakres obowiązków:
1.Prowadzenie spotkań mediacyjnych: Organizowanie i moderowanie bezpiecznych rozmów między uczestnikami konfliktu w siedzibie CUS lub poza nią.
2.Diagnoza i kontakt: Wstępny kontakt ze stronami, ocena sytuacji oraz motywowanie ich do podjęcia dialogu.
3.Pilnowanie zasad: Przestrzeganie fundamentalnych reguł mediacji, takich jak dobrowolność, poufność, neutralność i bezstronność.
4.Spisywanie ustaleń: Pomoc w sformułowaniu ostatecznej ugody lub protokołu z przebiegu spotkań.
5.Współpraca z innymi specjalistami: Działanie w zespole CUS (np. z psychologami, pracownikami socjalnymi, prawnikami lub terapeutami).
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wymagania niezbędne:
1.Wykształcenie wyższe (psychologiczne, pedagogiczne, socjologiczne lub prawnicze). Ukończone specjalistyczne szkolenia lub studia podyplomowe z zakresu mediacji (ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem mediacji rodzinnych). Wpis na listę stałych mediatorów lub certyfikat organizacji mediacyjnych (mile widziany);
2.Obywatelstwo polskie;
3.Pełna zdolność do czynności prawnych;
4.Pełna władza rodzicielska (osoba nie jest i nie była pozbawiona władzy rodzicielskiej oraz władza rodzicielska nie jest jej zawieszona ani ograniczona);
5.Wypełnia obowiązek alimentacyjny  w przypadku, gdy taki obowiązek wynika z tytułu egzekucyjnego;
6.Niekaralność prawomocnym wyrokiem sądu za umyślne przestępstwo ścigane z oskarżenia publicznego lub umyślne przestępstwo skarbowe;
7.Nieposzlakowana opinia.
    
Wymagania dodatkowe:
1.Predyspozycje osobowościowe: odpowiedzialność, zaangażowanie, łatwość nawiązywania kontaktów, konsekwencja w działaniu.
2.Umiejętność zachowania bezstronności, empatii, odporność na stres i opanowanie
w sytuacjach kryzysowych.
3.Dyspozycyjność.
4.Wysoka kultura osobista.

b)list motywacyjny,

jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

Apply Now

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst – Audit (m/f)
jobs.description:
Cyber Security Analyst – Audit

Luxembourg OR Amsterdam, Netherlands
Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm OR 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
Hybrid

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst – Audit to support and enhance the organization's security posture across multiple jurisdictions. This role is responsible for executing audit activities, strengthening compliance frameworks, and aligning security strategies across both legacy and modern technology environments. The candidate will work closely with audit partners and internal stakeholders to ensure adherence to audit and regulatory requirements and continuous improvement of security assurance practices.

The ideal candidate has at least four years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, risk management, or compliance. This role ensures adherence to global regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR, ISO), evaluates control effectiveness, and serves as a primary liaison for auditors. The role requires strong risk assessment capabilities, proactive issue resolution, and a balanced focus on compliance and enterprise resilience in tandem with security leadership.

Some of the things that you will be doing:

• Partner with global teams across business operations, compliance, IT, and legal to manage technology risk and regulatory compliance.
• Plan and execute internal, external, and jurisdictional audits in line with the audit roadmap.
• Develop and enhance security policies, standards, procedures, and compliance frameworks.
• Improve IT compliance processes and identify automation opportunities for control activities.
• Design and execute control testing strategies and ensure proper evidence documentation.
• Maintain and enhance control frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards.
• Conduct IT risk assessments and track remediation of identified gaps.
• Coordinate with auditors, regulators, and stakeholders during audit cycles.
• Track and report compliance metrics and program effectiveness indicators.
• Leverage GRC tools for audit management, evidence tracking, and reporting.
• Identify risks and vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
• Manage third-party/vendor risk assessments and escalations.
• Respond to regulatory and jurisdictional audit requests.
• Provide actionable insights and reporting to security leadership.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• 4+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, or cybersecurity.
• Strong knowledge of Global regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, ISO, DORA PCI, PSD2 and NIST.
• Familiarity with audit standards and frameworks (SOC 1 & 2, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, COBIT).
• Understanding of cybersecurity threat landscape and control environments.
• Knowledge of modern technologies including cloud, DevOps, application security, and AI.
• Experience working with/ customizing GRC tools (e.g., Archer, OneTrust, AuditBoard, Diligent).
• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive approach towards available work requests and timely response.
• Ability to translate technical risks into business insights.
• Hands-on experience in IT disciplines and audit execution.
• Experience in global and multi-regulatory environments.
• Ability to manage complex compliance requirements across jurisdictions.
• Strong organizational and proactive risk management skills.
• High integrity, accountability, and professional excellence.
• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CIA, or other relevant cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications.

jobs.title: HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


CDD, full-time, ref: [HTIPC26]
Service: National Business Relationship Management
Hierarchical Superior: Director, Business Relationship Management



About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.

Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.


Job mission:


Department description:

The Business Relationship Management division builds and maintains strategic relationships with Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. Within this division, the HealthTech team supports the development and competitiveness of Luxembourg's health technologies sector — spanning medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation — by connecting companies to relevant programmes, research organisations and European initiatives.


Job description:

As a HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator, you will drive the operational management and strategic coordination of healthtech-related projects at national and European level. You will coordinate the activities of the HealthTech team members, ensuring that project milestones are delivered on time and within budget, while fostering collaboration between internal colleagues, consortium partners, research organisations and Luxembourg-based companies across the health technologies value chain.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.


Main tasks and responsibilities:

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:


Inspire:

Monitor technological, regulatory and market developments across the healthtech landscape (medtech, digital health, biotech, pharma) and translate insights into actionable opportunities for the ecosystem
Contribute to the design and implementation of Luxinnovation's HealthTech strategy and annual work programme, aligned with national health innovation priorities
Represent Luxinnovation in healthtech-related fora, conferences and working groups at national and European level
Promote Luxembourg's healthtech ecosystem and its competitive advantages to international partners and stakeholders


Assess & Accelerate:

Manage the operational delivery of healthtech innovation projects, ensuring alignment with consortium work plans, KPIs and budgets
Coordinate the contributions of the HealthTech team members across active projects, ensuring clarity of roles, coherent planning and timely delivery of individual and collective workstreams
Track project progress through regular reporting (CRM, European project management systems), flag risks and propose corrective actions
Identify companies' innovation needs within the healthtech sector and assess their potential to participate in collaborative R&D projects
Support companies in navigating regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (e.g., EU Medical Device Regulation, European Health Data Space)


Connect:

Serve as the central coordination point within the HealthTech team, facilitating information flow, aligning priorities and ensuring synergies between team members' respective activities and project portfolios
Coordinate with consortium partners, research organisations and institutional stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution and knowledge exchange
Facilitate matchmaking between Luxembourg healthtech companies and international partners for collaborative innovation projects
Act as an internal interface, connecting healthtech project activities with other Luxinnovation services (funding, market intelligence, digitalisation)
Develop and maintain professional relationships across the national and European healthtech ecosystem


Fund:

Support Luxembourg companies in accessing European healthtech funding programmes (Horizon Europe Health Cluster, EIT Health, Innovative Health Initiative, Digital Europe Programme)
Ensure compliant budget tracking, timesheet management and financial reporting for all projects under your coordination
Identify synergies between national RDI funding instruments and European healthtech calls to maximise funding opportunities for ecosystem actors
Contribute to the preparation and submission of new collaborative project proposals in the healthtech domain


This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.


Required competencies:

Education level and professional experience required:

University degree at Master's level (Bac+4/5) in life sciences, biomedical engineering, health economics, public health, business management or equivalent
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in project coordination or management within the healthtech, life sciences or health innovation sector
Proven experience managing multi-partner collaborative projects (national or European)
Experience coordinating small cross-functional teams or workgroups
Knowledge of European R&D programme structures (Horizon Europe, EIT Health, IHI) is a strong asset
Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA) is desirable


Specific competencies:

Solid understanding of the health technologies landscape, including medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation
Proven ability to manage complex project portfolios with multiple workstreams, partners and deadlines
Strong team coordination skills, with the ability to align diverse contributors around shared objectives and delivery timelines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical health innovation challenges into structured project plans
Excellent stakeholder engagement and diplomatic skills across institutional, academic and private-sector actors
Knowledge of Luxembourg's socio-economic environment and health innovation ecosystem is an asset
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (EU MDR, IVDR, European Health Data Space) is an advantage


Languages:

Fluent English and French are mandatory (oral and written, minimum C1 level)
German and/or Luxembourgish is considered an asset


IT Skills:

MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and MS Project or equivalent
CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics)
European project management platforms (e.g., EC Funding & Tenders Portal, JEMS)
Knowledge of collaboration and reporting tools (Teams, SharePoint)


Why choose this position?

This role places you at the intersection of health innovation, European R&D policy and team leadership. You will coordinate a dedicated team of healthtech specialists while managing high-impact projects that accelerate the adoption of health technologies in Luxembourg. Join a collaborative environment where your expertise in project coordination and your passion for healthtech will contribute directly to strengthening Luxembourg's position as a competitive player in the European health innovation landscape.


Application:

Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us! [...]

Network Relationship Manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU

Your area of work:

Within Clearstream, Global Markets – Network Management is responsible for managing Clearstream's worldwide network of financial market infrastructures and service providers, including central securities depositories, custodian banks, cash correspondent banks, and trading venues.
The main responsibilities of Network Management are to select, develop and monitor the global network of third-party service providers for settlement, custody and cash correspondent banking services. The work includes notably the continuous assessment of the levels of service, competitiveness and the associated risks of those markets where Clearstream operates a link. Network Management also ensures at all times compliance with Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse's policies and procedures and their regulatory requirements applicable to the management of its market links and agent bank network.

The Network Management Office (NMO) is a transversal control, coordination and governance function that supports and oversees the Network Management teams globally. Its mandate is not market ownership, but process integrity, consistency, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience across the entire Network Management function. This is a cross functional role combining governance, process management, regulatory awareness, audit coordination, and stakeholder interaction.

Your responsibilities:

• Establishing and monitoring the contractual relationships with Clearstream's third party providers, from leading the RFIs/RFPs to concluding contracts
• Reviewing and negotiating fee schedules, taking into account the market specifics and competition
• Monitoring compliance with all applicable market and regulatory requirements
• Monitoring adherence to operational service levels, from a contractual and competitive standpoint
• Sourcing and communicating all information about allocated markets in a timely and relevant fashion, for all stakeholders
• Performing on-site due diligence visits (a few business trips per year may be necessary)
• Maintaining the evaluation of the market requirements and their risk assessments
• Representing and advocating for Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse in forums and in the interactions with all layers of the markets: participants, regulators, infrastructures, etc.
• Business analysis of Settlement and Custody related products
• Cross-departmental coordination of market developments/projects
• Governance & Oversight: providing a centralised governance and control over the above-mentioned Network Management activities to ensure execution of the Network Management Procedure, acting as a control and coordination layer between regional Network Management teams and other internal stakeholders (audit, compliance, etc)
• Procedures & Regulatory Alignment: responsible for the administration, maintenance and consistency of Network Management procedures that are filed with Clearstream's regulators, coordinating annual and adhoc updates and ensuring the audit and regulatory requirements are correctly documented.
• Audit & Assurance Support: act as the central audit interface for Network Management, coordinating external and internal audit requests and ensuring evidence, documentation and controls are consistently available.
• Process Coordinationg & Steering: organise and coordinate Network Management Steering Committees in order to facilitate internal alignment on processes, controls and priorities, supporting the escalation and alignment of transversal issues affecting the Network Management team as a whole
• Systems & Data Governance: supporting the consistent usage of the Network Management system (DigiNet) plus other systems and tools available to the team, to ensure quality data standards and disciplined documentation storage practices.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree, post-graduate degree or MBA, in economics / finance or equivalent
• 3-5 years of securities services experience or any equivalent financial enviornment
• Background in governance, operational risk, compliance, audit coordination, or process management
• Experience working with cross border or distributed teams is an advantage
• Strong organisational and coordination skills
• High attention to detail and structured working style
• Ability to understand complex processes and translate them into clear frameworks

• Confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and control functions

• Ability to set and prioritize objectives, to contribute to the wider departmental and organisational objectives, to proactively source, interact or develop talent, collaborate with the team and across the company. Able to work independently, be a team player, and offer up effective recommendations to management or counterparts.

jobs.description:
Wir sind...

die „Offenen Hilfen" die Anlaufstelle der Caritas für Menschen mit geistiger und / oder körperlicher Behinderung, mit chronischen Erkrankungen und Personen, die von Behinderung bedroht sind. Auch Eltern, Angehörige und Bezugspersonen finden bei uns Beratung und Unterstützung. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen mit Behinderung eine selbstbestimmte und selbstständige Lebensführung zu ermöglichen und die Teilhabe an der Gesellschaft zu fördern.

Im Ambulant Begleitenten Wohnen (ABW) unterstützten wir Menschen mit Behinderung im privaten Umfeld in der eigenen Wohnung oder begleiten diese bei Terminen und Veranstaltungen.

Hier finden Sie weitere Informationen zu unseren Angeboten:
https://www.offene-hilfen-caritas-muenchen.de/de

Informationen zur Stelle:

Stellenumfang: Teilzeit (10 Stunden)
Vertragsart: Befristet mit Option auf Übernahme
Beginn: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
Stellen-ID: 36660
Eingruppierung: Caritas AVR Anlage 02, 10 bis 10 - zum AVR Rechner
Arbeitsort: Caritas Offenen Hilfen München - Ambulant Begleitetes Wohnen, Hansastraße 134, 81373 München

Sie sind verantwortlich für...

- die Förderung einer selbständigen Lebensführung festen Klienten/-innen (z.B. Hilfe der Fachkräfte bei Alltagsstrukturierung, Umgang mit Geld, Begleitungen bei Behördenangelegenheiten)
- die Hilfestellung bei der gleichberechtigten Teilhabe am Leben in der Gemeinschaft (z.B. Begleitung von passenden Freizeitaktivitäten)
- die Gespräche mit ihren Klienten/-innen zu deren Selbst Reflektion
- die Dokumentation der durchgeführten Termine
- die Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen
- die zuverlässige Absprachen mit den Fachkräften

Wir freuen uns auf Sie, weil Sie...

- über pädagogische Grundkenntnisse verfügen
- eine positive und respektvolle Haltung gegenüber Menschen mit Behinderung und deren Angehörigen haben
- die Selbständigkeit von Menschen mit Beeinträchtigungen in deren eigenen Wohnung unterstützen und fördern möchten
- bereit sind, Inklusion und Teilhabe an der Gesellschaft mitzugestalten
- zeitliche Flexibilität (Arbeitszeiten auch am Abend) mitbringen und gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeiten wollen
- teamfähig sind und kollegiales Handeln wertschätzen
- im Idealfall über Erfahrung in der Behindertenhilfe oder im Ambulant Begleiteten Wohnen verfügen
- sich mit den Zielen und Werten der Caritas identifizieren und die Bereitschaft zeigen, diese im Berufsalltag umzusetzen und zu leben

Bei uns erwartet Sie...

- ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld in einem kollegialen Team
- eine attraktive AVR-Vergütung (angelehnt an den TVöD) mit regelmäßigen Gehaltserhöhungen durch Stufenaufstiege und Tariferhöhungen
- eine Jahressonderzahlung (Weihnachtszuwendung) pro Jahr
- 30 Tage Jahresurlaub (bei einer 5-Tage-Woche) und ein zusätzlicher freier AVR-Tag /Jahr
- zusätzlich 2 arbeitgeberfinanzierte dienstfreie Tage am 24.12. und 31.12. unter Berücksichtigung der Einsatzzeiten
- überdurchschnittliche Sozialleistungen wie arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Krankenzusatzversicherung und Vermögenswirksame Leistungen
- die bezahlte Freistellung von der Tätigkeit in der Einrichtung zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung für bis zu 5 Tagen für Fortbildungen/Zusatzqualifikationen und bis zu 3 Tagen zur Besinnung durch unser verbandseigenes Institut für Bildung und Entwicklung
- ein Zuschuss zur Nutzung des Deutschlandticket-Job (DB) und die Möglichkeit ein Business Bike zu leasen
- ein breites Angebot an Vergünstigungen bei Benefits.me
- Gesundheitsförderung durch betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
- ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz bei einem großen Träger mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten 
- eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe, bei der sich Familie und Beruf gut miteinander vereinbaren lassen

- weitere Arbeitgeber-Leistungen und Benefits, die Sie hier finden

jobs.title: Production Compliance Coordinator (m/f/d) (Bürokaufmann/-frau)

-------------------------------

AqVida is a German pharmaceutical company specializing in the development, approval, manufacture and distribution of oncology products. Our portfolio includes key generic medicines used to treat the most common forms of cancer.

Our customers are located worldwide, while our two sites are in Northern Germany: our administration and headquarters have been based in Hamburg since 2005, and our modern production facility in Dassow, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, opened in 2016.

We are looking for a Production Compliance Coordinator (m/f/d) to join our Hamburg site as soon as possible. - Prepare and update Excel trackers, tables, reports and status documents

- Follow up on open points, deadlines, questions and task lists
- Support preparation for audits, customer visits and internal or external information requests as well as preparation of presentations, summaries and decision-support documents for stakeholders
- Use Microsoft 365 tools and AI-supported working methods to improve transparency, consistency and efficiency in documentation and coordination
- Collaborate closely with Production, Quality Management, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain and other relevant functions

Your profile:

- University background or current university studies or relevant work experience
- Very good English skills (C1); German is a plus but not required
- Enjoy working carefully with documents, lists and structured information
- Confident with MS365: Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams and PowerPoint
- Able to keep track of tasks, deadlines and open questions as well as reliable, structured and comfortable communicating with different internal teams
- Open to using digital tools and AI-supported working methods responsibly
- Willing to ask questions when information is missing

What we offer:

- Work in a future-proof industry and a stable company
- A responsible coordination role in an international pharmaceutical environment
- An open, practical and hands-on working culture with short communication lines and flexible working hours
- 30 days of annual leave
- Bonus payments
- Company pension scheme
- Contribution towards the Deutschland-Ticket and corporate fitness membership (Wellpass)
- A diverse team with more than 20 nationalities, where you will quickly feel welcome

The starting salary ranges from EUR 3,200 to EUR 3,700 gross per month, depending on education, experience and the related level of responsibility.

Good to know: although this parental leave cover is initially fixed for 24 months, an extension may be possible.

If this opportunity appeals to you and you enjoy a fast, direct way of working in an unconventional pharmaceutical company, please send your CV, references and potential start date as one PDF file of no more than 3 MB to bewerbung@aqvida.com (https://mailto:bewerbung@aqvida.com) . ESTAruppin e.V. ist ein regionaler diakonischer Träger mit einem vielfältigen Aufgabenspektrum (siehe www.estaruppin.de). Wir führen an mehreren Orten im Landkreis Ostprignitz-Ruppin Beratung und Projekte mit dem Ziel durch, die gesellschaftliche Teilhabe und Integration von Zugewanderten mit Migrations- und Fluchtgeschichte zu fördern.

Im Landkreis Ostprignitz-Ruppin bestehen Anlaufstellen, in denen eingehend beraten bzw. im Case Management unterstützt wird. Sprachcafés verbessern die Konversationsfähigkeit, Infoveranstaltungen und Kurse erhöhen die individuelle Kompetenz, Betriebsbesichtigungen und der begleitete Kontakt zu Arbeitgeber*innen eröffnen Wege in Ausbildung und Beschäftigung. Institutionen arbeiten zur Sensibilisierung von Mitarbeitenden und Effektivierung von Maßnahmen zusammen.

Ihre Aufgaben im Projekt sind:

- kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Beratung und Begleitung geflüchteter Menschen auf dem Weg in eine Ausbildung oder Beschäftigung, im Case Management entlang eines Meilensteinsystems.
- Planung und Durchführung von Betriebsbesichtigungen; Begleitung bei Job- und Ausbildungsmessen sowie Vor- und Nachbereitung von Bewerbungen.
- Planung und Durchführung von Workshops, Infoveranstaltungen und Sprachcafés.
- Zusammenarbeit mit den unterschiedlichen Institutionen in der Flucht- und Migrationsberatung, dem Jobcenter, Arbeitgeber*innen und weiteren Akteuren im Landkreis
- Teilnehmenden-Dokumentation

- ein interdisziplinäres Team in einer innovativen Organisation.

jobs.title: Technik. Kunden. Verantwortung. Und ein Team, auf das du dich verlassen kannst. (IT-System-Elektroniker/in)
jobs.description:
Du suchst keinen Job, bei dem du morgens deinen Rechner einschaltest und abends einfach wieder ausmachst?

Du willst Technik nicht nur installieren, sondern verstehen, Probleme lösen und beim Kunden wirklich etwas bewegen?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

OrgaMAXX.IT GmbH ist ein wachsendes IT-Systemhaus mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden. Wir kümmern uns um die IT-, Druck- und Kopiersysteme unserer Kunden in der Region – und sorgen dafür, dass deren Technik einfach funktioniert.

Unser Motto:

„Wir kümmern uns um Ihre IT, damit Sie sich auf Ihr Unternehmen konzentrieren können.“

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen

IT-Systemelektroniker (m/w/d)

Arbeitsort: Neuhofen

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Bei uns bist du nicht nur „der Techniker“. Du bist Ansprechpartner, Problemlöser, Tüftler und manchmal auch derjenige, der aus einem scheinbar unlösbaren Technikproblem doch noch eine Lösung zaubert.

Deine Aufgaben sind abwechslungsreich und führen dich sowohl in unsere Werkstatt als auch direkt zu unseren Kunden:

- Installation, Wartung, Fehleranalyse und Instandsetzung von Multifunktions- und Drucksystemen
- Technischer Support bei unseren Kunden – vor Ort und remote
- Installation und Einrichtung von Hardware, Software, Komponenten und Zubehör
- Einweisung unserer Kunden in neue Systeme und Lösungen
- Installation und Betreuung von Druck- und Flottenmanagement-Lösungen
- Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen
- Unterstützung unseres First-Level-Supports
- Technische Beratung unserer Kunden und Kollegen
- Zusammenarbeit mit nahezu allen Bereichen unseres Unternehmens

Kurz gesagt: Kein Tag ist wie der andere.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Du musst bei uns nicht alles können. Aber du solltest Lust darauf haben, Dinge zu verstehen, Probleme anzupacken und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum IT-Systemelektroniker (m/w/d), Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung im technischen IT-Umfeld ist wünschenswert

jobs.title: Staff Product Analyst, Vendor Growth (Product-Lifecycle-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Staff Product Analyst (Vendor Growth) to join our Product Analytics team and drive data strategy for our Vendor Growth business management line. In this role, you will move beyond simple reporting to shape the future of our product through rigorous hypothesis testing and by converting massive datasets into high-impact strategic narratives.

In our Vendor Growth Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that empower restaurant partners to operate independently and at scale. Your work will directly improve experiences for vendors and their customers across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize partner operations, support partner autonomy, and strengthen vendor relationships.

As a Staff Analyst, you will champion a core strategic initiative focused on improving partner autonomy and operational efficiency. You will lead analysis and initiatives that help us better understand partner behavior, optimize vendor-facing experiences, and identify opportunities to reduce dependency on support channels. Your work will contribute to improved partner satisfaction, lower operational costs, and more scalable business processes.

You will operate across the product line, partnering with leaders in Product, Tech, Operations and Data to define the strategic direction of analytics for the entire Vendor Growth business. This is your opportunity to leverage deep technical expertise to champion innovation and influence how Delivery Hero empowers vendors at scale.

Strategic Leadership & Product Influence:

- Define the North Star: Develop and refine product metrics and leading indicators that accurately reflect vendor health, partner satisfaction, and business viability. Establish VSSR and related self-service metrics as key performance indicators.
- Influence Roadmap: Use quantitative analysis to look beyond the numbers, providing insights that empower Product Managers and Engineers to decide what to build and why. Provide data-driven recommendations on partner behavior and feature adoption.
- Drive Experimentation: Guide the team on methodology, design, interpretation, and decision-making of A/B tests. Champion vendor-facing experiments to validate self-service feature improvements and operational optimizations.

Technical Excellence & Scalability:

- Build for Scale: Drive the development of scalable analytics infrastructure and self-service capabilities, ensuring data quality and accessibility across the organization.
- Advanced Modeling: Collaborate on vendor behavior analysis and predictive models to understand adoption barriers and optimize feature rollout strategies.

Mentorship & Culture:

- Elevate the Team: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other analysts, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing, rigorous peer review, and technical excellence.
- Evangelize Data: Act as a quality gatekeeper and champion a data-driven mindset across the Product and Tech teams.

Qualifications

** Qualifications**

- 6+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Scientist, or similar role, preferably within fast-paced tech environments or marketplaces.
- Deep understanding of A/B test design and edge cases, causal inference, and statistical analysis.
- High level experience in SQL skills with practical experience on large-scale data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake), solid Python skills for complex analytics, automation, and data visualisation.
- Proven ability to design, build, and optimize data pipelines. You take ownership of data curation to ensure that all business decisions are based on a foundation of reliable, high-quality data, and proven track record of building actionable data-stories and dashboards (Tableau, Looker, or similar) that drive business decisions.
- Demonstrated experience mentoring junior analysts and leading high-impact projects with autonomy. You can influence stakeholders without formal authority.

Nice to have:

- Experience with vendor/partner-centric products.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.
