jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Trustworthy GenAI-assisted Software Engineering
jobs.description:
The Department of Computer science, Electrical engineering and Mathematical sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL) has an open position as a post-doctoral researcher within trustworthy GenAI-assisted software engineering.

The position is for a period of up to 3 years and associated with the strategically funded TERSE project.

Workplace is campus Bergen.
 

Project and duties of the position
The TERSE project aims to develop actionable methods, guidelines and software tools for enhancing
software engineering with the application of GenAI; and to explore how profession-oriented education and
curricula in software engineering should be transformed in light the emerging GenAI era. A central element
of the project is collaboration with industry, public sector institutions and international partners aimed to
investigate the real-world effects of GenAI in software engineering.


Software technology and engineering are key enablers in the ongoing digital transformation of society.
GenAI has emerged as a disruptive technology not only within a multitude of sectors profoundly impacting
the way we will work in the future, but also within the profession of software engineering itself where code
is increasingly being automatically produced by GenAI-based coding co-pilots and agents. Considering the
pivotal and increasingly critical role of software in society, the prospect of such a disruptive change raises
fundamental questions on the feasibility and risks associated with the application of GenAI, and on how the
future profession of software engineers will change.


The postdoctoral researcher will work closely with the four work package leaders of the TERSE project on
coordinated industry collaboration enabling longitudinal and empirical studies of GenAI, and on developing
and evaluating methods and software technology to detect, prevent, and mitigate faults in GenAI-generated
software. Key research questions to be addressed include: what measurable productivity and software
quality effects occur when applying GenAI in software engineering processes; how to develop and apply
software engineering tools which make AI-assisted development dependable; what are best practices and
methodology for trustworthy application of GenAI-based software tools and technology; and how to
integrate GenAI in software engineering education.


Research environment

The postdoctoral researcher will be a key researcher in the TERSE project and part of the software engineering research group at HVL https://www.hvl.no/en/research/group/software-engineering/ . The  research group currently include 10 professors and associate professors, 12 postdoctoral  researchers and PhD candidates, and a large number of master students in software engineering and 
in applied computer science. The software engineering research group is conducting high-quality  research presented at international venues, and has broad scientific expertise including empirical  software engineering, model- based software engineering, and formal methods for software  engineering. The research group has a strong track record of externally funded projects with  national and international industry and with academic partners. This includes projects within cloud  computing and services, internet-of-things, business process modelling, AI, machine learning,  collaborative systems, and security spanning domains such as healthcare services, marine  environments, robotics, industrial automation and emergency work. The postdoctoral research fellow will be provided with work expense funding that can be used forconference participation, travel and research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is 
Campus Bergen.
 


Qualifications

The successful applicant must have earned a PhD degree in informatics/computer science/software engineering or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded before the candidate can be offered the position. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within software engineering, and preferably include the application of generative AI and machine learning in software engineering or software engineering for AI. In addition to the required educational background and scientific profile, the following criteria will be assessed in the ranking of qualified candidates:

  • Quality and relevance of the PhD thesis
  • Publication and project acquisition track record, quality and relevance of publications
  • Practical software engineering skills, including experience with generative AI in software development or the engineering of software for AI solutions
  • Research network, industrial work experience and/or experience from industrial collaboration
  • Ability to work in the intersection of theoretical, applied, and empirical research
  • Teaching experience and interest in curriculum development in software engineering education
  • Ability to collaborate, engage in writing funding applications, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research work, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Dissemination capacity, oral and written communication skills in English (or in Norwegian) 

 

The application must include the following:

  • Cover letter, including a statement of motivation, description of relevance of research profile in relation to the position and summary of scientific work and industry experience
  • A CV, including publication list,
  • Up to five selected publications
  • Copies of educational certificates, transcript of academic records
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number) 

Applicants will in addition be assessed in relation to their prospective starting date.

 

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. If the documents submitted are not in English or in a Scandinavian language, the applicants must submit the corresponding certified translations.

 


Application procedure

Submit your application and CV by clicking on the button marked "søk stillingen" on this page.

Please note that applications will be assessed based on the information submitted to www.jobbnorge.no by the application deadline. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all relevant attachments are submitted by the deadline, including: 

Applicants with a degree from a country other than Norway, need to attach a certified translation of the diploma and transcripts of grades to English or a Scandinavian language, in addition to the original documents, if the original is not in any of these languages. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

Applications will be sent electronically to an expert committee. Based on the committee's recommendation, suitable applicants will be invited for an interview.

Applications cannot be sent by email to individuals at HVL.


We offer

Exciting and stimulating work as part of a strong international academic environment
An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues
Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
Employee benefits

The position as  postdoctoral researche is paid according to the Government's salary regulation, in position code 1352.
There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no/en for more information). The successful applicant must
comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time..


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte”). Organizationalchanges and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.
 

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.
Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. 

The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected. Applicants may be called in for an interview... 


Contact

Assistant Head of Department Pål Ellingsen

E-mail: pal.ellingsen@hvl.no


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

Homepage


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.

The Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences offers a wide range of courses both at undergraduate and graduate levels in:
Engineering and Natural sciences Economic and Administrative sciences Maritime sciences Social sciences and Humanities. The Faculty is
also responsible for PhD programmes in computer technology, innovation and regional development and in nautical operations.


 

 The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences has a strong academic and research environment, offering programmes at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels. The department has around 1,100 students and more than 120 staff members, and plays a key role in advancing technologies for digitalisation and the green transition.

We offer education across our campuses in Førde, Bergen and Haugesund, with six study programmes in computer science and electrical engineering, and teaching contributions in mathematics, statistics and physics.

The department hosts active research groups in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, human-computer interaction and sensor networks, and collaborates closely with industry and public sector partners

jobs.title: Airport Service Supervisor (Rovaniemi)
jobs.description:
_Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values – Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together–guide us in everything we do._

**We are now looking for an**

**AIRPORT SERVICE SUPERVISOR**

to join our Ground Operations Service Delivery team. Based in Rovaniemi, you will support operations at one of Finnair's most strategically important stations and contribute to the safe and reliable delivery of services across our growing Lapland operation. In addition, the position supports selected North Calotte airports in Northern Finland and Norway when required.

In this role, you will act as Finnair's local representative towards ground handlers, airport operators and other operational stakeholders. You will oversee operational performance, safety, quality and compliance of ground handling services delivered on behalf of Finnair, ensuring adherence to agreed standards, processes and regulatory requirements.

This is a highly visible operational role focused on safety oversight, service quality, compliance and stakeholder cooperation in one of the most strategically significant areas of Finnair's network.

This role is based in Rovaniemi and requires continuous onsite presence at Rovaniemi airport. Work is performed during regular office hours and includes occasional travel.

**Your main responsibilities will focus on operational oversight, performance follow-up and stakeholder collaboration, including:**

- Monitoring ground handler performance, operational quality, safety performance, safety observations and training compliance at Rovaniemi and selected North Calotte airports.

- Following up local operational deviations and supporting corrective actions.

- Conducting regular operational oversight activities with particular focus on safety culture, regulatory compliance, operational risk identification and continuous improvement.

- Supporting the implementation of Finnair operational development initiatives and process improvements, while monitoring their effectiveness and compliance at station level.

- Supporting operational coordination during irregular operations and seasonal peak periods.

- Maintaining effective cooperation with ground handlers, airport operators, authorities and other local stakeholders.

- Performing operational reporting, invoice verification, administrative follow-up and quality monitoring activities.

- Supporting monthly performance and quality reporting processes.

- Promoting compliance with applicable safety, security and operational requirements.

- Escalating significant operational, safety or compliance concerns through established Finnair processes.


**What we are looking for:**

- A bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant field.

- At least three years of experience in airline operations, airport operations, airport services or ground handling.

- Experience in operational supervision, coordination, quality monitoring or vendor/stakeholder management.

- Strong understanding of airport and ground handling operations, including both passenger-facing (above-wing) and ramp operations (below-wing), as well as applicable aviation authority requirements.

- Experience working with service providers and operational performance follow-up.

- Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured, independent and proactive approach to work.

- Willingness and ability to travel occasionally.

- Excellent Finnish and English skills, both written and spoken.


**We value:**

- A strong and proactive safety mindset, with the confidence to identify risks, challenge unsafe practices and promote a positive safety culture among operational stakeholders.

- Practical understanding of both passenger and ramp operations and their interfaces.

- Ability to influence and drive improvements without direct authority over the service provider.

- Ability to build effective relationships across organizations and locations.

- Adaptability during disruptions, irregular operations and seasonal peaks.

- Professional communication and good judgement in operational decision-making.


**Working at Finnair:**

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfill their travel dreams by offering a wide leisure travel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit, Epassi (sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

**Next steps:**

If you enjoy operational oversight, stakeholder collaboration and ensuring that safety ,quality and performance standards are consistently achieved, this role could be a great fit for you.

Please submit your application with your CV, cover letter and salary expectation no later than**Thursday, 3 September 2026**.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre employment security clearance and a drug test.

**Should you have any questions about the role**, please don't hesitate to contact Patrik Nyqvist (Head of Ground Service Delivery)by phone+358405380475 on the specified hours stated below (GMT +03:00):

- Thursday, 27 August between 4pm to 5pm

- Tuesday, 1 September between 2pm to 3pm


Please note that we do not process applications submitted via email.

_Our people are key to our success and the foundation that makes Finnair unique. We are committed to creating a safe work environment where all our people can thrive and succeed. We cherish diversity and strive to employ people with different backgrounds and experiences, to bring together multiple views to foster our business success. According to our employee survey, respecting diversity is at a high level in our work community. You are welcome to join Finnair as your authentic self._

Haemme liikennemyymälätyöntekijää ABC Tikkulaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen (20 h/vko). Työtehtäväsi sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti Hesburgerin keittiön puolelle. ABC Tikkula palvelee asiakkaitaan joka päivä 24h, joten työhön kuuluu aamu-, päivä-, ilta- ja yövuoroja.Työvuorot painottuvat iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin.

Tule mukaan 24h-tiimiimme – tekemään ihan tavallisia töitä, poikkeuksellisen hyvässä porukassa!

Liikennemyymälätyöntekijänä työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia ja usein myös vauhdikkaita. Työskentelet pääasiallisesti Hesburger-keittiön puolella ruokien valmistuksen parissa, mutta tehtäviisi kuuluu myös salityöskentelyä, asiakkaiden palvelua kassalla sekä muita vaihtelevia liikennemyymälän tehtäviä. Vuoroissa varmistetaan aina myös ravintolan siisteys ja jatkuva laadukas asiakaspalvelu on kaiken tekemisen keskiössä.

Katsomme eduksiaiemman kokemuksen Hesburger-työskentelystä ja vastaavanlaisista asiakaspalvelutehtävistä. Tärkeintä meille on kuitenkin tinkimätön palveluasenne, tehokas työote sekä halu oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssä. Teemme työtä yhdessä asiakkaitamme varten – siksi tiimityöskentelytaidot sekä aito halu palvella ja onnistua yhdessä ovatkin meille erityisen tärkeitä arvoja työssä. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta täysi-ikäisyyttä ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaikenlaisissa vuoroissa ABC Tikkulan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti.

Tarjoammeihan tavallisia liikennemyymälätyöntekijän töitä - vaihtelevia ja monipuolisia työpäiviä, mukavaa työarkea ja yhteisiä onnistumisia huipputiimisi kanssa! Saat aloituksen yhteydessä hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävään ja tuemme sinua onnistumisiinpitkin matkaa.

💚 Meillä Satakunnan Osuuskaupalla sinulla on mahdollisuus osoittaa kiinnostustasi myös vastuutehtäviin ja uralla kehittymiseen sekä työntekijänämme saat käyttöösi S-ryhmän ja Satakunnan Osuuskaupan kattavat henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää täältä.

💰Liikennemyymälätyöntekijän palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,51-14,08€/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus myös suoritepalkkioon.

Kiinnostuitko? Haethan paikkaa 2.9.2026 mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaaliikennemyymäläpäällikköHenna Stenius sähköpostitse henna.stenius@sok.fi tai puhelimitse 044 725 2704.

Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. Kandidatar kan bli innkalt til intervju undervegs i prosessen. 

Hospitaldrift leverer ikkje-medisinske tenester og produkt til kjerneverksemda som behandlar pasientar. Avdelinga har 790 engasjerte medarbeidarar, har eit breitt samansett fagmiljø og geografisk spreiing. Forbetrings- og serviceundersøking viser at me har nøgde medarbeidarar og brukarar. 

Helse Bergen har gjennom satsinga si på ernæring vedteke etablering av Spisestua. Dette er eit konsept der kjøkkenfagleg personell slutt-tilverkar maten til pasientane ute i klinikken. Målet er at kjøkkenfagleg personell skal komma i nærare kommunikasjon med pasienten for å tilpassa kvar enkelt ernæringsbehovet sitt. Hospitalsdrift Matforsyning har ansvar for matstovene som finst for fleire avdelingar.

Matstovene er open frå kl. 07.00 - 21.30 alle dagar. Her ønsker vi å tilby pasientane freistande mat i hyggelege omgjevnader. Vi ønsker å bidra til at måltidet blir eit av dagens høgdepunkt for pasientane. Matvertane tar seg av bestilling, slutt-tilverking, anretning av mat, oppvask og rydding. Per i dag er det 22 matstover.

  • Serviceinnstilt og imøtekommande
  • Trivast med å jobbe både sjølvstendig og i samarbeid med andre
  • Strukturert og nøyaktig
  • Vere fleksibel og kunne arbeide i eit hektisk miljø
  • Ha respekt for kvar enkelt pasient
  • Evne til å arbeide målretta med arbeidsoppgåvene

Haluatko työn lisäksi myös mukavia työsuhde-etuja ja mahdollisuuden myös päästä suunnittelemaan niitä lisää? Etsimme leppoisaan porukkaamme nyt luotettavaa ja innokasta työntekijää, jolla on halu löytää oikeasti hyvä työpaikka!

Työpäiväsi koostuu pääosin kotisiivouksista tai muista kodinhoidollisista tehtävistä asiakkaidemme luona. Meidän toimintaperiaate on se, että työtä ei tehdä kiireellä ja me annamme asiakkaalle aikaa. Tarjoamme asiakkaille siis monipuolisen ja lämminhenkisen palvelukokemuksen. Yleisimpiä siivouskohteita meillä on tavanomaiset viikkosiivoukset, ikkunanpesut, muuttosiivoukset ja muut kodinhoidolliset työt mihin asiakas tarvitsee apua.

Työpäivät meillä saat itse aikatauluttaa arkisin 8-17 väliselle ajalle. Pääset myös itse suunnittelemaan omia työvuoroja, jolloin pystyt aikatauluttamaan ne paremmin vapaa-aikaasi ajatellen. Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista työntekijää ja jos olet kiinnostunut kokoaikaisesta työstä, niin siihenkin voi olla tulevaisuudessa mahdollisuus.

Perehdytämme sinut hyvin työtehtäviin ja kohteisiin ennen työskentelyn aloittamista, joten sitä ei tarvitse stressata. Olemme saaneet positiivista palautetta työntekijöiltämme meidän kattavasta ja monipuolisesta perehdytyksestä. Perehdytyksen aikana työskentelet työparin kanssa ja itsenäinen työskentely aloitetaan vasta sitten, kun olet siihen omasta mielestä valmis.

Työssä liikut autolla, joten B-ajokortti on työn kannalta pakollinen. Tarjoamme sinulle yrityksen puolesta auton ja tottakai siihen myös polttoaineet. Mikäli liikut omalla autolla, maksamme sinulle kilometrikorvaukset. Palkka me maksetaan sinulle luonnollisesti myös asiakkaiden välisistä siirtymista.

Miksi hakea meille töihin?

\-Olet illat, viikonloput ja arkipyhät vapaalla. Työ ei siis vaikuta sinun säännöllisiin harrastuksiin tai viikonlopun rientoihin.

\-Tarjoamme sinulle itsenäisen työn, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan omiin työaikoihin. Perehdytämme sinut huolella työtehtääviisi emmekä heitä ketään ns. suden suuhun.

\-Kehitämme yrityksen toimintaa kokoajan ja meillä työntekijät pääsee vaikuttamaan yrityksen tulevaisuuteen.

\-Hyvät tekijät meillä palkitaan. Sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella palkkaa ylöspäin, kun toimintatavat on hallussa.

\-Tarjoamme työntekijöille jopa 400€ liikunta, kulttuuri ja hyvinvointirahaa tunneista riippuen.

\-Yrityksellämme on mm. sup-lautoja työntekijöiden vapaassa käytössä sekä muita työsuhde-etuja!

Me olemme nuorekas oululainen yritys, joka täyttää tänä vuonna jo kymmenen vuotta. Uudistamme koko alaa monipuolisten palveluiden- ja toimintamallien kautta. Yritys on kahden oululaisen nuoren perustama ja se näkyy myös meidän työyhteisössä ja toimintatavoissa. Meillä ei oteta työtä koskaan liian vakavasti, vaikka asiakastyö tehdäänkin aina viimesen päälle. Tällä hetkellä työllistämme yhteensä vähän alle viisitoista tyytyväistä työntekijää. Palveluihimme kuuluu tällä hetkellä monipuoliset siivouspalvelut sekä erilaiset kodinhoidolliset työt asiakkaidemme luona. Meillä otetaan työntekijöiden ideat aina huomioon ja uusista ideoista palkitaan. Tässä on sinulle loistava mahdollisuus tulla osaksi yritystä, jossa pääset kehittämään myös uusia palveluita ja ideoita. Innovatiivisuus ja luovuus katsotaan meillä vain positiivisena asiana!

Aiempi kokemus kotisiivouksesta, ikkunanpesuista sekä muuttosiivouksista katsotaan eduksi. Me kuitenkin perehdytämme sinut hyvin työtehtäviin, vaikka sinulla ei olisi aiempaa kokemusta alalta!

Työn aloituksen ajankohta ja tunnit on sovittavissa. Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista työntekijää pidempään työsuhteeseen ja pystymme lisäksi tarjoamaan sinulle kesätöitä, jos pystyt silloin tekemään enemmän tunteja. Teemme valinnan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja aloitamme perehdytyksen heti, kun sopii!:)

Kysy rohkeasti lisätietoja avoimesta työpaikasta vaikka soittamalla tai sähköpostilla. Tyhmiä kysymyksiä ei ole olemassa joten antaa tulla vaan, meitä ei tarvi pelätä ja ei tämä elämä niin vakavaa ole!! :)

Voit lähettää meille vapaamuotoisen hakemuksen ja CV:n sähköpostitse, eerik.peltomaki@arvojes.fi.

Kirjoita meille myös tuntitoiveesi ja aikataulut milloin pystyisit tekemään töitä. Huomioithan, että me emme tee töitä iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. Työ sopii hyvin myös koulun ohelle, jos sinulla on arkisin vapaapäiviä tai lyhyempiä koulupäiviä!:)

Käy myös tutustumassa meihin somessa: Instagram, Tiktok ja Youtube: @arvojes

jobs.title: Erfaren renholder – fast 66 % stilling på Ballstad
jobs.description:
Vi søker en erfaren og effektiv renholder til våre rorbuer og leiligheter på Ballstad. Du må kunne arbeide selvstendig, se hva som må gjøres og være opptatt av kvalitet og gode gjesteopplevelser.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som har erfaring med profesjonelt renhold, gjerne fra hotell, rorbuer, ferieboliger eller tilsvarende. Det viktigste er at du arbeider grundig og effektivt og klarer å holde god kvalitet også når det er mange enheter som skal klargjøres samme dag.

Du bør være pålitelig, strukturert og kunne arbeide selvstendig uten kontinuerlig oppfølging. Du må kunne se hva som mangler eller ikke er i orden og ta ansvar for at dette blir fulgt opp.

Siden vi arbeider med gjester fra hele verden, er det en fordel om du kan kommunisere på norsk eller engelsk. Førerkort er en fordel.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Klargjøring av rorbuer, rom og leiligheter mellom gjesteopphold. Arbeidet består hovedsakelig av renhold, oppredning av senger og kontroll av at boenheten er komplett og klar for neste gjest.

Oppgavene omfatter blant annet renhold av bad, kjøkken, soverom og oppholdsrom, skifte av sengetøy og håndklær, etterfylling av forbruksvarer og enkel kvalitetskontroll. Det kan også være aktuelt med vask av fellesarealer og enkelte andre praktiske oppgaver.

Du vil i stor grad arbeide selvstendig og ha ansvar for at enhetene holder god standard før gjestene ankommer.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr fast 66 % stilling med mulighet for mer arbeid i høysesong. Arbeidet foregår hovedsakelig på dagtid og passer godt for deg som liker en aktiv arbeidsdag med frihet og ansvar.

Du blir en del av et lite reiselivsteam på Ballstad, hvor vi samarbeider tett og hjelper hverandre når det trengs. Arbeidsdagen er variert, og i sommersesongen er det høyt tempo.

Lønn etter avtale og erfaring. Oppstart etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kræmmervika Rorbuer og Lofoten Hostel Ballstad tilbyr overnatting i rorbuer, leiligheter og hostel på Ballstad i hjertet av Lofoten. Vi er en liten, lokal reiselivsbedrift med gjester fra hele verden og stor aktivitet gjennom året. (⁠kremmervika.no)

Hos oss er godt samarbeid, kvalitet og gode gjesteopplevelser viktig. Vi er et lite team hvor alle bidrar og hjelper til der det trengs.

jobs.description:
BROLÆGGER / ANLÆGSSTRUKTØR SØGES

Kan du lide at arbejde med belægning, have kontakt med kunderne og aflevere et stykke arbejde, du kan være stolt af?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega hos A/S Karl Jensen.

Vi søger en brolægger eller anlægsstruktør til vores serviceafdeling

Du bliver en del af et hold på 8-10 dygtige kollegaer, som løser mindre og mellemstore anlægs-, belægnings- og kloakopgaver for private, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber.

Du får egen firmabil med værktøj og udstyr og vil typisk arbejde sammen med en lærling eller en kollega. Du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver, men du står aldrig alene med udfordringerne. Hos os hjælper vi hinanden.

Vi går op i den sidste finish.

Når vi kører fra en opgave, skal belægningen ligge skarpt, reetableringen være i orden og pladsen være ryddet pænt op.

Kort sagt: Det gør ikke noget, hvis du mestrer kunsten at få det til at se ud, som om vi aldrig har haft en skovl i jorden.

OM JOBBET

Som brolægger eller anlægsstruktør i vores serviceafdeling får du en alsidig hverdag, hvor opgaverne skifter.

Du skal især arbejde med:

• Etablering af nye belægninger
• Reetablering af eksisterende belægninger
• Indkørsler, terrasser, fortove og mindre belægningsopgaver
• Arbejde med minigraver og relevant udstyr
• Jord- og anlægsarbejde
• Kloak- og serviceopgaver efter behov
• Kundekontakt på de enkelte opgaver

VI TILBYDER

• Fuldtidsstilling
• Egen firmabil
• God løn efter kvalifikationer
• Overenskomst med 3F
• Dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer
• Arbejde primært i og omkring Hobro
• Mulighed for kurser og faglig udvikling
• En alsidig hverdag med både belægning, anlæg og kloak
• En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

• Er brolægger, anlægsstruktør eller har solid praktisk erfaring med belægningsarbejde
• Har sans for belægning, reetablering og den færdige finish
• Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver
• Trives med mindre og mellemstore projekter
• Har en god og ordentlig kontakt med kunderne
• Kan føre minigraver og bruge relevant udstyr
• Er mødestabil og ordentlig i dit arbejde
• Er en god makker for både kollegaer og lærlinge
• Har interesse for jord, kloak og anlæg
• Kan tale og forstå dansk i det daglige arbejde
• Har kørekort B – gerne B+E
• Har lyst til at lære nyt

VI UDVIKLER DIG

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag.

Har du den rigtige indstilling og lysten til faget, bygger vi gerne videre med oplæring og relevante kurser – eksempelvis kloakkurser, Vejen som arbejdsplads eller andre kurser, der passer til dig og jobbet.

PRAKTISK

Du bliver en del af vores serviceafdeling med 8-10 medarbejdere og arbejder typisk sammen med en lærling eller en kollega.

Opgaverne ligger primært i og omkring Hobro og spænder fra mindre private opgaver til opgaver for virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber.

Lyder det som noget for dig – eller kender du den rette?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Lead engineer - mechanical design m/f (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.



Descriptif mission
Overview:

In this role, the Lead Engineer (Mechanical Design) will actively participate in conceptual and detailed design of NPI (New Product Introduction), redesign and technology programs of Safran Electronics & Defense business unit and will support various Actuation Systems product lines including Power Door Opening System (PDOS), Thrust Reverser Actuation Systems (TRAS) and Highlift Flap and Slat Actuation systems.



Position: Lead Engineer (P2) - Mechanical Design



Primary Responsibilities:



o Understand system requirements, design intent, and comply with applicable design practices, aerospace standards, customer requirements and regulatory requirements.

o Contribute and implement the design and development of engineering solutions taking account of critical constraints for cost, safety, and sustainability.

o Perform trade study involving conflicting demands from engineering functions (stress, reliability, Performance).

o Carry out conceptual design and detailed design (modelling and drafting) for NPI, Technology programs and value engineering

o Apply GD&T and perform tolerance stack-up analysis for components/Sub-systems.

o Provide inputs to improve Processes, tools, methods, and products

o Design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA) and optimize the design for cost reduction, weight reduction, mistake proofing, material selection.

o Perform design failure mode and effects analyses

o Support manufacturing concessions and engineering change requests

o Self-motivated and keen to get involved in new technologies and projects and learn new skills to map out future career path.

o Actively participate in a team environment and work with customers, suppliers, and cross functional teams for product development

o Develop optimized product design by challenging existing design and ideas and by offering innovative ideas.

o Ensure design works are done in time and with the required details and quality

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Content Onboarding
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Content Onboarding team builds the systems that help customers move content into Notion, get started faster, and keep growing reliably over time. The role matters because one of Notion’s core differentiators is replacing multiple tools — and that only becomes real when customers can get their information out of those tools and into Notion with confidence. You’ll partner with product and engineering leaders to shape the future of our content importers, internal administrative tooling, and compliance workflows like exports.

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Shape the technical and product vision for Notion’s import systems, so customers can pull content from more sources and transform it into a trustworthy system of record.

 - By your 90th day, you’ll have clarified the near-term roadmap and de-risked the most important technical decisions for importers, exports, and internal admin tooling. You’ll connect AI-era and agentic workflow patterns to onboarding and import experiences — using AI to improve product judgment, prototyping, and engineering quality from design through production.

 - By the end of your first year, engineering excellence will be a team norm: reliable systems, clear operational standards, and a shared understanding of what it takes to keep critical workflows running. You will have a steady operating rhythm with HQ while owning a clear north star for the Content Onboarding surface area.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong technical leadership: you can represent the team’s work, hold a high engineering bar, and de-risk decisions through clear processes, delegation, and senior IC partnership.

 - Ability to craft and maintain multi-quarter team strategy, especially where outcomes depend on adjacent product and engineering teams.

 - Experience developing senior engineers, strengthening operating rhythms, and building high-performing engineering teams with durable standards.

 - Distributed-team leadership: you can set direction for a local team while staying tightly coordinated with cross-functional partners across time zones.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.description:
Innastutko kiinteistöalasta?

Kiinnostavatko kiinteistöalan monipuoliset tehtävät innastavassa työyhteisössä? Hae meille!

INNA on pohjoismainen asiantuntijapalvelukonserni, ja olemme erikoistuneet asuntojen, kiinteistöjen ja toimitilojen välitykseen sekä hallintaan. Tuotamme asiakkaillemme kokonaisvaltaisia palveluita ja ratkaisuja asumisen ja toimitilasektorin kiinteistöpalveluissa.

INNA toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Tanskassa.Konsernimme palveluksessa on runsaat 800 kiinteistöjohtamisen ammattilaista. Pohjoismainen toimintatapamme tarkoittaa suorapuheisuutta, luotettavaa palvelua, digitaalista edelläkävijyyttä ja jatkuvaa kehittämistä.

Palveluitamme ovat muun muassa toimitilojen ja asuntojen kiinteistöjohtamispalvelut, asuntovuokraus, taloushallintopalvelut, energiatehokkuus- ja ympäristövastuupalvelut sekä arviointipalvelut. Meillä on alan laajin ja monipuolisin palvelukokonaisuus, ja uskomme, että asiantuntemuksella sekä ajantasaisella markkinatiedolla voimme parantaa asiakkaidemme tulosta.

Etsimme nyt Helsinkiin Valimotielle

ASUNTOTARKASTAJAA

Oletko sinä uusi työkaverimme?

Tehtävänäsi on toimia asuntotarkastusten parissa ja vastaat mm.:

* asuinhuoneistojen tarkastuksista vuokralaisvaihtojen yhteydessä

* huoneistoremonttien määrittämisestä sekä suunnittelemisesta ja tilaamisesta tapauskohtaisesti

* huoneistoremonttien laadunvalvonnasta

* asukasneuvonnasta

Työ on liikkuvaa, ja edellyttää siksi ajokorttia sekä omaa autoa.

Onnistut tehtävässä, jos:

Olet kiinnostunut asunnoista, niiden toimivuudesta ja turvallisuudesta. Kiinteistöalan kokemus tai opinnot ovat eduksi tehtävässä. Lisäksi hallitset vuorovaikutuksen niin sanallisesti kuin kirjallisestikin sekä järjestelmäosaamisesi on hyvällä tasolla. Arvostamme myös näyttöjä korjaushankkeista, remonttien teettämisestä ja asiakaspalvelusta. Rakennustekninen osaaminen plussaa. Järjestelmien ketterä käyttö on tärkeää tässä työssä. Myös aikaisempi työkokemus asuntotarkastuksen tehtävistä katsotaan eduksesi.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen, itsenäisen ja vaikuttavan roolin innastavassa työyhteisössä, jossa osaaminen, kehittyminen ja yhdessä tekeminen kulkevat käsi kädessä. Pääset näkemään työsi tulokset konkreettisesti arjessa ja tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä eri liiketoimintojen kanssa.

Perehdytämme sinut tehtävääsi ja tarjoamme tukea kehittymiseesi tarpeidesi mukaan. Lisäksi käytössäsi on rajaton käyttöoikeus Eduhouseverkkokoulutusalustalle, jonka avulla voit kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti. Tukenasi on vakaa ja kasvava organisaatio, jossa toimintatapoja ja prosesseja kehitetään aktiivisesti ja rohkeasti.

Meillä työ mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi – tarjoamme joustavan arjen, jossa liukuva työaika ja joustava etätyömahdollisuus tukevat sujuvaa työskentelyä. Arvostamme tiimityötä ja rakennamme yhdessä kannustavaa ilmapiiriä, jossa on helppo kehittyä ja onnistua.

Panostamme hyvinvointiisi kattavilla eduilla, kuten laajalla työterveyshuollolla ja Epassilla, jotta jaksat ja viihdyt työssäsi parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Palkka sijoittuu 2800-3200 euron kuukausitasolle ja määräytyy hakijan kokemuksen perusteella.


Näin pääset työkaveriksemme

Tilaisuutesi innastua alkaa tästä. Haethan tehtävää viimeistään 3.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo rekrytointiprosessin aikana.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Henri Tunturi henri.tunturi@inna.fi [henri.tunturi@inna.fi]

Työnantajalupauksemme

INNA pääset kehittymään, ottamaan vastuuta ja vaikuttamaan kiinteistöalan tulevaisuuteen – ja ennen kaikkea innastumaan työstäsi.

Toimintaamme ohjaavat arvot: onnistumme yhdessä, uudistamme rohkeasti ja toimimme vastuullisesti. Ne eivät ole vain sanoja, vaan näkyvät aidosti arjessamme. Meille työyhteisö on paikka, jossa innostus tarttuu.

INNAlla tärkeintä

Tavoitteenamme on olla pohjoismaisen kiinteistöalan edelläkävijä – yritys, joka tunnetaan vahvasta kulttuuristaan, selkeistä arvoistaan ja kyvystään innostaa niin asiakkaita kuin omaa henkilöstöään.

jobs.title: Christmas Operations Coordinator, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Christmas Operations Coordinators for the Christmas season 2026 in Saariselkä.**

The duties focus on handling and organizing the safari programs for charter flight travelers. The coordinators form a team who manage the Christmas Operations as a whole, with the operators daily schedule being its core. This includes, for example, transportation scheduling, cooperation with tour operators, and management of bookings for various safaris with our suppliers. The Christmas Operations Coordinator mainly works as part of a team, but must also be capable of independent work, and if necessary, also acts as a guide.

We expect you to have an active and energetic attitude, a suitable education, and previous work experience within the tourism field in Lapland, as well as a flexible and firm approach to handling tasks. Excellent interpersonal skills are required as you will be guiding other team members in their work. December is a very busy travel month, so we also hope for problem-solving ability and the ability to work under pressure. The work environment is international, so you must have fluent verbal and written English skills. Knowledge of Finnish language is a big advantage in this position. Other language skills and previous experience in guiding work and providing tourism services are considered an advantage.

**In Saariselkä** the work is carried out in two different teams depending on the tour operator. In this role, you act as a key link between the tour operator and the transport company, ensuring smooth cooperation between all parties. You are also responsible for efficiently communicating last-minute changes to subcontractors and partners. The role involves active communication both internally and externally, including communication with subcontractors and the tour operator using various systems. Success in this position requires excellent communication skills, strong IT skills and the ability to understand and manage overall operational processes.

In Saariselkä driving license is considered an advantage.

**We offer you:**

- The support of a professional work team and an interesting job description

- Lapland's natural beautiful surroundings

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in October/November 2026 and last until the beginning/mid of January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade B-C, hourly wage starting at 12,20 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, an EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Mobiililaiteteknikko ja asiakaspalvelija
jobs.description:
**Haluatko mobiililaitteiden huollon ja asiakaspalvelun mestariksi?**

iTapsan Turun myymälä etsii nyt uusia vahvistuksia riveihinsä asiakaspalvelun ja laitehuollon tehtäviin!

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset auttamaan asiakkaitamme arjen laiteongelmissa sekä huoltamaan mobiililaitteita. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, kiinnostunut elektroniikasta ja innokas oppimaan uutta.

**Edellytämme sinulta noin 1-2 vuoden aiempaa kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä**, jotta pääset sujuvasti mukaan työtehtäviin.

Jos sinulla on intoa korjata tekniikkaa, nautit ihmisten auttamisesta ja haluat työpaikan, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

iTapsa on yksi Suomen laitehuoltoalan pioneereista olemme huoltaneet puhelimia, tabletteja ja tietokoneita jo vuodesta 2012.

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

Työsi on monipuolinen yhdistelmä teknistä osaamista ja ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua. Olet tärkeä osa myymälämme arkea ja varmistat, että asiakkaat lähtevät meiltä tyytyväisinä.

Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu:

- Asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja heidän auttamisensa laiteongelmissa

- Puhelinten, tablettien ja tietokoneiden huolto sekä vikadiagnostiikka

- Uudistettujen laitteiden myynti sekä ostoarvioiden tekeminen

- Huoltotöiden kirjaaminen ja hallinta järjestelmissämme

- Myymälän yleisestä viihtyvyydestä ja sujuvasta asiakaskokemuksesta huolehtiminen


**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta. Vaikka sinulla on jo hieman kokemusta alalta, tärkeintä on aito halu kehittyä ja oppia lisää!

Toivomme sinulta:

- Noin 1-2 vuoden kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä

- Motivaatiota ja oppimishalua: olet valmis kehittämään osaamistasi ja nautit uuden oppimisesta

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja: nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja osaat selittää asioita selkeästi

- Huolellisuutta: käsittelet laitteita vastuullisesti ja tarkasti

- Oma-aloitteisuutta: toimit itsenäisesti ja pidät huolen myymälän sujuvasta arjesta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


**Miksi tulla töihin iTapsalle?**

Meillä et ole vain työntekijä, vaan osa rentoa ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

- **Opit arvokkaita taitoja:** kerrytät osaamista asiakaspalvelusta, myymälän pyörittämisestä, laitehuollosta ja myynnistä

- **Kehityt ammattilaisena:** saat monipuolista työkokemusta teknisestä ja asiakaslähtöisestä työstä

- **Rento työilmapiiri:** työskentelet tiimissä, jossa huumori ja hyvä fiilis kulkevat mukana kiireessäkin

- **Kattava perehdytys:** tuemme sinua alusta asti, kunnes hallitset tehtävät itsenäisesti


**Näin haet meille**

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen myynti@itapsa.com. Kerro meille kuka olet, miksi haluat iTapsalle ja milloin voisit aloittaa. Muistathan laittaa sähköpostin otsikoksi **"Työhakemus iTapsa Turku"**.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 30.9.2026.

Palkkaus määräytyy kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

Ansøgningsfrist: 4. september 2026

 

Er du kreativ og nytænkende i din tilgang til mad? Brænder du for at skabe gastronomiske oplevelser og levere service af høj kvalitet til dine gæster? Vil du være en del af et team, der har fokus på din faglighed, udvikling og trivsel? Så har vi jobbet for dig.

 

 

Faglighed og kreativitet

 

Vi vægter kvalitet højt, bæredygtighed og service står øverst på agendaen. Vi forventer vores personale tager et medansvar og er med til at levere en fantastisk service. Vi søger derfor en kok, som brænder for madlavningskunsten, som har mod på at vise sine ideer frem, og som er interesseret i at bidrage til at skabe et team i verdensklasse. Hvis du kan nikke genkendende til dette, så tror vi på, at dette er det rette sted for dig.

 

 

Kreativ, Serviceminded og fleksibel

 

Det forventes, at vores nye kok har erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen, formår at sætte standarden højt for det produkt, der skal leveres hver dag. Som vores nye kok er du en dygtig håndværker, der brænder for service og som er villig til at gå en ekstra mil for et godt resultat til kunden og for dine kolleger.

Som person er du udadvendt, kunne levere et højt serviceniveau hver eneste dag, når du selv i de travleste perioder formår du at holde hovedet koldt og forblive fokuseret. Du er samarbejdsvillig og motiveres af udfordringer. Du er ambitiøs i din tilgang til jobbet, og du går aldrig på kompromis med kvaliteten af den mad du serverer.

 Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt mandag til fredag

 

Ansøgning

Indsend dit CV, motiveret ansøgning og andre relevante dokumenter via linket 'Ansøg nu' senest d. 4 september 2026.Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning i dag frem for i morgen – det kan være dig, vi leder efter.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Site Manager Martin Patrick Rørsig på mail. Martin.Patrick.Roersig@dk.issworld.com 

 

 Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

 #LI-DNI

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.



You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco and New York, the estimated OTE (On-Target Earnings) range is $145,000-$175,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Conduct data analyses to gain insights about Notion and use these insights to uncover opportunities for improvements in our product and business.

 - Communicate these insights with actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams (insights are useful, impact is even better!).

 - Work with cross-functional partners across the product and business to learn about their functions and use data to advance their respective areas.

 - Create metrics and build dashboards to monitor the growth and health of Notion.

 - Communicate insights and recommendations effectively to leadership and have an impact on strategic decision-making.




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master's in a quantitative field such as Economics, Statistics, Applied Math, Engineering, Computer Science, or Natural Sciences. Must graduate before December 2027.

 - This internship will take place from January 25 - April 16 and you will need to be able to work out of our SF office during this time.

 - Previous research or internship experience.

 - Proficient in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.

 - Working towards proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as Python or R.

 - You find large challenges exciting and enjoy discovering problems as much as solving them.

 - You are able to problem-solve and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck.

 - Put users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact—good and bad.

 - Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.

 - Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.

 - AI enthusiast: You have built or prototyped features with AI technologies (LLMs, Embeddings, ML) and are interested in learning more.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have previous intern experience working with product, engineering, or GTM teams.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.

 - You have interests outside of technology, such as in art, history, or social sciences.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated hourly range for this role is $55/hr for Bachelors and $59/hr for Master’s.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Valuation Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


Job ID: 21500
Date posted: July 23 2026
Category: Real Assets
Job Level: Manager


ABOUT US:

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com  


YOUR FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead the valuation process for portfolio assets and oversee the preparation and review of valuations for each NAV calculation, ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with applicable valuation standards and internal policies;
Drive the valuation assessment of new investment opportunities, providing independent challenge and expert judgment on pricing assumptions, methodologies and transaction structures;
Perform and oversee detailed financial, operational and market analysis of portfolio assets and the sectors in which they operate, identifying key value drivers, risks and opportunities;
Prepare and review comprehensive valuation reports, presenting valuation conclusions, methodologies, key assumptions and sensitivities to senior management and governance bodies;
Present valuation analyses and recommendations to the Valuation Committee and actively contribute to valuation-related discussions and decision-making processes;
Act as a key point of contact for valuation matters, working closely with Portfolio Management, Fund Onboarding, Risk Management, Operations & Oversight, Finance and other internal stakeholders, as well as external parties including General Partners, investment advisors/managers, auditors, third-party valuation firms, service providers and regulators;
Monitor market developments, industry trends and regulatory changes affecting valuations, ensuring that valuation methodologies remain robust and aligned with best market practices;
Contribute to the continuous enhancement of valuation policies, procedures, controls and governance frameworks across the organization;
Support and mentor junior team members, fostering technical excellence and knowledge sharing within the valuation function.


YOUR PROFILE:

You hold a Master's degree (MA/MSc/MBA or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field;
You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years of direct valuation experience gained within asset management, advisory, valuation consulting, audit, private markets, or a similar environment;
You have strong knowledge of valuation methodologies applicable to alternative assets, including Private Equity, Real Estate and/or Infrastructure investments;
You possess a solid understanding of financial statements, financial modelling, investment analysis and valuation principles;
You demonstrate strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and exercise sound professional judgment;
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills and are comfortable presenting complex valuation topics to senior stakeholders and governance committees;
You are able to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders and confidently interact with asset managers, advisers and auditors on technical valuation matters;
You proactively stay informed about market developments, valuation best practices and regulatory requirements, assessing their impact on valuation processes and outcomes;
You have a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment;
You are fluent in English


WHAT WE OFFER:

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.


Our global benefits also include:

Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
Continuous mentoring along your career progression
Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
Plus additional local benefits depending on your location
Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement

jobs.description:
Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
    Systems / ERP capability
        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

The Disbursement Officer will be involved in the process of loan disbursements in the non-EU as well as equity disbursements and reflows to/from EU and non-EU counterparts. This primarily entails verifying that all contractual conditions to disbursements are fulfilled and properly documented to fix the disbursement and instructing payments, while ensuring the support to the client facing departments to achieve their yearly disbursement objective (COP) and 1st Line of Defence controls pertaining to disbursements.

The Disbursement Officer cooperates closely with Client Facing Officers in the Bank Global (GLO) and Portfolio Monitoring and Management (PMM) Directorates as well as Operations (OPS) and colleagues in other Directorates: Finance Directorate (FI) front and back office, Legal Directorate (JU), the Project Directorate (PJ), Risk Management Directorate (RM) and has also contacts with external counterparts (borrowers, fund managers).

Reports to the Head of the Disbursement Unit - under the authority of the Head of Disbursement Division - working in a pool of Disbursement Analysts.


ACCOUNTABILITIES:

The tasks and activities the temp is expected to work on are as follows:
• Manage the upcoming disbursements related activities within the team dedicated to a specific geographical/sectorial area and ensure overall quality of the processes (the scope of concerned lending operations will vary from equity products to investment funds, Project Finance and/or standard loan products).
• Perform checks of conditions precedent to disbursement, in advance of the payments being made by the Bank and prepare the complete checklist and respective evidences for subsequent validation by the Head of Unit or a delegate validator.
• Ensure completeness of checklist of conditions precedent to disbursement; ensure that CP fulfilment evidences are properly saved for audit trail.
• Input the list of conditions precedent to disbursement (CPs) in the Bank's IT system (NOW/Serapis) and/or prepare RaSA quote requests where relevant (for loan disbursements).
• Check the validity of contractual securities, liaise with monitoring or transaction officers on confirmation of ratings of the borrower and/or guarantor, financial covenants compliance etc.
• Interface with borrowers and/or intermediary institutions to ensure the receipt of mandatory information needed for disbursement purposes or otherwise required in the Finance Contract
• Provide other middle office support to PMM monitoring and transaction officers, such as prepare statistics, respond to data requests etc.
• Flag business issues to the Head of Unit or the Head of Division if and when they arise, in particular, any issues of increased operational risk and work out potential solutions.


QUALIFICATIONS:

• University degree in relevant fields such as banking, finance, economics, accounting etc.
• At least 3 years of relevant experience, preferably in a loan back office, middle office, corporate finance or legal department.
• Very good knowledge of standard office tools such as Excel and Word.
• Very good knowledge of English. A good command of French or another EU language (in particular Spanish) would be an advantage.
• Knowledge of, or experience with, disbursement procedures and familiarity with legal documentation for lending would be an advantage.
• Knowledge of how the Bank operates and is organised, knowledge of the Bank project cycle, would be an advantage.


COMPETENCIES:

• Ensuring accountability: Holding yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
• Collaborating: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

• Driving results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
