About the FSTM

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.

Your role

Teaching:

The holder of the position will contribute to the Bachelor of Science in Nursing, specialisation: Surgery (“Bachelor Assistance Technique Médicale de Chirurgie”). The selected candidate is expected to co-organize the bachelor programme. The individual will contribute to establish the training plan for specialized nurses, contribute to organize theoretical and practical teaching, and the evaluation during and at the end of the course, in relation with the teachers and tutors of the clinical placements. More particularly, the presence on the campus of students in medicine, biology, nursing and midwifery provides us with the possibility to establish common courses, to help students discover and understand the specificities of their different training and future professions at a very early stage and to have them work together in modern interprofessional simulation environments. This pooling of teaching will be based on the collaborative and joint work of teachers from the different health programmes.

Research:

The candidate will be responsible for developing the research programme and to contribute, according to one's expertise, to the current Nursing Education Research Programmes.
The distribution between the different activities (academic/research) will be adapted according to the holder's profile.

Your profile

• Holder of a Nursing degree, a master's preferably in Nursing Science and a doctorate (PhD) preferably in Nursing Science or in Public Health. The candidate should hold a specilised degree in perioperative nursing and demonstrate research expertise based on the quality of one's research work as evidenced by publications
• Administrative experience and leadership qualities are essential
• Experience in both nursing research and nursing education, including theoretical teaching and supervision of trainees, is essential
• Clinical experience in Perioperative Nursing
• Connection to nursing education departments in universities abroad
• Collaboration or membership with European Nursing Societies
• Experience in simulation training and being a holder of ERC certificate are considered as an asset

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English (C1) and needs to have an excellent command of either French or German (C1). The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

Applications should include:

• Cover letter
• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, teaching activities, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

jobs.title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
SENIOR FUND ACCOUNTING OFFICER

Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our New York office.We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $65.38 – $76.92/hr.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: TEHNIČKI NADZORNIK/TEHNIČKA NADZORNICA FLOTE
jobs.description:
Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • nadzor tehničkog stanja plovila i brodske opreme (dizalica)
  • planiranje i praćenje preventivnog i korektivnog održavanja
  • organizaciju servisa, popravaka, remonta i dokovanja
  • koordinaciju rada vanjskih servisera, izvođača i dobavljača
  • tehničku podršku upraviteljima stroja
  • praćenje kvarova i osiguravanje njihove pravovremene sanacije
  • kontrolu tehničkih izvještaja i dokumentacije s plovila
  • praćenje rokova servisa, pregleda i certifikata tehničke opreme
  • suradnju s klasifikacijskim društvima, registrom i nadležnim tijelima
  • pripremu plovila za tehničke preglede i inspekcije
  • izradu tehničkih specifikacija i zahtjeva za nabavu
  • kontrolu ponuda, troškova održavanja
  • praćenje zaliha rezervnih dijelova i kritične opreme
  • povremene odlaske na plovila i lokacije izvođenja radova
  • sudjelovanje u tehničkom planiranju i razvoju flote

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • tehničko ili pomorsko obrazovanje
  • iskustvo u pomorskom sektoru, brodogradnji, održavanju plovila ili srodnim tehničkim poslovima
  • dobro poznavanje sustava, strojeva i opreme
  • sposobnost samostalnog organiziranja i vođenja tehničkih aktivnosti
  • razvijene organizacijske sposobnosti i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • odgovoran i praktičan pristup rješavanju tehničkih problema
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i tehničke dokumentacije
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • spremnost na povremena službena putovanja i rad na terenu
Prednost imaju kandidati s:
  • iskustvom u svojstvu upravitelja stroja, časnika stroja
  • iskustvom s radnim brodovima, tegljačima, jaružalima, multicat plovilima ili drugim specijaliziranim plovilima
  • iskustvom u organizaciji remonta, dokovanja i većih tehničkih popravaka
  • iskustvom u radu s klasifikacijskim društvima i pomorskim administracijama
  • poznavanjem sustava planiranog održavanja (PMS)
Nudimo:
  • stalni radni odnos
  • aktivno sudjelovanje u upravljanju i razvoju flote
  • dinamično radno okruženje u pomorskom sektoru
  • rad na različitim tehničkim i pomorskim projektima
  • mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja
  • stimulativna primanja u skladu s iskustvom i kvalifikacijama kandidata

  • Obavlja sve strojobravarske poslove te vodi brigu o tehničkoj ispravnosti postrojenja,strojeva i opreme u društvu
  • Ispituje ispravnost mehaničkih dijelova strojeva i opreme u postrojenjima te poduzima potrebne preventivne mjere
  • Utvrđuje i otklanja kvarove te mijenja dotrajale ili neispravne dijelove
Uvjeti:
  • završena srednja škola strojarskog usmjerenja – strojobravar, bravar, mehaničar industrijskih strojeva ili drugo odgovarajuće zanimanje
  • poznavanje rada i održavanja strojeva, opreme i industrijskih postrojenja
  • radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima je poželjno
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • odgovornost, pouzdanost, samostalnost i spremnost na timski rad
  • spremnost na rad na različitim lokacijama Društva i obavljanje hitnih intervencija
  • zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.
Uz prijavu je potrebno priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o završenom obrazovanju
  • presliku vozačke dozvole

Na natječaj se mogu ravnopravno prijaviti osobe oba spola. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju uvjete mogu biti pozvani na razgovor i provjeru stručnih znanja i sposobnosti.

Poslodavac zadržava pravo ne odabrati nijednog kandidata bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke.

  • dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu za ložača centralnog grijanja,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, pisanu provjeru stručnih sposobnosti koje su potrebne za obavljanje poslova ovog radnog mjesta i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 19. kolovoza 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23), e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 10 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il seguente posto di lavoro di 1 OPERATORE TECNICO / OPERATRICE TECNICA addetto/a alla manutenzione per lo svolgimento delle mansioni di bidello e fuochista - addetto/a al riscaldamento centrale, a tempo determinato e orario completo (supplenza) CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: Oltre alle condizioni generali in conformità alle norme generali sul lavoro, i candidati devono soddisfare anche le condizioni previste dall'articolo 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU n. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e secondo il Regolamento sull'ambito di lavoro del segretario e sulle mansioni tecnico-amministrative svolte nella scuola elementare (GU n. 40 /14, 71/25, 74/25-correzione):
  1. Scuola media superiore di ramo tecnico
  2. Esame per fuochisti – addetti al riscaldamento centrale
  3. Idoneità sanitaria per lo svolgimento di mansioni a rischio specifico
  4. assenza di condanne penali per i reati indicati nell'articolo 106 della Legge sull'educazione el'istruzione elementare e media superiore.
NOTA: La prova della specifica idoneità sanitaria del/la candidato/a per il posto di lavoro si ottiene prima della stipula del contratto di lavoro, conformemente alle disposizioni dell’articolo 24, commi 2 e 3, della Legge sul lavoro (GU 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23, 64/23). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • i dati biografici (Curriculum vitae),
  • la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova attestante il superamento dell'esame per fuochista – addetto al riscaldamento centrale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (la cui data non deve antecedere a 6 mesi dalla data del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, la verifica scritta delle competenze professionali necessarie per lo svolgimento delle mansioni relative a questo posto di lavoro ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 19 agosto 2026.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent), in Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Nice to have

Bonus Points

- Experience

jobs.title: IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d)

vor Ort Roggwil TG, Thurgau, Schweiz

• Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

• Transparente Kommunikation sowie eine familiäre Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und Rabatte

Jobbeschreibung

Die kybun Joya Retail AG in Roggwil gehört zur kybun Joya Gruppe, welche Komfortschuhe und weitere Gesundheitslösungen in der Schweiz entwickelt, produziert und in mehr als 40 Ländern vertreibt. Ziel ist es, den Menschen durch kompetente Beratung schmerzfreie Bewegung zu ermöglichen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Roggwil suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine teamfähige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit.

Als IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator sind Sie das technische Rückgrat unserer digitalen Infrastruktur und gleichzeitig Motor unserer KI-Transformation. Sie sorgen für eine stabile, sichere Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft und treiben aktiv die Integration von KI-Lösungen in unsere Geschäftsprozesse voran. Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)
- Verwaltung von Endgeräten inkl. Device Enrollment, Intune-Policies und Lizenzmanagement
- Konfiguration und Pflege von Domains, DNS-, SPF- und Zertifikatsstrukturen (z. B. sichere LDAP-Zertifikate, Mail-Deliverability)
- Hardware-Beschaffung & -Verwaltung (Client/Server)
- Gelegentlicher Vor-Ort-Support für Shops, inkl. Reisetätigkeit bei Neueinrichtungen

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection
- Incident Response bei Sicherheitsvorfällen (z. B. Phishing, kompromittierte Accounts) inkl. interner Kommunikation
- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Workflows in n8n und Anbindung an Systeme wie Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Synthflow und weitere APIs
- Betrieb und Optimierung von KI-Agenten (z. B. Gorgias AI Agent, Synthflow Telefonie, Copilot-Anwendungen)
- Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring KI-generierter Inhalte – inkl. Fehlerdiagnose, Fallback-Logik und Reporting
- Evaluation neuer KI-Tools und Modelle sowie Ableitung von Business-Use-Cases
- Schulung und Enablement interner Teams im Umgang mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gorgias AI)

Stellenanforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, Netzwerktechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Administration, idealerweise in einem KMU- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
- Erste praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, Prompt Engineering und/oder Automatisierungsplattformen (n8n, Zapier, Make o. ä.)

Fachliche Kompetenzen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Firewalls, WLAN-Controller)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft-365-Welt: Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint

jobs.title: HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Berufsausbildung in Verbindung mit einer qualifizierten Weiterbildung und darauf bezogene umfangreiche fachspezifische Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.- Sie können komplexe Compliance- und Kontrollanforderungen verständlich vermitteln.- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.- Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder ohne direkte Weisungskompetenz zu beeinflussen.- Sie bringen eine hohe Integrität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risiko- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.- Sie treiben Veränderungen aktiv voran und fördern eine nachhaltige Compliance- und Kontrollkultur.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Boltvezető-helyettes HUMANIC - Duna Plaza üzletbe (Verkaufsfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 70 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

AZ ÖN FELADATAI

- Boltvezető helyettesítése
- Ügyfélkiszolgálás és értékesítés.
- Üzleti célok elérésének biztosítása
- Üzletünk szabályainak betartatása
- Üzletünk rendjének és tisztaságának fenntartása.
- Üzlet napi működésének felügyelete                
- Üzletünkben lévő termékek rendszeres ellenőrzése.
- Raktárkezelés és készletgazdálkodás
- Kapcsolattartás a vevőkkel és partnerekkel
- Ügyfelek igényeinek kielégítése.

AZ ÖN PROFILJA

- Kedves, mosolygós, dinamikus, csapatban szívesen dolgozó munkatársakat keresünk, aki szívesen foglalkozik emberekkel és mindenekelőtt szereti a cipőket,
- több éves kereskedelmi tapasztalat,
- igényes munkavégzés,
- német nyelvtudás előny,
- középfokú végzettség, érettségi

AJÁNLATUNK

- Keresünk rugalmas munkatársat boltvezető helyettesi munkakörbe, Budapesten a Duna Plaza bevásárlóközpontban levő színvonalas cipőüzletünkbe teljes munkaidőben való foglalkoztatással.
- Változatos feladatok egy nemzetközi divatcégnél, amelynek székhelye Ausztriában található.
- Kedves, hozzáértő csapat, amely átfogó betanítást biztosít.

Előnyök üzleteinkben:- szakmai tréningek

- versenyképes alapbér
- béren kívüli juttatás
- teljesítménytől függően 13. havi bér.

Fizetés:- Megegyezés szerint

jobs.title: Tööinspektor-jurist
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Riikliku järelevalve teostamine töösuhteid reguleerivate õigusaktide nõuete täitmise üle.
Tööandjate tegevuse kontrollimine erinevates tegevusvaldkondades. Haldus- ja väärteomenetluste läbiviimine tööõiguse valdkonnas. Osalemine kohtumenetlustes oma pädevuse piires. Teiste tööinspektorite nõustamine ja toetamine järelevalvemenetluste läbiviimisel. Töösuhete ja tööohutusega seotud õiguslike küsimuste analüüsimine ning õigusaktide tõlgendamine. Ettepanekute ja sisendi andmine õigusaktide muutmiseks ning arendamiseks. Panustamine töösuhete ja töökeskkonna õiguspärasuse ning turvalisuse tagamisse.

Omalt poolt pakume: Võimalust teha huvitavat ja mõjusat tööd.
Toetavat ja kogenud meeskonda ning võimalust professionaalselt areneda. Erialaseid koolitusi teadmiste ja oskuste täiendamiseks. Pärast katseaja läbimist põhipalka 2400 eurot kuus. 35 kalendripäeva põhipuhkust ja 5 tasustatud tervisepäeva. Töökohta Tööinspektsiooni Tallinna, Rakvere või Jõhvi kontoris. Paindlikku tööaega ja võimalust teha osa tööst kaugtööna. Võimalust osaleda rahvusvahelises koostöös ning õppida teiste riikide kogemustest.

Muud nõuded: Rakenduslik või akadeemiline juriidiline kõrgharidus.
Huvi tööõiguse ning töösuhteid ja tööohutust reguleerivate õigusaktide vastu. Valmisolek panustada Eesti tööelu turvalisemaks ja inimkesksemaks muutmisse. Valmisolek rahvusvaheliseks koostööks ja lähetusteks. Hea argumenteerimisoskus, pingetaluvus ja enesekindlus. Positiivne ellusuhtumine ja tulemustele orienteeritus.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Jah

jobs.title: Ehitus- ja remonditööline
jobs.description:
Osalise koormusega

Tööülesanded: Otsime remondi- ja hooldustöölist (osaline töökoormus)
RevalHome haldab Tallinnas ligi 30 lühiajalise majutuse üksust mitmel objektil ja portfell kasvab jõudsalt. Otsime oma meeskonda remonditöölist, kes hoiaks meie korterid ja majutusüksused töökorras. Tööülesanded Pisiremonditööd objektidel: santehnika (segistid, WC-potid, sifoonid), elektri väiketööd (pistikud, lülitid, valgustid), uksed ja lukud, silikoonimine, värvimine, seinte ja põrandate parandus. Mööbli ja sisustuse kokkupanek, paigaldus ja parandus. Külaliste ja majutusmeeskonna teavitatud probleemide operatiivne lahendamine. Seadmete kontroll ja hooldus: pesumasinad, boilerid, konditsioneerid, ventilatsioon. Vajalike materjalide ja varuosade ostmine. Objektide üldine tehniline korrashoid ja väiksemad ennetavad tööd.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pikaajaline ja stabiilne koostöö kasvavas ettevõttes: objektide arv suureneb lähiajal oluliselt.
Selged ülesanded ja kiire suhtlus – ei pea ise kliente otsima ega hinnapakkumisi tegema.

Muud nõuded: Oskus iseseisvalt probleemile lahendus leida ja töö lõpuni viia.
Oma põhilised käsi- ja elektritööriistad. Telefoni teel hea kättesaadavus ja paindlikkus kiireloomuliste olukordade puhul.

jobs.title: Asendustalunik
jobs.description:
asendab talupidajaid

Tööülesanded: Eestimaa Talupidajate Keskliit otsib oma kollektiivi asendustalunikke.
Asendustalunik on põllumajandustöötaja, kelle ülesandeks on ajutiselt asendada talunikke nende puhkuse, haiguse või muude eriolukordade ajal. Töö hõlmab erinevaid põllumajandus- ja loomakasvatustöid, tagades talu sujuva toimimise taluniku puudumisel. Asendustaluniku töö on liikuv, mistõttu saab teenindada mitmeid erinevaid talusid nii elukohajärgses piirkonnas kui ka kaugemal. Vajadusel ööbitakse kohapeal taludes. Asendustaluniku tööülesanded hõlmavad loomadega seotud tegevusi nagu lüpsmine, söötmine, loomade tervise jälgimine ja muud põllumajanduslikud tööd.

Omalt poolt pakume: Töötasu alates 10 eurot tunnis (bruto).
Toetame Teie tööle sõitmist, pakkudes transpordikulude katmist. Pakume koolitusvõimalusi. Tagame vajalikud tööriided, et saaksite oma tööd mugavalt ja ohutult teha. Ühendame meie meeskonda läbi ühisürituste ja tegevuste.

Muud nõuded: - Põllumajanduslik keskeri-, kutsekesk- või kõrgharidus või vähemalt 3 aastane varasem töökogemus põllumajandusettevõttes, eriti loomakasvatuses
- Lüpsioskus, veistega töötamise kogemus - Hooliv suhtumine loomadesse - Usaldusväärsus, korrektsus, kiire kohanemisvõime - Väga hea suhtlemisoskus - Soovitavalt traktorijuhiload Töö on mitmekesine ja nõuab head kohanemisvõimet ning oskust töötada iseseisvalt ja vastutustundlikult. Samas pakub töö palju paindlikkust oma aja planeerimisel.

jobs.title: Õde
jobs.description:
Tõrva kodu ootab oma meeskonda hoolivat ja pühendunud õde

Tööülesanded: Toetab erihooldusteenusel olevate inimeste tervist ja heaolu, tagades professionaalse, turvalise ja inimkeskse õendusabi.
Hindab ja jälgib klientide terviseseisundit, sealhulgas elutähtsaid näitajaid, haavade seisundit ning lamatiste tekke riski. Teostab õendustoiminguid, sh haavaravi ning osaleb terviseprobleemide ennetamises ja varajases märkamises. Hindab vaimset tervist ning viib läbi terviseedenduslikke tegevusi ja grupisekkumisi (nt unehügieeni ja rahunemistehnikate teemal). Korraldab ravimite tellimist, jälgib nende kasutamist ning tagab ravimite nõuetekohase ja ohutu hoiustamise. Korraldab vaktsineerimisi ning rakendab nakkustõrje meetmeid. Korraldab sõeluuringutes osalemist ning hindab elukeskkonna ja abivahendite vajadust. Dokumenteerib õendustegevused vastavalt kehtivatele nõuetele. Teeb koostööd erihooldusteenusel oleva inimese, tema lähedaste või eestkostja, hoolduspersonali ning pere- ja eriarstidega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Hea ja hooliv meeskond – sõbralikud kolleegid ja toetav õhkkond.
Ühised üritused – meeskonnaüritused ja traditsioonid, mis loovad ühtekuuluvustunnet. Paindlik töökorraldus – aitame töö ja eraelu paremini ühildada. Toetused eraelu oluliste sündmuste puhul – nt lapse sünni või lähedase kaotuse korral.

Muud nõuded: Oskus hinnata inimese terviseseisundit ning teostada õendustoiminguid iseseisvalt ja professionaalselt.
Kogemus või valmisolek teha koostööd perearstide, eriarstide ning teiste tervishoiu- ja sotsiaalvaldkonna spetsialistidega. Hea digipädevus ja oskus kasutada tervishoiu infosüsteeme ning teisi tehnoloogilisi lahendusi oma töös. Isikuomadused: Empaatiline ja lugupidav suhtumine erivajadustega inimestesse. Hea suhtlemis- ja koostööoskus. Korrektsus, kohusetundlikkus ja täpsus. Iseseisvus otsuste tegemisel ning vastutustunne oma töö korraldamisel. Paindlikkus ja meeskonnatöö valmidus.

jobs.title: Üldehitaja
jobs.description:
Üldehitaja / Ehitustööline

Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda kogemustega ja iseseisvat üldehitajat, kellele meeldib oma kätega hästi tehtud töö ja kes hindab vaheldusrikkaid ehitusobjekte.
Töö hõlmab erinevaid üldehitus-, remondi- ja viimistlustöid vastavalt objektile ja oskustele – alates ettevalmistavatest töödest kuni kvaliteetse lõpptulemuseni. Meie objektid on peamiselt elamud ja korterid ning tööd võivad hõlmata ka katuse-, fassaadi-, maalri- ja muid ehitustöid. Ootame Sind, kui oskad oma tööd planeerida ja iseseisvalt teostada, tunned ehitusest rõõmu ning pead oluliseks korralikku ja kvaliteetset lõpptulemust. Objektid asuvad peamiselt Harjumaal, kuid huvitavamad projektid võivad viia ka mujale Eestis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Ankre OÜ-s ootab Sind:
- kindel ja stabiilne töökoht usaldusväärses ja kasvavas ettevõttes; - vaheldusrikkad ja huvitavad ehitusobjektid, kus töö ei ole päevast päeva ühesugune; - võimalus teha mitmekesiseid üldehitus-, remondi- ja viimistlustöid ning rakendada oma seniseid oskusi; - iseseisev ja vastutusrikas töö, kus Sinu panus ja tehtud töö on päriselt oluline; - konkurentsivõimeline töötasu, mis vastab Sinu oskustele, kogemusele ja panusele; - täiskoormusega töö ja õigeaegselt makstav töötasu; - korralik ja toetav meeskond, kus väärtustatakse head töömeest ja kvaliteetset tööd; - võimalus areneda koos ettevõttega ning saada pikaajaline ja stabiilne töökoht; - objektid peamiselt Harjumaal, kuid võimalusel ka huvitavad projektid mujal Eestis. Farmis on ligikaudu 1000 looma, mistõttu on tehniliste süsteemide sujuv toimimine meie igapäevatöös väga olulisel kohal. See on hea võimalus inimesele, kes soovib teha praktilist ja mitmekesist tööd ning olla osa ettevõttest, mis areneb, investeerib ja kasvab. Sinu tööks saab olema: - farmi masinate ja seadmete hooldus ning remont; - lüpsi- ja muude farmiseadmete rikete tuvastamine ning kõrvaldamine; - tehnosüsteemide korrasoleku jälgimine; - ennetavate hooldustööde tegemine; - erinevate tehniliste probleemide lahendamine; - koostöö farmi meeskonna ja teiste tehnikutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Olla osa professionaalsest ja toetavast meeskonnast;
- teha mitmekesist tööd kaasaegses piimafarmis; - arendada oma tehnilisi teadmisi ja oskusi; - töötada erinevate seadmete ja tehnosüsteemidega; - kaasa rääkida ja oma teadmistega ettevõtte arengusse panustada; - kindlat ja pikaajalist töökohta; - töötasu suurus sõltub oskustest ning panusest; - vajalikud töövahendid ja tööriided; - ametiauto.

Muud nõuded: Meie ootused:
Sul on hea tehniline taip ja praktiline mõtlemine; oskad või soovid õppida masinaid ja seadmeid remontima; oled iseseisev, kohusetundlik ja lahendustele orienteeritud; hindad vaheldusrikast tööd ja soovid oma töö tulemust päriselt näha. Varasem kogemus piimafarmis ei ole tingimata vajalik. Olulisem on huvi tehnika vastu, õppimisvõime ja soov areneda.

jobs.description:
Description de l'entreprise
Le Groupe BPCE, avec son modèle de banque coopérative universelle, représenté par 9 millions de sociétaires, est le deuxième acteur bancaire en France. Avec 105 000 collaborateurs, il est au service de 30 millions de clients dans le monde, particuliers, professionnels, entreprises, investisseurs et collectivités locales. Il est présent dans la banque de proximité et l'assurance en France avec ses deux grands réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d'Epargne ainsi que la Banque Palatine. Chez BPCE Equipment Solutions, nous sommes spécialisés en financement des ventes et des équipements professionnels aux entreprises et nous sommes leader en Europe et n°2 mondial sur notre marché. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis à l'international nous sommes régulièrement primés notamment aux Leasing Life Awards en tant que "SME Champion of the year" et / ou « European Lessor of the year ». Entité à taille humaine, agile et innovante, rejoignez-nous pour partager notre Vision : "We want to be a leading provider of innovative and flexible solutions to finance and manage equipment. We are a digital and customer-centric organization, committed to deliver an excellent experience to vendors partners and clients across countries. We are a great place to work, driven by simplicity, agility and sustainability."
Poste et missions
Vos missions au sein de l'équipeVous rejoignez l'équipe de Vincent, composée de 25 personnes en tant que Chef de Projet Data.Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data en place au sein de BPCE ES, répartie entre Paris et Bangalore. Cette équipe a en charge la gestion de la plateforme Data utilisée pour le pilotage commercial, financier, risque et Conformité de BPCE ES. Elle est aussi porteuse des principes Data à appliquer dans les projets de la Business Unit, sur la Data Quality ou la Protection des données.Dans cette équipe, vous aurez notamment l'occasion de contribuer au programme d'intégration de BPCE ES dans le Groupe BPCE, ainsi qu'au support des sujets transverses de la filière Data.Au quotidien, vous avez pour missions :Gestion de projet :Piloter et coordonner des projets Data.Assurer le suivi des plannings, des budgets et des ressources allouées.Organiser et animer les réunions de suivi de projet.Identifier et gérer les risques et les dépendances entre les projets.Analyse métier :Recueillir et analyser les besoins métiers en matière de data.Rédiger des cahiers des charges fonctionnels et techniques.Assurer l'interface entre les métiers et les équipes techniques.Participer à la conception des solutions data en collaboration avec les architectes et les développeurs.Amélioration continue :Proposer des améliorations des processus et des outils existants.Veiller à la qualité des données et à leur cohérence.Participer à la définition et au suivi des indicateurs de performance.Communication :Rendre compte régulièrement de l'avancement des projets à la direction.Assurer la communication entre les différentes parties prenantes.Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'appropriation des solutions data.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Un groupe engagé dans les enjeux sociétaux et environnementaux
En intégrant le Groupe BPCE, vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail hybride et favorisant le collaboratif. En tant qu'employeur responsable et engagé à construire un environnement de travail inclusif, nous offrons les mêmes opportunités aux talents de tous horizons, indépendamment de votre âge, origine, orientation sexuelle, handicap. Vous intégrerez un environnement international, au sein d'une communauté d'experts qui place l'excellence, l'impact et l'action collective au cœur de tout ce qu'elle entreprend.
Profil et compétences requises
Vous possédez une expérience d'au-moins 5 ans dans ce rôle, dans le domaine bancaire et autour des process métier lié au pilotage d'activité commerciale, risque et finance, idéalement dans le leasing.
Les compétences attendues sont :
- Connaissance des méthodes agiles et des outils de gestion de projet (JIRA, etc.)
- Maîtrise des outils d'analyse de données (SQL, Excel, Power BI, etc.)
- Connaissance des réglementations liées à la protection des données (RGPD)

- Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et esprit d'équipe

- Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse
- Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter les délais

jobs.title: Cook –Authentic Uyghur Hand-Pulled Noodles and Central Asian Cuisine
jobs.description:
Uyghur Noodle House is a restaurant in Helsinki specialising in fresh handmade noodles and authentic Central Asian cuisine.

We are recruiting two full-time cooks for two separate positions:

1. Cook specialising in handmade and hand-pulled noodles

2. Cook specialising in Central Asian cuisine


POSITION 1: HANDMADE AND HAND-PULLED NOODLE COOK

Main duties:

Preparing noodle dough from raw ingredients Kneading, resting, portioning, stretching and cooking the dough Producing fresh handmade and hand-pulled noodles during daily restaurant service Preparing laghman and other traditional noodle products Ensuring consistent noodle texture, thickness, portion size and quality Preparing ingredients and organising the noodle workstation before service Working efficiently during busy service periods Cleaning and maintaining the equipment and work area

Requirements:

At least three years of professional experience in handmade or hand-pulled noodle preparation Ability to complete the entire noodle-making process independently, starting from dough preparation Ability to maintain consistent quality and speed during busy restaurant service Willingness to complete a practical noodle-making skills test

POSITION 2: CENTRAL ASIAN CUISINE COOK

Main duties:

Preparing traditional Central Asian dishes, including pilaf, samsa, grilled lamb skewers and whole roasted lamb Preparing dough, fillings and seasonings for traditional samsa Selecting, cutting, seasoning and marinating lamb and other ingredients Preparing and grilling lamb skewers according to traditional methods Preparing, seasoning and roasting whole lamb Controlling cooking temperature, timing, flavour, portion size and presentation Preparing and portioning ingredients before service Maintaining consistent taste and quality Following food safety, hygiene and halal food preparation standards Cleaning and maintaining ovens, grills, kitchen equipment and work areas

COMMON REQUIREMENTS:

Ability to follow food safety, hygiene and halal food preparation standards Ability to cooperate with other kitchen employees Ability to provide reliable evidence of previous professional experience A Finnish Hygiene Passport, or willingness to obtain one within the legally required period

Demonstrated professional experience in Central Asian, Uyghur or Northwestern Chinese halal cuisine, including culinary traditions associated with Xinjiang, Gansu and Xian, is considered an advantage.

Language skills in English, Uzbek, Chinese or Uyghur are considered an advantage. These language skills are not mandatory selection requirements, and Finnish is not required.

We offer permanent, full-time employment for both positions. The regular working time is 112.5 hours per three-week period. The work includes evening and weekend shifts. Salary and other employment conditions are determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and the employees professional experience.

Applicants should clearly indicate whether they are applying for Position 1, Position 2, or both positions.

jobs.title: Technical Director
jobs.description:
CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience.

In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.

Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Your Tasks:

Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.

Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.

Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.

Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.

Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.

Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.

Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization.





Your Profile:

Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.

Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.

Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.

People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.

Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.

A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.

Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.

Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: COSTING ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Costing Engineer â Jigs & Fixtures is responsible for the end-to-end financial estimation of specialized tooling required for electronic assembly lines. This role involves analyzing technical drawings, calculating manufacturing costs for custom parts, and budgeting for complex automation components. The goal is to provide accurate "Should-Cost" models that ensure high-quality assembly solutions are delivered within budget.

Core Responsibilities

  • Component & Material Estimation
  • Fabricated Parts: Calculate costs for metallic (Al, SS) and non-metallic (ESD plastics, Delrin) parts by evaluating material weight, machining cycles (CNC/VMC), and finishing processes.
  • Bought-Out Items: Source and maintain price benchmarks for:
    • Mechanical: Bearings, linear rails, and precision slide ways.
    • Pneumatics: Cylinders, DCV valves, and manifold systems.
    • Automation: PLCs, sensors (proximity/optical), magnets, and HMI units.
    • Electrical: Push buttons, switches, wiring harnesses, and connectors.
  • Assembly & Validation Costing
  • Estimate man-hours for mechanical assembly, pneumatic plumbing, and electrical wiring.
  • Factor in costs for fixture testing, calibration, and $Cpk/Ppk$ validation runs.
  • Strategic Financial Analysis
  • Conduct Make vs. Buy analyses for custom fixture components.
  • Perform Value Engineering (VA/VE) to suggest lower-cost alternatives for non-critical parts without sacrificing precision or safety.
  • Maintain a live database of vendor quotes and historical cost data.
Technical Requirements

  • Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Production Engineering.
  • Experience: 3â5 years in costing, specifically within high-precision tooling or electronics assembly.
  • Software Proficiency: * Advanced MS Excel (Macro/Pivot tables) and ERP systems (SAP/Oracle).
    • Ability to view and measure parts using CAD software (SolidWorks/AutoCAD).
  • Process Knowledge: Deep understanding of milling, turning, grinding, and surface treatments.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Estimation Accuracy: Variance between estimated cost and actual procurement cost.
  • Turnaround Time: Speed of providing quotes for new assembly line projects.
  • Cost Savings: Success in identifying 5-10 %$ annual savings through Value Engineering.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  • High attention to detail (zero-error mindset).
  • Strong negotiation skills for dealing with external vendors.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively between Design, Procurement, and Finance teams.

In this role you will join Bluefors' Control & Software team to build and develop an automated monitoring platform for the cryostat units. The platform runs on an edge device installed at customer premises and operates reliably in both air-gapped and cloud-connected environments. It gives customers a live, monitorable dashboard and triggers alarms when something needs attention.

As a Senior Software Developer your key responsibilities are for example develop calculation and business logic for the monitoring platform with Python, build and maintain dashboards and alarm rules in Grafana and model, store, and query data using InfluxDB v2 and Flux. We are looking for a person with a strong technical knowledge and also ability to work with different stakeholders and sharing knowledge.

- A senior role in a technically challenging, innovative and global environment

- Possibility to work both with hands-on development and architectural design
- Flexible hybrid work model, combining weekly office presence and remote work

Work tasks

- Designing and implementing advanced Grafana dashboards for real-time cryostat monitoring
- Managing and optimizing data flows within InfluxDB v2 and Flux
- Participating in designing the architecture of the platform
- Collaborating closely with different internal stakeholders

We are looking for

- Strong Python skills applied to calculation and business logic
- Hands-on experience with Grafana (e.g. dashboards and alerts)

- Experience utilizing AI tools and agents within a modern development environment
- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to oversee complex technical solutions
- A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills
- Fluency in English

Meillä Enersensellä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten ja mielenkiintoisten työtehtävien parissa rennossa ja kannustavassa työympäristössä. Tarjoamme sinulle haasteita ja vastuuta, sillä uskomme, että juuri se tekee työnteosta mukavaa ja kehittävää.

* Osallistut asiakaskohteen laitteistojen kunnossapitotehtäviin ja pienprojekteihin oman osaamisalueesi puitteissa
* Työsi keskittyy tuotantolaitteiden tarkastuksiin, käyttötehtäviin sekä huolto-, kunnossapito- ja vianetsintätöihin
* Lisäksi osallistut aktiivisesti laitoksen kehityshankkeisiin
* Toimit joko asennustiimin jäsenenä tai tarvittaessa kärkimiehenä asennusryhmässä

Vaatimukset:
* Sähköteknisen alan koulutus
* Vähintään 5 vuoden työkokemus itsenäisestä SIA asennustyöstä teollisuuden, vesilaitoksen tai jätevedenpuhdistamon kunnossapidosta
* Erityisosaaminen, kuten:
+ Vesilaitosten automaation tuntemus
+ Pumppujen huolto ja kunnonvalvonta, sähköiset järjestelmät
+ Venttiilien, säätölaitteiden ja sulkujen huolto ja vaihto, mm. Auma, Endress Hauser
+ Valmet DNA prosessidatan analysointi, esim. pumppu käyrien ja kunnonvalvonnan mittausten tarkastelu
* Kyky lukea sähkökuvia ja ymmärtää prosessiautomaation vaikutukset prosessiin.
* Osallistua tiimin jäsenenä mekaanisiin huoltotöihin.
* Hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot
* Ongelmanratkaisukyky ja ennakoiva työote
* Organisointi- ja dokumentointitaidot

jobs.title: Tuotantotyöntekijöitä Pirkkalaan
jobs.description:
FY-Composites on sotilas- ja viranomaiskäyttöön tarkoitettujen vaativien komposiittirakenteiden ja ballististen suojien valmistaja. Tuotteet ja palvelut kattavat taistelijan henkilökohtaiset suojatuotteet ja räätälöidyt komposiittiratkaisut. Suunnittelemme ja valmistamme tuotteet yli 30 vuoden kokemuksella.

Olemme luotettava kumppani. Valmistamme komponentteja ja henkeä pelastavia suojaimia, joiden suorituskykyyn voi luottaa, myös kaikkein vaativimmissa olosuhteissa. Tuotteemme on kehitetty ja testattu yhteistyössä sotilaiden ja viranomaisten kanssa pohjoisen olosuhteissa.


Nyt meillä on haussa FY-Composites Oy:lle Pirkkalaan reippaita TUOTANTOTYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen!

Työnkuva pitää sisällään puolustus- ja turvallisuussektorin komposiittivalmistukseen liittyviä eri työvaiheita mm. koneiden käyttöä, liimauksia, mittauksia, asennuksia ja yleisiä tuotannon työtehtäviä.

Työtä tehdään tällä hetkellä päivävuorossa, mutta lähitulevaisuudessa työ siirtyy kaksivuorotyöhön. Tehtävässä edellytetään valmiutta myös 3-vuorotyöhön tarvittaessa.

Töiden suunniteltu alkamisajankohta olisi heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työt alkavat 6-12kk mittaisella määräaikaisella työsuhteella Wirestaffin kautta, jonka jälkeen hyvät mahdollisuudet vakinaistumiselle

Rekrytointiprosessiin kuuluu työympäristön ja luonteen vuoksi valitulle henkilölle terveystarkastus (työ sisältää kemikaalien käsittelyä), turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumausainetesti.

Mitä FY-Compositesin homma tarjoaa?

- Vaihtelevan työnkuvan, jossa mahdollisuus päästä tekemään monipuolisia ja mielenkiintoisia suojaustuotteita viranomaiskäyttöön

- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön ja todella mukavan ja innostavan työporukan

- Hyvän sopimuspalkkauksen ja omalla tekemisellä pääsee vaikuttamaan palkkakehitykseen

Mitä toivomme hakijalta?

- Tekemisen meininkiä, laadukasta, vastuullista ja tarkkaa työotetta

- Kädentaitoja ja ymmärrystä työkalujen käytöstä

- Kokemusta teollisuustöistä ja valmiutta käytännön tuotantotyöhön

- Suomen kielen taitoa ja Suomen kansalaisuutta

Kiinnostuitko hommasta?

Pääset hakemaan paikkaa suoraan osoitteesta www.wirestaff.fi.

Lisätietoja antaa: Ma-pe klo 13-15 välillä Ville Kangasmäki, puh 044 901 6930 tai sähköpostilla ville.kangasmaki@wirestaff.fi
