jobs.title: S-Päällikkö-valmennus, Varsinais-Suomi, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
TURKU

Kasva päälliköksi ihan tavallisissa töissä – epätavallisen hyvässä porukassa!
Haluaisitko rakentaa uran kaupan tai ravintola-alan esihenkilönä – sellaisessa työssä, jossa arki on sopivasti vauhdikasta, ihmiset ovat keskiössä ja pääset oppimaan tekemällä?

Haemme nyt viittä S-Päällikkö-valmennettavaa kasvamaan tulosvastuullisiksi päälliköiksi Turun Osuuskauppaan. Valmennettavat työllistyvät kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, ja noin puolentoista vuoden mittainen valmennus alkaa 24.11.2026. Valmennuksen aikana saat vahvat valmiudet esihenkilötehtäviin sekä liiketoiminnan ja ihan tavallisen arjen johtamiseen.

Tässä haussa kaupan alan tehtävät sijoittuvat market-toimialalle eli Saleihin, S-marketeihin ja Prismoihin. Ravintola-alalla haemme valmennettavia ensisijaisesti nopean syömisen yksiköihin, kuten lounaskahviloihin ja Hesburgereihin.

Mitä S-Päällikkö-valmennus sisältää?

S-Päällikkö-valmennus yhdistää käytännön työssäoppimisen ja liiketoimintaosaamisen kehittämisen. Valmennuksen aikana työskentelet Turun Osuuskaupan eri yksiköissä Varsinais-Suomen alueella ja pääset tutustumaan toimialasi arkeen ihan käytännössä. Valmennus edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa sekä arkisin että viikonloppuisin toimipaikkojen työvuorojen mukaisesti. Meillä päälliköt eivät johda vain toimistosta käsin, vaan ovat mukana siellä missä tapahtuu: asiakkaiden, tuotteiden, annosten, tiimin ja päivän pienten säätöjen keskellä.

Työssäoppimisen aikana pääset palvelemaan asiakkaita, kehittämään yksikön toimintaa, huolehtimaan myyntikuntoisuudesta sekä osallistumaan liiketoiminnan päivittäiseen johtamiseen. Välillä on rauhallisempaa, välillä päivät ovat vauhdikkaita, mutta juuri siinä tavallisessa arjessa opitaan, miten hyvä työpäivä, toimiva tiimi ja tuloksellinen liiketoiminta rakennetaan.

Valmennus suunnitellaan yksilöllisesti aiemman kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella. Jokaiselle valmennettavalle nimetään henkilökohtainen tuutori, joka toimii esihenkilönäsi, tukee oppimistasi ja auttaa rakentamaan juuri sinulle sopivan kehittymispolun.

Valmennus toteutetaan yhteistyössä Jollas Instituutin kanssa. Käytännön työn lisäksi osallistut lähijaksoille yhdessä muiden alueosuuskauppojen valmennettavien kanssa, suoritat verkko-opintoja ja oppimistehtäviä sekä toteutat projektityön. Näin saat monipuolisen näkemyksen niin omasta toimialastasi kuin koko S-ryhmän liiketoiminnasta.

Valmennuksen hyödyt valmennettaville
Saat kokonaisvaltaisen käsityksen toimialasi liiketoiminnasta ja opit katsomaan arkea myös lukujen, tavoitteiden ja toimintaympäristön kautta.

Pääset työssäoppimisjaksojen kautta kehittämään yksiköiden ja henkilöstön toimintaa ihan oikeassa arjessa.

Ymmärrät esihenkilötyön kokonaiskuvan ja saat valmiudet toimia esihenkilöroolissa Turun Osuuskaupassa.

Verkostoidut S-ryhmän ammattilaisten kanssa ja saat hyvän käsityksen S-ryhmän liiketoimintakokonaisuudesta.


Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työsuhteen, Suomen monipuolisimmat henkilöstöedut, ePassi-edun sekä mahdollisuuden henkilöstörahastoon. Tehtävän palkkaus on 2552 € kuukaudessa. Lisäksi kuulut tulospalkitsemisen piiriin, joka antaa mahdollisuuden ansaita lisäpalkkiota tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta. Ihan tavallisia töitä siis – mutta epätavallisen hyvillä eduilla ja mahdollisuuksilla kasvaa.

Millaisia valmennettavia etsimme?

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos sinua innostavat asiakaspalvelu, myynti, liiketoiminta ja tavoitteellinen työskentely. Työskentelyotteesi on aktiivinen ja rohkea, ja tartut ennakkoluulottomasti uusiin haasteisiin. Viihdyt ihmisten parissa, rakennat luottamusta ja yhteistyötä ympärilläsi sekä toimit sujuvasti monimuotoisessa työyhteisössä.

Et säikähdä sitä, että päällikön työssä arki on välillä hyllytystä, tarjoilua, asiakaspalvelua, organisointia, palautteenantoa, kiirepiikkejä ja pieniä yllätyksiä. Meillä arvostetaan sitä, että asioihin tartutaan, työkaveria autetaan ja hommat hoidetaan yhdessä maaliin.
Lisäksi sinulla on soveltuva AMK-tutkinto tai olet valmistumassa lähiaikoina, ja pystyt työskentelemään sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Odotamme, että sinulla onjo jonkin verran kokemusta työelämästä ja ymmärrystä työyhteisössä toimimisesta. Aiempi kokemus kaupan tai ravintola-alalta on eduksi, mutta meille tärkeintä ovat oikea asenne, oppimishalukkuus ja potentiaali kehittyä tulevaisuuden päälliköksi.

Kiinnostuitko? Sitten hakemaan!

Jos ihan tavalliset työt ja epätavallisen hyvä kasvupolku päällikkötehtäviin houkuttavat, lähetä hakemuksesi S-Päällikkö-valmennukseen 30.8. mennessä. Kerro hakemuksessasi, mikä motivoi sinua hakemaan valmennukseen, ja liitä mukaan CV:si.

Rekrytointiprosessi sisältää ryhmä- ja yksilöhaastattelun. Kaupan toimialan ryhmätilaisuudet ovat 8.9. ja 9.9. Ravintola-alan ryhmätilaisuus järjestetään 7.9. Hakija osallistuu näistä yhteen tilaisuuteen. Haastatteluista jatkoon etenevät ehdokkaat suorittavat henkilöarvioinnin.

Jäikö jokin mietityttämään? Tuutorit ja nykyinen S-Päällikkö-valmennettava vastaavat mielellään kysymyksiisi arkisin klo 9–15 välillä.

Kaupan alan tuutori:
Prismajohtaja Piia Laine puh. 010 764 4033

Matkailu- ja ravitsemuskaupan tuutori:
Ryhmäpäällikkö Katja Honkanen puh. 010 764 4219

Nykyinen S-Päällikkö-valmennettava:
Emil Gustafsson puh. 050400 0506

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
jobs.description:
Haluatko työskennellä monipuolisissa teollisuuden kunnossapitotehtävissä ja päästä mukaan varmistamaan tuotannon sujuvaa toimintaa modernissa työyhteisössä?

Haemme Installerylle **kunnossapitoasentajaa** Keravalle teollisen pesun asiakaskohteeseemme, ja kehittymään pesulatekniikan ammattilaiseksi yhteisöömme.

Tarjoamme kiinnostavia tehtäviä teollisuuden tuotantolaitosten kunnossapidon parissa, sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

Installery on erikoistunut teollisuuden projekti-, kunnossapito- ja tarkastuspalveluihin. Meidät tunnetaan laadukkaasta työnjäljestä, vahvasta ammattiosaamisesta ja asiakaslähtöisestä toimintatavasta.

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

Kunnossapitoasentajana tärkein tehtäväsi on varmistaa asiakkaamme tuotannon häiriötön ja jatkuva toiminta. Työpäiväsi rakentuvat pääosin tuotantolinjojen häiriöiden selvityksestä ja niiden ratkaisemisesta, pienistä projektiluontoisista töistä ja tuotantolaitteiden toiminnan kehittämisestä. Lisäksi olennainen osa työtä on myös ennakkohuoltojen suorittaminen, niiden dokumentointi ja jatkuva parantaminen.

Asiakaskohteemme kattaa kaksi eri laitosta, ja niiden välillä liikkuminen edellyttää ajokorttia.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääosin päivävuorossa, mutta päivystys-, ilta- ja viikonlopputyöt ovat ennaltasovittuina mahdollisia.

Asiakkuuksiimme kuuluu muun muassa elintarviketeollisuuden, teollisuuspesun ja korkean teknologian toimijoita. Meillä pääset työskentelemään mielenkiintoisissa ympäristöissä ja jättämään oman kädenjälkesi teollisuuden huippuosaajien rinnalla.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

- Toivomme sinulta työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, vianhausta ja ongelmanratkaisusta vähintään 1–2 vuoden ajalta. Meiltä löytyy kiinnostavia kohteita myös kokeneemmille kunnossapitoasentajille.

- Tehtävässä menestymistä tukee sähkö-, automaatio-, kone- tai mekaniikka-alan koulutus, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme käytännön kokemusta ja kiinnostusta koneita ja laitteita kohtaan.

- Työkielemme on suomi. Lisäksi englannin perustaidot ovat eduksi esimerkiksi teknisten manuaalien tulkinnassa.


**Miksi Installery?**

Meillä työskentelet avoimessa, työntekijälähtöisessä ja ammattimaisessa työyhteisössä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja kehitetään aktiivisesti.

Tarjoamme:

- monipuoliset ja kiinnostavat teollisuuden kunnossapitokohteet

- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi

- modernit toimitilat Helsingin Käpylässä

- tiiviin yhteisön sisaryhtiömme Engineryn kanssa, joka toimii teollisuuden sähkö-, automaatio- ja mekaniikkasuunnittelun parissa


Meillä voit rakentaa pitkäjänteisen uran. Haluamme mahdollistaa projektikierron eri kohteissa sekä tarjota urapolkuja esimerkiksi työnjohtoon, asennusvalvontaan ja suunnittelutehtäviin.

**Palkka ja edut**

Kunnossapitoasentajan palkka on kokemuksestasi riippuen noin 2800–3600 €/kk.

Lisäksi tarjoamme kattavat työsuhde-edut:

- laadukkaat työvälineet ja työvaatteet

- matkapuhelimen hankintabudjetin (1000 €)

- kattavan työterveyshuollon ja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen

- liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun (400 €/vuosi)

- yrityksen yhteiskäyttöveneen ja vesijetin käyttöösi Helsingissä

- yhteisiä tapahtumia, virkistysmatkoja sekä liikuntaharrastusmahdollisuuksia


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi hakulomakkeemme kautta 30.8. mennessä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja pyrimme palaamaan sinulle mahdollisimman nopeasti.

Installeryn Juha Ryödi kertoo mielellään lisää tehtävästä numerossa 040 487 8179.

Tervetuloa mukaan Installeryn porukkaan!

jobs.title: Two university lecturers, teaching in the Nanjing-Helsinki Institute
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Science invites applications for

TWO UNIVERSITY LECTURERS

starting 1.11.2026 or as agreed.

RESPONSABILITIES
The main duties are teaching for joint bachelor, master and doctoral programs in atmospheric sciences with Nanjing University, supervision of doctoral students and examination of BSc, MSc and PhD theses. The teaching will be performed mainly on-site at Nanjing University campuses in China. The work requires teaching experience in the present degree programmes in atmospheric sciences at the University of Helsinki (ATM-MP and ATM-SciDoc) or equivalent experience of teaching similar courses. The duties of a university lecturer also include research. Working language is English.
QUALIFICATIONS
An ideal candidate has over 2 years of experience in similar duties and expertise in a) or b) clarified below.


a) Expertise in atmospheric chemical transport model development and application, with experience using the CSC – IT Center for Sciences Finnish supercomputing facilities. Research focuses on the atmospheric evolution of aerosol particles, their formation processes, source-attribution analysis and impacts particularly across European and Chinese regions. And teaching experience in aerosol physics, health effects of fine particles, meteorological observations and climate change.
b) Experience in linksbetween plant physiology, carbon and water cycling, and climate resilience across scales from organs to ecosystems using physiologicalexperiments, isotopic analyses, ecosystem measurements, and modeling. And teaching experience in biogeochemistry,biometeorology, forestry and climate change, and quantitative methods including scientific computing and statistics.

We appreciate experience in teaching in the Nanjing degree programme. Pedagogical training is considered as a merit.

The appointee of the university lecturer shall hold an applicable doctoral degree and be able to provide high-quality research-based teaching. The degree requirement must be met before the end of the application period.

WHAT WE OFFER
University of Helsinki is an equal opportunity employer and offers an attractive and diverse workplace with a variety of development opportunities and benefits. The salary is based on the salary system of Finnish universities. The salary range is from 4600-5300 euros per month depending on the qualifications and seniority of the selected candidate.

The University of Helsinki is committed to promoting equality and preventing discrimination in all its operations. The University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care and health insurance, sports facilities, and opportunities for professional development

HOW TO APPLY
Applications shall be submitted through the University of Helsinki´s recruitment system and include the following documents:

* a motivation letter
* a university portfolio (please see https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-of-science/faculty/join-us/academic-portfolio)

External applicants, please submit your application via the Apply Now button.

Internal applicants, who have a helsinki.fi username and a valid employment/grant/visitor contract, please submit your application via the Employee login button.

The deadline for applications is 9.9.2026.

FURTHER INFORMATION

Further information may be obtained:

* About the position and the operational environment from Research Director Katja Lauri, katja.lauri(at)helsinki.fi and Research Coordinator Tom Kokkonen, tom.kokkonen(at)helsinki.fi.

* About the recruitment process and the recruitment system recruitment(at)helsinki.fi.


Institute for Atmospheric and Earth System Research (INAR) is a multi- and interdisciplinary research unit based in physics, chemistry, meteorology, forest sciences, environmental sciences and social sciences in the University of Helsinki. INAR aims to strengthen the internationally leading, integrated multidisciplinary research and education environment for atmospheric and Earth system science and to feed in scientific results for the national and international environment and climate policy. It performs multiscale research from molecular to global scale and focuses on climate change, air quality, biogeochemical cycles and ecosystem processes. INAR is part of the Atmosphere and Climate Competence Centre (ACCC), a Research Council of Finland flagship programme, with partners in Finnish Meteorological Institute, University of Eastern Finland and Tampere University.

The UH Faculty of Science is an equal opportunity workplace committed to advance wellbeing and diversity in science and education. We welcome applicants from a variety of genders, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities. We support the compatibility of work and family-life and promote gender equality in science.

jobs.description:
**Autovuokraamovirkailija Vaasaan – liity palkittuun SIXT-tiimiin**

Haemme asiakkaallemme SIXTille vakituista ja kokoaikaista autovuokraamovirkailijaa Vaasaan.

Vaasan toimipisteessä työskentelee kolmen hengen tiivis ja yrittäjähenkinen tiimi, joka tunnetaan joustavuudesta, energisyydestä ja vahvasta tekemisen meiningistä. Tämä tiimi valittiin Vuoden 2025 toimipisteeksi koko Suomen ja Baltian alueella!

Sixtillä tehdään töitä asiakasta aidosti kuunnellen ja yhdessä onnistuen.

Nyt etsimme joukkoon henkilöä, joka haluaa sitoutua, kehittyä ja rakentaa pitkäaikaista työuraa kansainvälisessä brändissä.

Työt alkavat heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

Autovuokraamovirkailijan työ on monipuolinen ja vastuullinen kokonaisuus, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.

You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event.

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.
Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.
Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.


At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    

Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:

We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide.

We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach :
one based in Mobile (USA)
one based in Bangalore (India)


The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.

Your main tasks and responsibilities are:

Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).  

Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.  

Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG).

This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills.

Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company.

After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation.

Your boarding pass:

You have an advanced level in English.

You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline.

You have structure and systems skills.

You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics.

You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus.

You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious.

This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui approuve les solutions de réparations proposées par le bureau d'études du Service Client, suite à un événement en service . Au sein de l'équipe certification et navigabilité, vous aurez la responsabilité de vérifier et attester que la solution technique ainsi appliquée restaure la navigabilité de l'avion. Cette étape est indispensable pour la remise en service de l'avion.

Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. jobs.title: Lead testing engineer - mechanical m/f (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.



Descriptif mission
Description of the Job



In this role, the Lead Engineer (Mechanical / Hydraulic Testing) will actively participate in NPI (New Product Introduction), technology and value engineering programs of Safran Electronics & Defense business unit by assessing test requirements, authoring test procedures and test reports, performing qualification testing, analyzing / interpreting test data and investigating test failures. The associate engineer will support various Actuation Systems product lines including Power Door Opening System (PDOS), Thrust Reverser Actuation Systems (TRAS) and Highlift Flap and Slat Actuation systems.



2. Lead Testing Engineering Responsibilities and Technical Skillset

o Understand the requirements and generate test procedures.

o Plan for test set-up based on the available test equipment resources and plan for procurement as required to complete the test set-up.

o Provide requirements for test fixture development and co-ordinate with cross-functional teams for development and procurement.

o Understand the requirements of mechanical and hydraulic test rigs

o Conduct Mechanical / Hydraulic component qualification testing and document test evidence.

o Knowledge of hydraulic circuits, servo valves etc and its applications

o Knowledge of qualification test standards such as DO-160 and MIL-STD-810, ARP1383

o Understand qualification test requirements and create a qualification test plan, test procedures, test reports and analysis & similarity reports.

o Able to understand and interpret test data.

o Identify and evaluate test facilities to meet test requirements and coordinate with the suppliers.

o Assistance in off-site testing including transportation, assembly and commissioning of all necessary support equipment, and performance of function tests during off-site testing.

o Failure reporting of the tests and working with cross functional teams to analyze the failures.

o Actively participate in a team environment to meet project objectives.

o Ensure 5S in the test lab before and after the test activities.

o Strong application of health and safety compliance and risk assessment

jobs.title: Husmor till Lemland-Lumparlands församling
jobs.description:
**Vill du skapa trivsel, gemenskap och goda möten?** Lemland-Lumparlands församling söker en engagerad och serviceinriktad **husmor** som vill vara med och skapa välkomnande och trivsamma miljöer för församlingens medlemmar, personal och besökare.

Som husmor har du en viktig roll i församlingens vardag. Du ser vad som behöver göras, tar ansvar för helheten och bidrar till att våra lokaler fungerar väl och känns välkomnande.

**Arbetsuppgifter**

Arbetet är varierande och omfattar bland annat:

- ansvar för ordning, trivsel och praktisk skötsel av församlingens lokaler

- förberedelser inför, minnesstunder, möten och andra församlingsarrangemang i församlingshemmet

- dukning och servering samt enklare matlagning och bakning inför församlingens aktiviteter

- ansvar för inköp och hantering av livsmedel och andra förnödenheter som tillhör ansvarsområdet

- städning och löpande tillsyn av församlingshemmets kök och gemensamma utrymmen

- ansvar för att kök och serveringsutrymmen fungerar på ett hygieniskt och ändamålsenligt sätt

- samarbete med präster, församlingsanställda, frivilliga och andra som använder församlingens lokaler

- vid behov andra praktiska uppgifter som hör till församlingsverksamheten.


Arbetet innebär också att vara en del av församlingens värdskap. Du möter människor i många olika situationer och behöver därför kunna bemöta både församlingsmedlemmar och besökare på ett vänligt, respektfullt och professionellt sätt.

**Vi söker dig som**

- är serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande och noggrann

- tycker om att arbeta med människor

- har god organisationsförmåga och kan arbeta självständigt

- har blick för vad som behöver göras och tar egna initiativ

- trivs med ett varierande arbete där arbetsuppgifterna kan växla från dag till dag

- har god samarbetsförmåga och ett positivt förhållningssätt

- har erfarenhet av köksarbete, servering, städning eller motsvarande praktiska arbetsuppgifter.


Svenska är ett krav för befattningen, i enlighet med församlingens språkstadga. Du behöver ha mycket god muntlig svenska och kunna kommunicera tydligt och begripligt med människor i olika situationer. Eftersom arbetet innebär omfattande kontakt med församlingsmedlemmar och besökare är tydligt tal och god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska en förutsättning för att kunna utföra arbetet.

Utbildning inom restaurang, livsmedelshantering, lokalvård eller annan för befattningen relevant utbildning är meriterande, liksom erfarenhet av arbete inom församling eller annan föreningsverksamhet.

Vi fäster stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

**Vi erbjuder**

Hos oss får du ett omväxlande och meningsfullt arbete där du får vara med och skapa goda möten och en välkomnande miljö i församlingen.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat arbetslag och får arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

**Tjänsten:** deltid, 50 %

**Tillträde:** 1 november eller enligt överenskommelse

**Arbetsplats:** Birgittagården

**Lön:** enligt kollektivavtal

**Ansökan**

Skicka din ansökan, CV och eventuella arbetsintyg till lemland-lumparland@evl.fi senast **8.9.2026**.

Frågor om befattningen besvaras av ekonomichef Maria Ek, maria.ek@evl.fi.

**Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!**

Ansökningar jämte cv tillställs kyrkorådet och skickas till lemland-lumparland@evl.fi

jobs.description:
Skynopy is providing a unique connectivity service for satellite operators through a world wide network of ground stations (antennas) and with an end-to-end connectivity kit approach.

It is serving the booming Low Earth Orbit space industry composed of earth observation satellites and constellations, telecommunications providers and in orbit services players. Founded in October 2023 by two former Loft Orbital directors, Skynopy has the support of renowned advisors. We are now seeking for talents to grow our team and develop our unique services for a competitive space industry.

### Job Description and Responsibilities

As a key member of our team and among the first employees, you will work on the integration of a satellite radio equipment with ground station infrastructure. Here's a breakdown of the tasks you could be involved in:

1. **Integration**: Perform the integration of satellite radio equipment, working closely with ground station components, including downconverters, digitizers, and software modems.
2. **Software Development**: Contribute to the development of software that commands and controls radio equipment, facilitating efficient hardware in the loop testing.
3. **Test-bed Solutions**: Design, implement, and maintain measurement tools and test-bed solutions, ensuring comprehensive validation of link/ modem functionalities.
4. **Custom Signal Processing**: Implement custom signal processing chains to meet the unique needs of satellite customers.
5. **Signal Monitoring and Troubleshooting**: Monitor and troubleshoot analog IF signals, digitalIF signals, and baseband packets with precision

### Qualifications

### *Nice to Haves*

- **Communication Experience**: understanding of RF communications, digital signal processing(DSP), and various protocols, as well as proficiency in digital modulation and coding techniques.
- **Modem Configuration**: Demonstrate hands-on knowledge in configuring and troubleshooting communication modems.
- **Test Equipment Proficiency**: Utilize knowledge of and experience with test equipment, including oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and RF test equipment.
- **Scripting Language Skills**: Proficient in a scripting language, with a preference for Python, to facilitate seamless automation.
- **Mindset** : a positive and solution-oriented mindset
- **Collaboration skills**: Excellent documentation skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary environments. Your contribution will be pivotal in driving the success of our satellite communication initiatives.
- **Communication skills** : capacity to clearly and concisely communicate about technical problems and propose insightful solutions

### *Bonus*

- **Software Radio Protocols**: Familiarity with software radio transport protocols such as VITA-49, for both DigIF and baseband signals.
- **GNU Radio Expertise**: Experience in GNU radio processing chain development, including the creation of custom Out-of-Tree (OOT) blocks.
- **SDR and FPGA Knowledge**: A plus if you possess knowledge in software-defined radio (SDR) and FPGA coding, enabling the development of advanced testing equipment like high-speed data generators

---

Location : Paris, France

Type: Full-time employment (CDI - Contrat à Durée Indeterminée)

You'll prospect every day: building lists, researching advisors and firms, and writing outbound that earns replies. You'll run the first call to qualify fit and book qualified demos for the AE team. You'll own inbound leads from our waitlist and referrals, respond fast, and make sure no good lead goes cold.   • Experience with outbound tooling for sequencing, list-building, and enrichment
  • Background at an early-stage startup where you helped build the motion, not just follow it
  • You've used AI tools in your own workflow and get why this market is about to change

  • Health and dental benefits
  • Unlimited vacation
  • Equity in the company

jobs.description:
Bering-Alaka`ina Holdings, LLC is looking for an Unexploded Ordnance Tech II to support our government customer located at Andros Island in the Bahamas.

Seeking an Unexploded Ordnance Tech II to support the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) Mission in Andros Island, Bahamas. AUTEC is a Major Range and Test Facility Base (MRTFB) and the Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Division Newport's largest single team project, providing both deep and shallow water test and training environments. The Unexploded Ordnance Tech II is responsible for performing handling, preparation, post run and transport of exercise torpedoes and associated equipment in accordance with NAVAIR/NAVSEA/NAVFAC guidelines on the AUTEC project.

Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.

  • Conduct rigging operations of heavy equipment per NAVFAC standards.
  • Handle, package, transport hazardous ordnance material up to 1.1 per NAVORD standards.
  • Operate torpedo data extraction computer per NAVSEA standards.
  • Operate and maintain the breathing air system in support of the torpedo operations.
  • Operate and maintain breathing air system.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Must pass annual CPR / First Aid training.

  • Must pass NAVFAC Crane Certification for CAT III overhead cranes, preferred.
  • U.S. Navy Basic and Advanced Underwater Torpedo School preferred.

  • Two (2) or more years related experience working in a torpedo shop environment.

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas has been a playground for celebrities and discerning travellers set along an 8-kilometre (5-mile) stretch of natural, white-sand beach on Paradise Island. Connect with Bahamian beauty in an enclave of remarkable seclusion, where intimate low-rise buildings are immersed in 14 hectares (35 acres) of Versailles-inspired lawns and gardens. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. However you spend your day, be sure to join us back at Martini Bar and Lounge for a nightcap.

When Legends Come To Life

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club has welcomed the worldâs most discerning guests to our five-mile stretch of natural white sand beach â framed by 35 acres of Versailles inspired lawns and gardens.

Discover the legendary chic of The Ocean Club, combining elevated Four Seasons service with laid-back Bahamian style â creating one of the most sought-after resort experiences in the Caribbean.

On a stretch of natural white sand beach, our resort offers 107 ultra-luxury accommodations, a Balinese-inspired spa, and dining by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

The Ocean Club has a treasured history serving generations of luxury travelers. Expansive lawns and towering coconut palms provide an enchanting backdrop to the pristine beaches of Paradise Island.

The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa.

The Role of the Security Guard III

The Security Guard III plays a crucial role in ensuring the safety and well-being of guests, employees, and property. Their primary responsibility is to deliver optimal protection by enforcing rules and regulations, as well as deterring criminal activities and addressing any emerging issues. These dedicated professionals are vigilant in maintaining a secure environment, demonstrating a commitment to upholding the highest standards of safety and security.

Key Functions

  • Patrol and inspect property to protect against theft fire, vandalism, terrorism and other illegal activity.
  • Posting at stationary positions throughout the property to provide access control.
  • Posting at checkpoints to carry out employee bag checks and monitor employees swiping time clock.
  • Control access of independent contractors and vendors by ensuring that they log in and display proper ID before entering property.
  • Control access of vehicles seeking to enter property and inspect vehicles leaving.
  • Monitor public areas and guests floors to identify and remove undesirable persons and trespassers.
  • Provide escorts for employees and patrons including escorts of cash and other valuables.
  • Provide security for special events and VIP services.
  • Provide exceptional customer service when assisting guests, patrons and employees.
  • Complete incident reports on all incidents and attend court or other hearing or tribunals to testify.
  • Assist the Supervisor with coaching of Security Guards.
  • Assist the Supervisor with the briefing and assigning of Security Guards to their posts.
  • Temporarily perform the duties of Supervisor when required.

This is an exciting time to join The Ocean Club, a Four Seasons Resort.

Applicants that are interested in applying, please note that the position is based on The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort Property located in The Bahamas and is available to those individuals who possess a legal ability to work in The Bahamas without sponsorship.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst (m/f)
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst
Job ID: 10478702 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon is seeking an analytical and resourceful Financial Analyst (FA) to support our fast growing network. In this role, you will be responsible for providing analytical support to the business/financial leadership team by monitoring operational performance and identifying improvement opportunities. You will also get the opportunity to work closely with a variety of stakeholders, including Retail finance, Controllership, BI, Supply Chain and Transportation teams to build multi-billion dollars financial plans. On top of the above, you will be in charge of driving initiatives to improve financial planning and reporting efficiency, develop new bridging / forecasting tools and establish new key performance metrics where appropriate.

Key job responsibilities

· Compiling and reviewing financial results and plans and communicating results to company leaders.
· Equipping management with regular actionable reporting to enable decision making.
· Driving team productivity by automating and outsourcing reporting and analysis.
· Establishing and driving variance analysis processes on an ongoing basis
· Building technical solutions to support planning cycles

A day in the life

The role will require quickly learning and fully grasping the business economics to understand the big picture, gaining proficiency in our data systems to capture the right details, and communicating clearly and succinctly to effectively partner with business leaders and influence decisions. The successful candidate will have the ability to tackle multiple projects and efficiently execute deliverables. The position will also require to be strategic, analytical, and have the demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Basic Qualifications

· BA/BS degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering or other fields with an analytical focus
· Corporate finance or related analytical experience
· Intermediate to advanced experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MSAccess, Python, Essbase and/or Cognos)

· Demonstrated effective written and verbal communication and presentation skills working with peers and various levels of management

· Ability to solve complex problems and perform root cause analyses
· Experience in identifying key metrics, and developing reports and analytical views in business intelligence tools
· High attention to details within frame of structured and organized thinking

Do you have a strong passion for continuous improvement and implementing methodologies such as Six Sigma and Lean?
EU Amazon Transportation Services' ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence System) team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated person as a Process Expert to help develop a world class middle mile process that delivers goods on time at the best cost.

Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A
Job ID: 10465601 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you'll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You'll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

Key job responsibilities

- Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon's cost structure
- Lead projects by overseeing timelines, priorities, auditing quality and resolving issues
- Generate insights from financial data, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and communicate findings with the leadership team to drive business actions
- Own the financial reporting, create scalable processes and monitor teams for accuracy

Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.

Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree
- Experience in multiple finance and accounting roles, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL or Tableau
- Experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving

jobs.description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

We are seeking a Tax Lead to join our global Tax and Treasury team. In this pivotal role, you’ll help Notion navigate a complex global tax environment, create tangible value, strengthen our tax operations, and work collaboratively to develop tax-efficient strategies that enable business expansion and innovation. jobs.description:
Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator
Levi, Lapland, Scandinavian Travel Group

We are looking for a reliable, energetic and hands-on Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator to join our team in Levi for the winter season 2026–2027.
This role supports the smooth daily flow of our winter operations. You will keep guest clothing and equipment clean, dry and ready for departures, assist guests with outfitting, and help maintain a clean and organized office environment.

WORK LOCATION & CONDITIONS
- Location: Scandinavian Travel Group office, Keskuskuja 2 B, Levi
- Working mode: Full-time, on-site
- Main office language: English
- Contract period: fixed-term employment 01.11.2026–31.03.2027
- Application deadline: 31.07.2026

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Winter clothing and gear management
-Cleaning, drying, disinfecting, sorting and organizing winter clothing and equipment
-Preparing correct sizes and clothing sets for guest departures
-Checking the condition of overalls, boots, helmets and other equipment
-Handling basic replacements, repairs and maintenance needs
-Keeping simple washing and maintenance records
2.Guest outfitting
-Helping guests dress and undress before and after activities
-Selecting correct sizes for overalls, boots, helmets and other gear
-Advising guests on layering and staying warm in Arctic conditions
-Providing friendly, efficient and practical customer service during busy departure times
3.Office housekeeping
-Keeping the kitchen, staff areas, front desk zone and entrance clean, safe and organized
-Supporting daily cleanliness in customer-facing and staff areas
-Maintaining a tidy and professional working environment throughout the day

REQUIREMENTS
-Good English skills are required.
-Valid Category B drivers license (minimum) and good driving experience are required.
-Previous cleaning, housekeeping, laundry or equipment maintenance experience is an advantage.
-Additional languages such as Spanish, French, German or Dutch are considered an advantage.

IDEAL PROFILE
-You are practical, reliable, positive and self-disciplined. You are physically ready for active work during a busy winter season, attentive to cleanliness and details, and comfortable working with international guests and colleagues.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Contract type
This is a fixed-term seasonal employment contract. The fixed-term nature is justified by the seasonal peak of the winter travel business in Lapland.

Salary and working hours
Contract type: fixed monthly salary
Starting monthly salary: €2,560 gross
Included working hours: average 37.5–40 hours per week

Supplements
Sunday and official public holiday work is compensated with a 100% pay increase according to Finnish law.
Evening and night work is compensated according to the applicable Program Services Sector Collective

Agreement (Ohjelmapalvelualan TES).

Due to the seasonal nature of our work, we use a working time averaging arrangement under Finnish law and the applicable collective agreement. Working hours are averaged over the contract period. A work schedule is prepared in advance for each period.

ADDITIONAL PERKS
- Access to a shared seasonal ski pass for Levi slopes
- Possibility of local Levi fitness club membership
- Local worker discounts at selected restaurants and shops via Levi Passi
- Friendly international team and lively winter season atmosphere

HOW TO APPLY
Please send your CV and additional information in English to hr@gostg.fi.
Subject line: Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator — Levi
Please mention your earliest possible start date, relevant experience, language skills and whether you need accommodation in Levi.
Application deadline: 31.07.2026.

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

jobs.title: Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)
jobs.description:
Scholz & Friends is the internationally most successful German agency group and is represented in Switzerland through its Zurich office. As a full-service agency, we create orchestrated communication solutions for national and international clients.

For our client UBS Switzerland AG, supporting their LATAM segment across the booking centers in Switzerland and Hamburg, we are currently looking for a

Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)

Your role
•    Support the planning, coordination and execution of marketing activities and client events for LATAM markets across booking centers Switzerland and Hamburg.
•    Manage end-to-end event ticketing processes, including requests, allocations, nominations, tool updates, reporting and follow-up activities.
•    Coordinate closely with Market Business Coordinators and stakeholders to ensure accurate guest management, invitation handling and timely execution.
•    Organise and deliver local client events in Zurich and Geneva, including venue sourcing, restaurant bookings, transportation arrangements, event materials, giveaways and on-site support.
•    Support international and flagship events by consolidating nominations, monitoring confirmations, managing deadlines and coordinating with central event teams.
•    Handle operational event administration, including supplier coordination, invoices, contracts, documentation and post-event follow-up.
•    Ensure accurate event tracking and timely reporting for LATAM markets, contributing to KPI dashboards and management reporting.
•    Provide back-up support for digital lead management activities, maintaining data quality, monitoring follow-ups and coordinating with Client Advisors.
•    Contribute to process improvements and help ensure a consistently high-quality client experience across all marketing and event activities.
•    Place of work will be Zurich.

Your profile
•    Commercial apprenticeship, degree in Marketing, Events Management or a comparable qualification.
•    Professional experience in marketing, event management, hospitality, client service or a similar coordination role.
•    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously.
•    High level of client and service orientation with a proactive, hands-on approach.
•    Excellent attention to detail and strong operational execution skills.
•    Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling ad hoc requests and last-minute changes.
•    Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with internal and external stakeholders.
•    Advanced user of Microsoft Office applications; experience with reporting tools and dashboards is an advantage.
•    Fluency in English is essential; Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly desirable. German would be an advantage.

Are you an upbeat person used to working independently within a team?
Are you a highly organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys creating outstanding client experiences? Do you thrive in a dynamic international environment and enjoy coordinating events, managing operational processes and working with a variety of stakeholders? Then we look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Syngenta

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Hiring Team is seeking a Onsite, Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d) in Münchwilen, Schweiz.

Role purpose:

The role involves leading a team of 1-3 lab technicians in a chemistry lab while being responsible for developing and scaling-up chemical reactions towards manufacturing, including preparation and support of pilot campaigns. The position requires maintaining comprehensive process know-how for all assigned chemical steps. It also demands digital curiosity and confidence, working at the interface of chemistry, data and technology.

Accountabilities:

Ensuring the required HSE standards and good laboratory practices are applied/respected.
Overseeing and defining the experimental program to deliver safe and sustainable chemical processes that are fit for the current development lifecycle stage under guidance of the project lead.
Designing lab experiments and pilot campaigns to generate process understanding and know-how
Maintaining documentation to capture lab results and project requirements as defined by guidance.
Supporting process know-how transfers in agreement with the project lead.
Ensuring close collaboration with project stakeholders.
Supporting the department in specialist roles.
Preparing inputs for cost estimates.
Proposing, supporting, and implementing improvement projects.
Ensuring efficient use of provided resources.
Qualifications
PhD in organic chemistry or chemical engineering, typically with a Post Doc. (or equivalent experience)
Practical experience in organic chemistry.
Fluent English. German and French advantageous.
Good communication skills coupled with the ability to see trends and simplify complex information.
Track record in working within project timelines in a dynamic environment.
Experience in the fields of data science, statistics, modelling, automation or process analytical techniques or in collaborating with experts in these fields.
Basic knowledge of Python, MATLAB, or R or a willingness to learn, is advantageous.
Additional Information
What We Offer

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta’s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)
Please send your complete application with CV, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner (80-100%), (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition.You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Reporting to the Head of HR Switzerland, you will provide HR Business Partner support to the Technology (R&D) and Service Divisions, as well as selected Corporate Functions including HR, Marketing & Communications and Legal, covering an employee population of around 260. As a member of the Technology Management Team, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, helping drive business and people success. You will contribute to the implementation of HR priorities in line with the people strategy, support leaders across the employee lifecycle and take over project work and diverse HR assignments in a dynamic international environment.

Your responsibilities:

Act as strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders across Technology (R&D), Service and selected Corporate Functions.

Serve as a member of the Technology Division Management Team and contribute HR perspectives to business decisions, organizational development and people topics.

Advise and support managers on HR practices, processes and policies, including employee relations, performance management, change management and leadership effectiveness.

Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning and capability development.

Support the implementation of annual HR processes, including performance management, salary review, talent review and employee engagement activities.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities for selected roles and support effective job marketing and communication.

Use workforce and people data to identify trends, derive insights and recommend pragmatic actions that support business objectives.

Lead or contribute to HR projects, process improvements and diverse local or global assignments.

Foster an inclusive, engaging and high-performance culture aligned with Accelleron’s values.

Ensure compliant and consistent HR solutions in line with Swiss employment legislation, internal policies and governance requirements.

Your background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field.

5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager or equivalent HR generalist role in a complex business environment, preferably experience with HR work in management teams.

Experience partnering technical, engineering, R&D, industrial, service or manufacturing populations is highly desirable.

Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, employee relations and Swiss employment legislation.

Experience with Workday or a similar HR system is preferred.

Proven ability to advise, challenge and influence leaders at different organizational levels.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence.

Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international matrix environment.

Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.



You benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits.

Modern office, smart working.

Flexible working models.

Canteen.

Employee Assistance Program.

Global parental leave program.

Strong problem-solving skills and proactive communication abilities.
Fluency in English (minimum B2 level, verbal and written).

SAY YES AND GROW WITH AYES!

Entrée en fonction immédiate

jobs.title: Head of Internal Audit
jobs.description:
Head of Internal Audit  
Key Accountabilities  
Risk ManagementDevelop, implement and coordinate the organization's risk management strategy, and maintain Business Continuity plans for the organization. Introduce a culture of Risk Management supported by policies and guidance. Develop and maintain a Risk Register and ensure it is reviewed regularly by the Management Team. Responsible for the development, auditing, testing and implementation of Business Continuity Plans. Create action plans which show how these policies and plans will be implemented and undertake regular audits to demonstrate that they are effective. Ensure that relevant staff understand the policies and are given assistance and advice when needed. May oversee Group Risk Inspections.  
Quality Assurance  
Implement, support and audit relevant quality assurance systems across the organization. Assess the organization and recommend, priorities and implement relevant organizational and service specific quality policies. Make recommendations and implement an organizational wide quality assurance program based on set objectives ensuring systems and process are in place and working to meet any standards set for achievement. Ensure that all systems (IT and paper) for holding and processing customers' data are compliant with prevailing legislation. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with any quality assurance system or service quality standards. Monitor and evaluate performance against standards or agreed targets. Use audits, feedback loops and corrective action to ensure continuous improvement. Prioritize and escalate issues resulting in non\-complianceReport and take actions on the findings of monitoring and evaluation processes and make recommendations as and SafetyPlan, review, recommend and implement health and safety management procedures and practices across the organization in line with prevailing legislation and operational working practices and instill health and safety culture. Work with external H\&S advisors to ensure Omya remain compliant as a company and utilize as much resources as possible in terms of policies, procedures, audits and advice. Lead and service the H\&S Working Group, and advise and support the Group as appropriate in relation to reviewing, improving and monitoring the H\&S policies, procedures and working practices across the organization. Write and implement a health and safety plan based on external and internal audits with defined responsibilities and delivery dates. Plan, review, recommend, implement and monitor H\&S management systems and practices across the organization including, fire safety, first aid provision and safe working practices etc. Advise and support designated persons with legal compliance and the maintenance of Health and Safety manuals including carrying out risk assessments, H\&S inspections and the management of fire safety, emergency evacuation and first aid provision as required. Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

About us  
We are a Private Recovery Clinic, experts in addiction and affective disorders, providing exceptional treatment and care to an international clientele. Situated on the spectacular shores of Lake Lucerne, we are an English\-speaking boutique clinic treating those suffering from addiction and affective disorders such as depression and anxiety. Our team is dedicated to helping people achieve long\-term recovery through compassionate care.  
The role  
We are currently recruiting dedicated and experienced Recovery Counsellors (100%) to join our multidisciplinary team. The ideal candidate combines personal recovery experience, professional competence, and a strong commitment to supporting others on their recovery journey. In this role, you will work closely with medical and mental health professionals to provide comprehensive care, guidance, and encouragement to our clients.  
Start date: immediately or by agreement.  
Skills and qualifications  
A minimum of 10 years of continuous abstinence from all psychoactive substances  
Excellent written and spoken English (C2 professional proficiency); other languages are an advantage  
Active and ongoing participation in personal recovery work or mutual aid groups, such as Narcotics Anonymous, Alcoholics Anonymous, Gamblers Anonymous, etc.  
A clear understanding of your recovery process and the ability to express it in a differentiated manner  
Good IT skills and the ability to write reports and clinical notes  
A high degree of professional \& personal competence as an "expert from experience"  
The ability to work as part of a multi\-disciplinary team with medical leadership  
A relevant form of training or work experience  
The ability to work with a culturally diverse clientele  
A current driver’s license and willingness to drive  
Ability to commute or relocate close to Lucerne, Switzerland  
Ability to work in shifts (combination of day, overnight, weekends, holidays)  
Must be eligible for a work permit in Switzerland (CH/EU\-/EFTA nationals). An EU passport is ideal for obtaining a work permit if you are applying outside Switzerland.  
Key responsibilities:  
Working as a valued member of the clinical team, our Recovery Counsellors offer essential motivation, support, and guidance to our clients as they embark on their recovery journey with the utmost care and consideration for confidentiality. You will have the opportunity to use your own recovery experience to inspire and guide clients through their recovery process, moderate and deliver group sessions, escort the clients to mutual aid groups in Zurich and Lucerne, accompany them to various off\-site activities, organising and supervising overnight, on\-call, and weekend plans. Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Sport Facilities Manager & Activity Coordinator
to join the school from: 01.11.2026
