jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Fluency in English and French.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €106,000 - €119,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Community Lead
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture and a natural instinct for bringing people together?

ONLY BRAND HOUSE is looking for a Community Lead to shape, grow and strengthen the communities around our brand.

From intimate community gatherings and creative partnerships to larger-scale events and brand activations, this role will create experiences that bring ONLY BRAND HOUSE into the real world and give people meaningful reasons to engage with and participate in the brand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
As our Community Lead, you will develop meaningful relationships between ONLY BRAND HOUSE and the people, places and cultural communities surrounding our brand.
You will work across multiple European markets, building an international network of creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors, ambassadors and brand advocates who authentically connect with ONLY BRAND HOUSE. A particular focus will be on developing our community presence within French-speaking markets.

Working closely with Brand, Creative, Social, Communications and our local markets, you will turn cultural insights and relationships into relevant experiences, partnerships and activations. Your key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute ONLY's community strategy across key markets

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors and brand advocates

  • Identify emerging communities, people and cultural movements relevant to ONLY

  • Develop and execute events, gatherings, launches, pop-ups and cultural activations from concept to delivery

  • Build ONLY's community presence within French-speaking markets

  • Develop creative partnerships with relevant talent, venues, organisations and complementary brands

  • Collaborate with Social and Communications on talent, seeding and organic brand relationships

  • Track community growth, engagement and impact while bringing relevant cultural insights back into the wider Brand team

WHY JOIN ONLY BRAND HOUSE?
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how ONLY BRAND HOUSE builds communities and shows up in culture across international markets. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Shape and develop ONLY’s international community approach

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers and cultural connectors

  • Turn ideas and cultural opportunities into real-world experiences and activations

  • Work across markets and bring local insights and perspectives into the brand

  • Join a collaborative Brand team where new ideas and perspectives are encouraged

ABOUT YOU
You are a connector by nature. You genuinely enjoy meeting people, building relationships and bringing different communities together. At the same time, you know how to turn an idea into reality and are comfortable owning events and projects from concept through to execution. We imagine that you:

  • Have 3–5 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, cultural marketing, PR or a related field

  • Have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture

  • Have experience developing and executing events, activations or community initiatives

  • Understand the difference between building a community and simply building an audience

  • Are proactive, highly organised and comfortable balancing relationship-building with execution

  • Are professionally fluent in both English and French

  • Experience working across European markets and an existing network within fashion, creative or cultural communities are both considered strong advantages.

INTERESTED?
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Head Of Creative, Joshua Mark Bredehoeft on +45 71990213. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than September 10th, 2026. We review applications continuously and reserve the right to close the position once we have found the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark

jobs.title: Rengøringsleder til Renseri
jobs.description:
Vi søger en engageret og struktureret Rengøringsleder til vores renseri hos Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V

Som Rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer, at arbejdsopgaver planlægges, koordineres og udføres effektivt. Du bliver bindeled mellem virksomhedens ejer og medarbejderne og bidrager til en høj kvalitet i både driften og kundeservicen.

Stillingen er en driftskoordinerende funktion uden personale- eller HR-ansvar. Du har ikke ansvar for ansættelser eller afskedigelser, men du har ansvar for at sikre en effektiv daglig drift, høj service og et godt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Ansættelsen forudsætter, at du til enhver tid har gyldig arbejdstilladelse, hvis dette kræves.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsplaner og sikre tilstrækkelig bemanding i forhold til den daglige drift og kundernes behov.

  • Vejlede og støtte medarbejderne i det daglige arbejde for at sikre høj kvalitet og effektiv kundeservice.

  • Modtage og betjene kunder, besvare henvendelser samt modtage servicebestillinger.

  • Håndtere kundefeedback og klager professionelt og sikre hurtig opfølgning.

  • Sikre en effektiv kommunikation mellem medarbejderne og virksomhedens ejer om den daglige drift.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med ansvar for den daglige drift.

  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange og kundeoplevelse.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til vores kontaktperson, da vi akut har brug for en medarbejder i teamet.

We are looking for a dedicated and well-organised Cleaning Supervisor to join our dry-cleaning business at Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V.

As a Cleaning Supervisor, you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the daily operations of the business. You will ensure that daily activities are carried out efficiently, customer service standards remain high, and communication between employees and the business owner runs smoothly.

This is an operational coordination role and does not include HR or personnel management responsibilities. You will not be responsible for hiring, dismissing or conducting employee performance reviews. Instead, your focus will be on ensuring efficient daily operations, service quality and workflow coordination.

Employment is subject to holding a valid work permit at all times where required.

Key Responsibilities

Your duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Monitor and coordinate the company's daily operational activities to ensure efficient workflows.

  • Coordinate employee work schedules and ensure adequate staffing levels to meet operational and customer service needs.

  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to employees to ensure efficient customer service and smooth operations.

  • Welcome and assist customers, respond to enquiries and receive service orders.

  • Handle customer feedback and complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution.

  • Maintain effective communication between employees and the business owner regarding daily operations.

  • Monitor customer service performance and the overall efficiency of daily operations.

  • Monitor customer satisfaction and recommend improvements to enhance the customer experience.

  • Identify operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency.

  • Suggest practical business development ideas and sales initiatives to support business growth and attract new customers.

  • Ensure daily tasks are completed on time while maintaining a well-organised and efficient working environment.

  • Represent the company professionally in all customer interactions.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience in a dry-cleaning, laundry, cleaning or similar service business.

  • Is organised and capable of coordinating daily operations.

  • Has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Is customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service.

  • Is proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.

  • Can work independently while maintaining an overview in a busy working environment.

We Offer

  • A varied and responsible position with a key role in daily operations.

  • The opportunity to contribute to improving operational processes and customer satisfaction.

  • A friendly working environment with short decision-making processes.

  • Close collaboration with the business owner.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

How to Apply

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible to our contact person as we have an immediate need of getting the position filled.

English version:

Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.
The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)
• Knife work in high-volume pork production
• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield
• Following hygiene and safety procedures
• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning
• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends
• Good knife skills
• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant
• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.
If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application
If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Ewa Pedersen email ewape@jks.dk telefon: +45.61204070.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join the Team at Ærø Hotel

Are you reliable, hardworking and looking for an opportunity to live and work in Denmark?

Ærø Hotel is currently looking for 2 motivated employees to join our housekeeping team.

The positions primarily involve housekeeping, but the housekeeping team also assists with the hotel’s dishwashing department as part of the daily operation.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a family-owned and family-operated hotel located in the maritime town of Marstal on the beautiful island of Ærø, Denmark.

The hotel has:

  • 100 hotel rooms

  • Around 35,000 overnight stays every year

  • Restaurant and Compass Bar

  • Conference and event facilities

  • Indoor swimming pool

  • Fitness room

  • An international team with employees from several European countries

Ærø Hotel is Denmark’s only adults-only hotel, welcoming guests aged 18 years and above.

English is the primary working language at the hotel, so it is not necessary to speak Danish.

Your Responsibilities

Your daily responsibilities will include:

  1. Cleaning and preparing guest rooms

  2. Cleaning bathrooms

  3. Changing bed linen and towels

  4. Making beds according to hotel standards

  5. Restocking guest amenities and supplies

  6. Cleaning corridors and other public areas

  7. Ensuring that all rooms are clean, tidy and ready for arriving guests

  8. Following the hotel’s cleaning procedures and quality standards

  9. Assisting in the hotel’s dishwashing department

  10. Washing dishes, glasses, cutlery and kitchen equipment

  11. Keeping the dishwashing area clean and organised

  12. Working closely with the rest of the housekeeping team to ensure an efficient daily operation

We Are Looking For People Who

  • Speak and understand English

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Work well as part of a team

  • Are able to work independently

  • Are comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Can work efficiently while maintaining a high standard

  • Are flexible regarding working hours, including weekends

Previous housekeeping experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, reliability and willingness to work are equally important.

  • 2 available positions

  • Hourly salary of DKK 130 before tax

  • 12.5% Danish holiday pay in addition to the hourly salary

  • Stable employment

  • Friendly and international colleagues

  • Thorough introduction and training

  • Staff accommodation available

  • The opportunity to live and work on the beautiful island of Ærø

Staff Accommodation

Staff accommodation is available approximately 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

At present, each employee has a private bedroom, while kitchen and bathroom facilities are shared with other employees.

Rent is DKK 750 per person per week, including:

  • Electricity

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and a small private kitchen, providing significantly improved and more independent living facilities for our employees.

jobs.title: We Are Hiring – Experienced Chef
jobs.description:
EU/EEA citizenship or valid right to work in Denmark required

Ærø Hotel is looking for an experienced, skilled and reliable Chef to join our international kitchen team.

We are located on the beautiful Danish island of Ærø, in the maritime town of Marstal. We are looking for an experienced chef who enjoys working in a structured professional kitchen, preparing good-quality food for a large number of hotel guests.

We have 1 position available.

About the position

You will become part of our evening kitchen team, which consists of five chefs working closely together.

Ærø Hotel does not operate an à la carte restaurant.

Our kitchen is based on planned production and pre-arranged menus for our hotel guests. We serve between approximately 100 and 200 guests every day.

During the day, we prepare and serve lunches, while dinner consists of pre-booked and predetermined two-course menus.

Our dinner concept follows a fixed rotation of four different two-course menus. After the fourth menu, the rotation starts again on day five.

This means that our kitchen operation is highly structured, allowing the team to focus on good preparation, consistency, quality and efficient service.

We are therefore looking for an experienced chef who is comfortable preparing food in larger quantities and who understands the importance of planning, organisation and consistency when serving many guests.

The primary working language in our kitchen is Spanish, while English is the common language throughout the rest of the hotel.

Your main responsibilities

  • Preparing lunches and evening meals for our hotel guests

  • Preparing and cooking food for approximately 100–200 guests per day

  • Working with our fixed rotation of pre-planned two-course dinner menus

  • Taking responsibility for your own tasks and preparation

  • Working closely with our team of five evening chefs

  • Ensuring consistent quality, taste and presentation

  • Planning and organising preparation efficiently

  • Contributing to a smooth and well-organised dinner service

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene

  • Following Danish food safety and hygiene regulations

  • Supporting your colleagues and contributing to a professional and positive working environment

We are looking for someone who

  • Has solid professional experience working as a chef

  • Is experienced in preparing food for larger groups of guests

  • Is comfortable with high-volume food production

  • Is able to work independently and take responsibility

  • Understands the importance of planning, preparation and consistency

  • Works efficiently and remains organised during busy periods

  • Speaks Spanish and is able to communicate in English

  • Is reliable, responsible and flexible

  • Takes pride in food quality and presentation

  • Enjoys working as part of a professional kitchen team

  • Has EU/EEA citizenship or another valid right to work in Denmark

Previous professional experience as a chef is essential for this position.

Salary and employment conditions

Salary: DKK 180 per hour before tax.

Holiday allowance is paid in addition to the hourly salary in accordance with Danish regulations.

We offer attractive working hours and the opportunity to become part of an established and experienced kitchen team.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Ærø Hotel, Marstal, Denmark

Staff accommodation

If needed, we can offer staff accommodation close to the hotel.

The current accommodation consists of private bedrooms with shared kitchen and bathroom facilities.

Rent is DKK 750 per week and includes:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and small kitchen.

Accommodation is optional and paid by the employee.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a well-established hotel located in Marstal on the island of Ærø in southern Denmark.

We welcome guests from Denmark and abroad and have an international team of employees from several different countries.

Our kitchen is an important part of the hotel experience. Because most of our guests stay with us as part of organised hotel packages, we know in advance how many guests we are cooking for and which menus will be served.

This gives us a structured way of working, where good preparation, teamwork and consistency are essential.

You will become part of an experienced kitchen team where everyone works together to ensure that between 100 and 200 guests receive a good dining experience every day.

Life on Ærø

Ærø is one of Denmark’s most beautiful and distinctive islands.

The island is known for its beautiful coastline, beaches, historic towns, colourful houses, maritime atmosphere and relaxed way of life.

Marstal has a strong maritime tradition and is a lively small town with shops, cafés and the everyday facilities needed when living on the island. At the same time, the sea and nature are always close by.

Working at Ærø Hotel gives you the opportunity to combine a professional job with life in a safe, peaceful and welcoming island community.

For the right person, Ærø offers much more than just a workplace. It is an opportunity to become part of an international team while experiencing a very special part of Denmark.

If you are an experienced chef and would like to become part of our team at Ærø Hotel, we would be very pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction about yourself, your professional kitchen experience and when you would be available to start.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers
jobs.description:
The Centre for Industrial Mechanics in Sønderborg, Denmark, part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year postdoc position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers. The position is open from October 1, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates.

 

About the Position

The position is funded through a collaborative research and innovation project involving SDU, DTU, and Stiesdal Hydrogen, and aims to reduce the CAPEX of green hydrogen production by developing a next-generation bipolar electrode cassette for alkaline electrolysers. One focus will be on geometry-driven bubble management.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will join the SDU Energy Systems Group at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM) and play a key role in developing advanced simulation tools and validating simulations with experimental results. Your work will combine multiphase CFD modelling, current distribution modelling, and collaboration with experimentalists. The objective is to create predictive models that guide cassette design, identify optimal operating conditions, and reduce the need for extensive physical prototyping.

Working closely with researchers at SDU and DTU, as well as engineers at Stiesdal Hydrogen, you will contribute to the development of next-generation hydrogen production technology with clear industrial impact and support its path towards large-scale implementation.

 

Your Role

  • Develop and apply simulation methods for multiphase transport and current distribution 

    in electrolyzers

  • Investigate bubble-buoyancy-driven internal electrolyte circulation

  • Quantify transport processes affecting mass transfer and electrochemical performance

  • Integrate computational and experimental results to advance mechanistic understanding and predictive modelling

  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners

  • Mentor and supervise students (PhD, MSc, BSc) on related research questions

  • Publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences

  • Contribute to research funding applications and assist with teaching activities as relevant

 

Your Profile

  • PhD in engineering, computational science, physics or related discipline

  • Background in computational fluid dynamics (CFD)

  • Experience in multiphase flow and/or electrochemical transport modelling

  • Experience with numerical simulation software such as ANSYS, COMSOL, or OpenFOAM 

  • Programming skills in Python, C++, or equivalent languages

  • Strong teamwork, communication, and independent research skills

  • Proficient in English (spoken and written)

 

Why Join SDU Sønderborg?

The SDU Energy Systems Group at CIM is a dynamic, recently established research group within the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). As part of a young and growing team and institute, you will help shaping research, education, and innovation in engineering science. 

You will have access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities, and benefit from strong academic and industrial networks across Denmark and Europe. CIM is based at SDU’s scenic Sønderborg campus in the Alsion building directly at the waterfront. All study programs are taught in English, and more than half of our students and staff are international, creating an inspiring environment.

SDU maintains close ties to industry in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany, offering direct exposure to real-world challenges and opportunities for cross-sectoral research collaborations. This position offers you the chance to develop your own research ideas, contribute to the growth of the group and institute, and advance your career in a supportive, international setting.

In short, you will benefit from:

  • Access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities

  • A dynamic, international research environment in a scenic campus setting

  • Close ties to industry and opportunities for cross-sectoral collaboration

  • Support for developing your own research ideas and career

 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Martin Lautenschläger 
(mlaut@sdu.dk; phone: + 45 65 50 79 86) or Associate Professor Lars Duggen (duggen@sdu.dk) and visit www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from October 2026. The start date may be adjusted to comply with processing times for any work- and residence permits.  Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: PhD Position in High Performance Organic Photovoltaics
jobs.description:
The Centre for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE), Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position within the DFF funded project LuminOPV. The position is open from Dec. 1, 2026, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

 

What we offer 

The PhD position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center at the Mads Clausen Institute, SDU, where we focus on designing, developing, and bringing forward new sustainable solar energy conversion and storage technologies, in particular new thin film solar cells and modules. The DFF LuminOPV project will explore aggregation-induced emission (AIE)-active molecular materials to control photophysical processes, molecular organization, and energy losses in organic photovoltaics. Complementary interface engineering and passivation strategies will be employed to optimize charge extraction, suppress interfacial defects, enhance operational stability, and facilitate scalable organic solar cells and modules. 

This PhD project focuses specifically on the design and development of AIE-active molecular materials for next-generation organic photovoltaics. The project will be part of the DFF1 project, and research stays abroad is part of the position. Most of your working time is devoted to your own research studies. As a PhD student you are expected to develop your own ideas and communicate scientific results in English. We offer a fully funded PhD position for the duration of three years. 

The successful applicant will be enrolled as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

What we expect 

Candidates who hold a master’s degree in a relevant field (chemistry, material science, physics, electrical engineering and similar). Preferred candidates have experience with some of the following: Organic synthesis, molecular photophysics, organic and/or hybrid semiconductors, thin films and interfaces, and organic photovoltaics. Due to the high cross-disciplinary nature of the work, the candidate is expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

 

Workplace description 

We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg, for developing next-generation sustainable and high-performance photovoltaics. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on green energy technologies - improving performance, device stability and up-scaling, the center has full access to an ISOS5 cleanroom and surface science laboratory facility for the preparation and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. 

 

Further information 

For information about the CAPE research center, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/cape 

For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci

Further information about this position is available from Associate Professor Vida Engmann, e-mail: engmann@mci.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager — Japan Training Quality to support localization for Customer Education, helping ensure Notion training content feels accurate, clear, culturally relevant, and ready to use for learners across the globe.



You’ll work at the intersection of localization quality, training implementation, and program management, collaborating with Localization, Partner Enablement, Customer Education, vendors, and language specialists. You’ll help turn translation feedback, learner experience issues, and regional quality needs into practical improvements across training content, quizzes, LMS setup, and repeatable localization workflows.



The ideal candidate combines native-level Japanese language expertise with a deep understanding of what effective education looks like in the Japanese market.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own and apply Japanese localization QA standards across training content, including checking for accuracy, clarity, tone, terminology, and cultural nuance

 - Support development of glossaries, style guides, QA checklists, review processes, and localization assets

 - Become a go-to partner for translation questions related to Notion-specific concepts, product terminology, and training context

 - Support QA of technical implementation in eLearning authoring tools and LMS environments (course files, quizzes, answer selections)

 - Coordinate across Customer Education, Partner Enablement, Localization, and vendors to align on priorities, timelines, translation progress, and quality expectations

 - Identify workflow risks and recommend improvements that improve translation quality and reduce time-to-launch

 - Document repeatable processes that make training and help center localization easier to manage over time




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Strong understanding of localization workflows, including vendor collaboration, review cycles, glossaries, style guides, QA rubrics, and linguistic QA

 - Experience with Japanese localization QA, ideally for SaaS, technical training, customer education, or partner enablement content

 - Ability to review translated content for quality, clarity, terminology accuracy, cultural nuance, and learner comprehension

 - Familiarity with eLearning or LMS tools; experience with platforms like Skilljar or Parta authoring tools is a plus

 - Comfort working with technical or product-specific terminology that may not translate directly

 - Strong attention to detail, especially in learner-facing content, quizzes, course setup, formatting, and implementation QA

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We want all of our learners should feel like Notion training content was made for them — not simply translated for them. High-quality localization has a direct impact on learner trust, comprehension, launch readiness, and regional enablement outcomes.



This role will help Customer Education and Partner Enablement move faster while raising the quality bar: reducing rework, catching issues before launch, improving vendor feedback loops, and creating a clearer, more repeatable operating model for training localization



This is a 6-month, part-time role with option to extend. Preferred location is Tokyo, but we're open to remote applicants with strong Japanese market expertise and timezone overlap with Japan and Notion's International Experience team.



Availability: 20 hours/week



#LI-Onsite

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821306) U ODJELU ELEKTRO ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – elektro smjera • poznavanje čitanja električnih shema • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• obavlja složene poslove na održavanju elektro opreme i uređaja energetike na crpnim, precrpnim stanicama i vodospremama • obavlja popravak elemenata električnih instalacija niskog napona, sklopne tehnike, rasvjete, grijanja i snage • sudjeluje pri remontu agregata, demontaže i montaže elektro motora, mekih upuštača, frekventnih pretvarača i ispravljača • obavlja izradu električnih instalacija jake i slabe struje • izrađuje i montira sustave za kompenzaciju jalove energije na svim pogonima vodoopskrbe • održava elektroinstalacije u poslovnim prostorima • popravlja i održava vanjsku i unutarnju rasvjetu, gromobransku instalaciju, uzemljenja, izjednačavanje potencijala i kabelskog razvoda • rad u smjenama

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

jobs.title: ISPITIVAČ/ISPITIVAČICA ZA POSLOVE ISPITIVANJA BEZ RAZARANJA (NDT)
jobs.description:
Inženjer strojarstva za rad na poslovima ispitivanja bez razaranja. Posao uključuje provedbu ispitivanja bez razaranja, te pisanje izvještaja provedenim ispitivanjima na Hrvatskom i / ili Engleskom jeziku s odgovarajućim zaključcima. Ispitivanja se vrše na različitim strojarskim elementima i dijelovima parnih turbina i pumpe te slične energetske opreme u pogonima TTK u Karlovcu i na terenu (razna postrojenja). Ispitivanja koja se provode su: - VT – vizualni pregled (povremeno videoskopija i dimenzionalna kontrola)* - UT – ispitivanja ultrazvukom* - PT – ispitivanja penetrantima* - MT – ispitivanja magnetnim česticama* - HT – mjerenja tvrdoće - PMI – analiza sastava materijala *potrebna formalna certifikacije prema HRN EN ISO 9712:2022, minimalno level 2 Rad je samostalan ili u timu, uz podršku inženjeringa TTK. Poželjno je prethodno radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima, te formalna certifikacija. Ukoliko postoji interes a nemate formalnu certifikaciju ista će se provesti od strane TTK uz interno i vanjsko školovanje. Od kandidata se očekuju tehnička stručnost, analitičnost, ozbiljnost u izvršavanju posla te završnim izvještajima te spremnost na terenski rad koji može uključivati i rad vikendom. Uvjeti:
  • VŠS / VSS (strojarstvo)
  • Poželjno prethodno radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • Spremnost na terenski rad
  • Analitičnost i tehnička stručnost
  • Znanje engleskog jezika
Nudimo:
  • Mogućnost stručnog usavršavanja i dodatnih edukacija (rad sa specijaliziranom opremom)
  • Rad na zanimljivim i tehnički zahtjevnim projektima u strojarstvu i energetici
  • Profesionalni razvoj i stjecanje specijalističkih znanja

jobs.title: Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding)
jobs.description:
Aquaphor International OÜ is looking for an experienced Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding) to join our team.

Work tasks: Job description
Repair, service, and maintain injection molds. Perform preventive maintenance and keep molds production-ready. Diagnose mold and tooling issues and carry out necessary repairs. Disassemble, inspect, repair, and assemble molds and their components. Repair and manufacture tooling, mold components, and production fixtures. Support mold trials and troubleshoot mold-related issues in production. Preferred candidate profile Technical or vocational education in toolmaking, machining, mechanical engineering, industrial maintenance, or a related field. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in toolmaking, mold assembly, maintenance, or repair of injection molds. Good understanding of injection mold construction, components, mechanisms, and operating principles. Ability to repair and maintain injection molds of varying complexity, including cold runner and hot runner systems. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings for molds and tooling. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Responsible, precise, and quality-focused approach to work. Good working knowledge of technical English.

We offer: Fixed-term contract for 12 months, with the possibility of extension
4-month probation period. Full-time position, 40 hours per week. Work location: Tallinn, Estonia. Employer-provided health insurance. 28 calendar days of annual leave. Company-provided workwear and personal protective equipment. A performance-based bonus system.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinator in Spain
jobs.description:
Viking Travel Care is looking for Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinators to join our travel insurance assistance centre in Spain.

At Viking Travel Care, you will assist Nordic travellers around the world when they experience illness, accidents or other unexpected situations while travelling. You will provide important support to customers who need reassurance, information and practical assistance.

This could be an exciting opportunity for you if you already live in Spain or are considering moving here.

What does the role involve?

As an Assistance Coordinator, you will often be the first person a customer speaks to when something has happened.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Answering telephone calls and emails
    Listening to customers and understanding their situation
    Opening and following up on cases
    Providing information about insurance coverage
    Assisting with arrangements involving doctors, clinics, transport, hotels or repatriation when required
    Working with insurance companies, doctors, clinics and other partners

Our assistance centre operates 24/7, and working hours are organised across daytime, evening, night and weekend shifts.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular educational background to apply. What matters most is that you enjoy helping people, communicate well and are comfortable working in a busy environment.

Experience in customer service, travel, healthcare, insurance, hospitality or other people-focused roles may be relevant, but it is not a requirement.

A background in areas such as languages, travel and tourism, healthcare, law, insurance or international studies may also be relevant, but is not required.

We are looking for someone who:

    Speaks and writes Danish fluently
    Speaks and writes English confidently
    Is comfortable communicating by telephone and in writing
    Is organised and accurate
    Enjoys finding solutions
    Works well both as part of a team and independently
    Learns new systems quickly
    Is flexible and positive

Additional languages are an advantage.

To proceed in the recruitment process, you must be able to provide a clean criminal record certificate.

What we offer

    A full-time position in accordance with Spanish employment law
    Thorough and structured training
    A competitive salary and good employment conditions
    A social and inclusive working environment
    Varied working days where you can make a genuine difference
    Opportunities for personal and professional development
    Attractive offices in Torrevieja or Fuengirola

How to apply

Please submit your application and CV. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Viking

Viking Travel Care assists travelers and expatriate employees around the world on behalf of travel insurance companies. We coordinate assistance for Nordic travelers and, through our global network of medical providers and partners, provide support in situations ranging from minor travel-related incidents to complex medical emergencies.

Viking Travel Care is part of Viking Assistance Group, a leading Nordic provider of roadside assistance, vehicle-related services and assistance solutions. Viking has offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 09, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Critical Environment Technician
jobs.description:
Overview
Critical Environment Technician (CET) – Shift Role 
Location: 3 Sites Greater Copenhagen Area, Denmark  
Role Type: Shift-based, onsite technical operations role 

Role Summary Microsoft is seeking a Critical Environment Technician (CET) to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Microsoft datacenter infrastructure in Denmark. 
This role is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems within a 24/7 mission-critical environment. 

We offer an excellent work-life balance 
•    Two-day shifts from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. •    Two-night shifts from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. 
•    Seven days off following each rotation, in accordance with the DI agreement. 
Microsoft Culture and Expectations 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within CO+I, this mission is supported through a culture focused on safety, reliability, sustainability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. 
Employees are expected to model Microsoft values, follow approved procedures, apply STOP WORK authority when needed, and contribute to an inclusive environment where all team members can perform, grow, and succeed. 


Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities 
•    Monitor, operate, and control critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems. 
•    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance in accordance with approved EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs. 
•    Respond to incidents, support troubleshooting and recovery activities, and lead response efforts when appropriate. •    Identify and escalate safety, compliance, and operational risks in line with Microsoft standards. 
•    Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure safe and high-quality execution. 
•    Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and developing technical capability over time. 


Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
 •    Upper secondary education (vocational or general upper secondary school) or equivalent practical work experience 
•    Some prior experience in technical work, such as: industrial maintenance, electrical or HVAC installations, energy, process or production facilities, datacentres, hospitals or other demanding technical environments 
•    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
•    Ability to work rotating shift patterns in a 24/7 operational environment. 
•    Ability to communicate effectively in English. 
Preferred (but not essential) Qualifications 
•    Technical certification in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent training. 
•    Experience working with CMMS systems. •    Experience in high-availability, mission-critical, or safety-critical environments. 
•    Exposure to industrial, electrical, mechanical, cooling, or control systems.  

Direct datacenter experience is not required—we provide onboarding and support to build the necessary domain expertise. 
You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. 
If you have strong experience in similar technical environments, a passion for safety, and operations, we encourage you to apply. 

Candidate Profile 
•    The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong safety mindset, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a structured, procedure-driven environment. 
•    Microsoft encourages applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a high-performing datacenter operations team. 
Security Requirements 
Candidates must successfully complete the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and maintain ongoing compliance throughout employment.

jobs.title: German Speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR), Part-time
jobs.description:
We recently expanded into Germany and we are now hiring a part-time Sales Development Representative. Your job is to find German companies that would be a good match for HR-ON’s software solutions for recruitment and core HR, start the conversation, and book the meeting for sales. We don’t know everything yet, and you will be part of shaping the future strategy of our German market expansion.


About the team

In the office you'll spend the most of your time with the Sales Development team: you, one German-speaking SDR and two colleagues covering Denmark. You'll also join the German Squad, consisting of six German-speaking colleagues across sales, marketing and customer success whose job is to make this market work.

With value based self-management at the core of how we work at HR-ON, you are responsible to your team as we don’t have the typical hierarchy. That means great freedom and great responsibility.


What you’ll do
  • Calling and emailing companies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, in German
  • Booking meetings for our sales team to close
  • Following up on leads from campaigns, webinars and events
  • Trying different messages and target groups, and keeping track of what actually works
  • Keeping the CRM in a state where a colleague can pick up your conversation


Do you recognise yourself?

This is an entry level position, so what matters more for this role than your previous experience is that you can say yes to the following statements:

  • I can hold a conversation with someone who wasn't expecting to hear from me, and I don't take a no personally
  • I keep asking questions until I understand, and I can explain something complicated back in the other person's words rather than my own
  • I don't need a manager checking up on me to deliver, and when I'm stuck, I ask instead of waiting
  • I get better results with a team around me, and I keep working on getting better at what I do
  • I speak and write German fluently


What we offer
  • A culture and environment that values output and impact, no matter the title or seniority. That means you can gain experience with tasks and take on responsibilities that are typically reserved for leadership in traditional organisations.
  • A thorough onboarding program and in-house sales training to give you the skills you need to thrive in your role
  • Become part of a team where we take our work seriously while still having fun.
  • Flexible working hours
  • Value-based self-management where mutual trust and transparency come first.


Practical information

Start date: as soon as possible

20 to 25 hours a week, spread how you like, as long as a decent share lands inside German office hours. The job is based in Odense, and we'd like you here at least two days a week. Exact days are agreed with your team.


How we hire

So you know what to expect when you apply:

  • Three short questions and your CV instead of a cover letter
  • A 30-minute screening call.
  • An interview with the team in Odense, including a 20-minute case you receive in advance
  • A decision within a week, and an answer to every candidate either way


Sounds like you?

We read applications as they arrive, so send yours when it is ready rather than waiting for a deadline, and we get back to every single candidate.

Click "apply" to send your application.


About us

HR-ON has grown from a start-up in Odense into one of Europe's most comprehensive HR technology providers, serving more than 600 customers, and we are still accelerating.

HR-ON covers the whole employee journey, from recruitment and onboarding through wellbeing, time registration, employee data and offboarding.

At HR-ON, employees have the freedom to manage their own working time. This means unlimited holiday and parental leave, as well as full flexibility regarding working hours and remote working.

Our employee manifesto outlines a forward-thinking approach to working life, shifting focus from time to results, from control to trust, and from hierarchy to open dialogue. We call this approach value-based self-management because it is based on trust and a shared set of values.

Read more about our Employee Manifesto HERE
